cards.text:
Searchlight can be advanced. X is the number of advancement tokens on Searchlight.
[subroutine]Trace[X]. If successful, give the Runner 1 tag.
[subroutine]Trace[X]. If successful, give the Runner 1 tag.

cards.name: Showing Off
cards.text: Run R&D. If successful, when you breach R&D, access cards from the bottom of R&D instead of the top.

cards.name: Space Camp
cards.text:
While the Runner is accessing this asset in R&D, they must reveal it.
When the Runner accesses this asset, you may place 1 advancement counter on an installed card you can advance.
cards.flavor: Future leaders start here.

cards.name: Spooned
cards.text: Run any server. The first time you fully break a code gate during that run, trash that code gate.

cards.name: Stim Dealer
cards.text: When your turn begins, if there are 2 or more hosted power counters, remove all of them and suffer 1 core damage. This damage cannot be prevented. Otherwise, place 1 power counter on this resource and gain [click].
cards.flavor: Her eyes were the color of dreams and disasters.

cards.name: Sub Boost
cards.text: Host this operation on a rezzed piece of ice as a condition counter with "Host ice gains barrier and gains '[subroutine] End the run.' after its other subroutines."
cards.flavor: "It's fun watching them derez after hitting Enigma." -Grace Lamarr, Freelance Security Expert

cards.name: The Board
cards.text:
Each agenda in the Runner's score area is worth 1 less agenda point.
When this asset is trashed from anywhere while being accessed, add it to the Runner's score area as an agenda worth 2 agenda points.
cards.flavor: No one on the board knows everyone on it.

cards.name: The Twins
cards.text: Whenever the Runner passes a rezzed piece of ice protecting this server, you may reveal and trash another copy of that ice from HQ to force the Runner to encounter the piece of ice just passed again.
cards.flavor: Anything worth doing is worth doing twice.

cards.name: Titan Transnational: Investing In Your Future
cards.text: Whenever you score an agenda, you may place 1 agenda counter on it.
cards.flavor: The Way Forward.

cards.name: Traffic Accident
cards.text:
Play only if the Runner has at least 2 tags.
Do 2 meat damage.
cards.flavor: "Traffic was murder."

cards.name: Uninstall
cards.text: Add an installed program or piece of hardware to your grip.
cards.flavor: Runner software is notoriously scratch-built and under-tested, and the shadow net has no tech support. It works, mostly, but sometimes a fresh install is just the ticket.

cards.name: Valencia Estevez: The Angel of Cayambe
cards.text: The Corp starts the game with 1 bad publicity.
cards.flavor: "Everyone deserves a chance. Everyone."

cards.name: Vigil
cards.text: +1[mu] When your turn begins, if the Corp has cards in HQ equal to their maximum hand size, draw 1 card. Limit 1 console per player.
cards.flavor: "Show me your faith without deeds, if you can."

cards.name: Virus Breeding Ground
cards.text:
When your turn begins, place 1 virus counter on Virus Breeding Ground.
[click]: Move 1 virus counter on Virus Breeding Ground to another card with at least 1 virus counter on it.
cards.flavor: Scraps of code drifting around the network can congeal into pools of data. Within this primordial soup the code breaks, re-assembles, mutates. Evolves.

cards.name: Wanton Destruction
cards.text: Run HQ. If successful, instead of breaching HQ, you may spend any number of [click] to force the Corp to trash that many cards from HQ at random.

cards.name: Wormhole
cards.text:
Wormhole can be advanced and its rez cost is lowered by 3 for each advancement token on it.
[subroutine] Resolve a subroutine on another piece of rezzed ice.
cards.flavor: As through the door of light he came.

cards.name: Adjusted Chronotype
cards.text: The first time each turn you lose [click] except by paying the trigger cost of a paid ability, gain [click].
cards.flavor: Turns a night owl into an early bird!

cards.name: Bandwidth
cards.text: [subroutine] Give the Runner 1 tag. If this run is successful, the Runner removes 1 tag.
cards.flavor: "It tracks you and logs you. If you get in you can just delete the log. But first you have to get in." -Gabriel Santiago

cards.name: Brain-Taping Warehouse
cards.text: The rez cost of bioroid ice is lowered by 1 for each unspent click the Runner has.
cards.flavor: In the vast universe of memories, consciousness slumbers...

cards.name: Capital Investors
cards.text: [click]: Gain 2[credit].
cards.flavor: Give a man money, and he is rich for a day. Teach a man how to invest, and he is rich for life.

cards.name: Clot
cards.text:
The Corp cannot score an agenda during the same turn they installed that agenda.
When the Corp purges virus counters, trash this program.

cards.name: Cortex Lock
cards.text: [subroutine] Do 1 net damage for each unused MU the Runner has.
cards.flavor: The more power a spike process can use, the harder it can hit. The really clever ones borrow the runner's own memory to iterate locally.

cards.name: Enhanced Vision
cards.text: The first time you make a successful run each turn, the Corp reveals 1 card at random from HQ.
cards.flavor: Watch out fellas, this little lady's on the prowl!

cards.name: Gene Conditioning Shoppe
cards.text: Genetics also trigger the second time each turn their trigger condition is met.
cards.flavor: "These g-mods haven't hit the consumer market yet, but I can hook you up."

cards.name: Genetic Resequencing
cards.text: When you score Genetic Resequencing, you may place 1 agenda counter on an agenda in your score area.
cards.flavor: "The best part of our work is that nothing is ever wasted. A gene that is useful once will surely be useful again." -Wong Ya Ching

cards.name: Jinteki Biotech: Life Imagined
cards.text: Before taking your first turn, you may switch this identity with any copy of Jinteki Biotech. [click][click][click]: Flip this identity. Side 1: When you flip this identity, do 2 net damage. Side 2: When you flip this identity, shuffle all cards in Archives into R&D. Side 3: When you flip this identity, place 4 advancement counters on 1 installed card that you can advance.
cards.flavor:
The vats in Building C can create-and destroy-life itself.
The best and brightest genengineers spends their days in the Tank dreaming up a better world.
The Greenhouse was built to enhance natural beauty.

cards.name: NEXT Gold
cards.text: X is the number of rezzed NEXT ice. [subroutine] Do X net damage. [subroutine] Trash X programs.
cards.flavor: "God in Heinlein. What's next, NEXT Platinum?" -John Masanori

cards.name: Negotiator
cards.text:
2[credit]: Break 1 subroutine on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability.
[subroutine] Gain 2[credit].
[subroutine] Trash 1 installed program.
cards.flavor: "Negotiation is an art, so never negotiate when you can intimidate instead." -Thiago Reyes, VP Strategic Operations

cards.name: Paige Piper
cards.text: The first time you install a card each turn (including Paige Piper), you may search your stack for any number of copies of that card and add them to your heap. Shuffle your stack.
cards.flavor: "The Valley is littered with good ideas. You need the discipline to execute if you want to stay in my incubator."

cards.name: Predictive Algorithm
cards.text: This card is not trashed until another current is played or an agenda is stolen. As an additional cost to steal an agenda, the Runner must pay 2[credit].

cards.name: Spike
cards.text: If you have at least 2[link], the memory cost of this program is 0[mu], even if it is not installed. This program gets +1 strength for each installed icebreaker. Interface → [trash]: Break up to 3 barrier subroutines.

cards.name: Symmetrical Visage
cards.text: The first time you spend [click] to draw 1 card (not through a card ability) each turn, gain 1[credit].
cards.flavor: Born for success!

cards.name: Synthetic Blood
cards.text: The first time you take damage each turn, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Your heart deserves the best.

cards.name: Tech Startup
cards.text: When your turn begins, you may trash Tech Startup. If you do, search R&D for an asset, reveal it, and install it. Shuffle R&D.
cards.flavor: "Don't worry. If this one fails, we can start a new one tomorrow."

cards.name: Traffic Jam
cards.text: This card is not trashed until another current is played or an agenda is scored. The advancement requirement of each agenda is increased by 1 for each copy of that agenda in the Corp's score area.

cards.name: Valley Grid
cards.text: Whenever the Runner fully breaks a piece of ice protecting this server, they get -1 maximum hand size until the beginning of your next turn. Limit 1 region per server.

cards.name: Beach Party
cards.text:
When your turn begins, lose [click].
Your maximum hand size is increased by 5.
cards.flavor: "So much to do. So little time."

cards.name: Blacklist
cards.text: Cards cannot leave the Runner's heap for any reason.
cards.flavor: Officially, there is no blacklist. That would be illegal. Unofficially, there is a list, and being on it can ruin a career.

cards.name: Breaker Bay Grid
cards.text: The rez cost of each card in the root of this server is lowered by 5. Limit 1 region per server.
cards.flavor: After the Big One, real estate value changed sharply. Some found that they had become owners of beachfront property. Others were underwater.

cards.name: Career Fair
cards.text: Install 1 resource from your grip, paying 3[credit] less.
cards.flavor: "You can help Jinteki shape the future. Your future."

cards.name: Comet
cards.text: +1[mu] The first time you play an event each turn, you may play another event (without spending a click) after the first one resolves. Limit 1 console per player.

cards.name: Crick
cards.text:
Crick has +3 strength while protecting Archives.
[subroutine] Install a card from Archives (paying its install cost).
cards.flavor: Crick and his colleagues ushered in modern genetics by mapping the structure of DNA.

cards.name: Dorm Computer
cards.text: When you install this hardware, place 4 power counters on it. [click], hosted power counter: Run any server. Whenever you would take tags during that run, prevent all of those tags.

cards.name: Game Day
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this event, spend [click].
If you have fewer cards in your grip than your maximum hand size, draw cards until you have cards in your grip equal to your maximum hand size.

cards.name: Gutenberg
cards.text:
Gutenberg has +3 strength while protecting R&D.
[subroutine] Trace[7]. If successful, give the Runner 1 tag.
cards.flavor: Johannes Gutenberg ignited the first Information Revolution by inventing the movable-type printing press.

cards.name: Hacktivist Meeting
cards.text: This card is not trashed until another current is played or an agenda is scored. As an additional cost to rez non-ice cards, the Corp must randomly trash a card from HQ.

cards.name: Hayley Kaplan: Universal Scholar
cards.text: The first time you install a card each turn, you may install another card of the same type from your grip (paying its install cost).

cards.name: London Library
cards.text: Trash all programs hosted on London Library when your turn ends. [click]: Install a non-virus program from your grip on London Library, ignoring the install cost. [click]: Add a program on London Library to your grip.

cards.name: Meru Mati
cards.text:
Meru Mati has +3 strength while protecting HQ.
[subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor: Meru Mati pushed the limits of physics by engineering the first buckyweave structure, a thousand-foot long wall.

cards.name: Off-Campus Apartment
cards.text: Off-Campus Apartment can host any number of connections. Whenever you install a connection on Off-Campus Apartment, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Usually crashing with friends means sleeping on the couch. This time, it meant sleeping on a server farm.

cards.name: Recruiting Trip
cards.text: Search R&D for up to X different sysops (by title), reveal them, and add them to HQ. Shuffle R&D.
cards.flavor: "My script can perform the Kobayashi algorithm in .12 seconds."

cards.name: Research Grant
cards.text: When you score Research Grant, you may score another copy of Research Grant that is installed.
cards.flavor: "My research could make your corporation billions. And save lives, of course."

cards.name: Student Loans
cards.text: As an additional cost to play an event, if there is a copy of that event in the heap, the Runner must pay 2[credit].
cards.flavor: The cost of an education is sometimes felt sharpest in the stomach.

cards.name: Study Guide
cards.text: This program gets +1 strength for each hosted power counter. Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 code gate subroutine. 2[credit]: Place 1 power counter on this program.
cards.flavor: "Once you download the lecture source files, this program does a statistical analysis and distills the most important concepts." -Hayley Kaplan

cards.name: Turing
cards.text: Turing has +3 strength while protecting a remote server. The Runner cannot use AI programs to break subroutines on Turing. [subroutine] End the run unless the Runner spends [click][click][click].
cards.flavor: Alan Turing laid the foundation for artificial intelligence by suggesting that you could teach a computer to be human.

cards.name: Tyson Observatory
cards.text: [click], [click]: Search your stack for a piece of hardware, reveal it, and add it to your grip. Shuffle your stack.
cards.flavor: "There are whole generations of people who never move out of a megalopolis center. You should see the look on their face the first time they see the stars." -Professor Darren Fin, Astronomy

cards.name: Analog Dreamers
cards.text: [click]: Run R&D. If successful, instead of breaching R&D, you may choose 1 unrezzed non-ice card with no advancement counters on it. The Corp shuffles that card into R&D.
cards.flavor: Sometimes progress means returning to the past.

cards.name: Brain Cage
cards.text:
You get +3 maximum hand size.
When you install this hardware, suffer 1 core damage.
cards.flavor: The skull is not one bone, but 22. The surgery is even more complex than it sounds.

cards.name: Chrome Parlor
cards.text: [interrupt] → Whenever you would suffer damage from a "when installed" ability on a piece of cybernetic hardware, prevent all of that damage.
cards.flavor: Picking a chopper might be the last decision you make. If you find a good one, stick with her for life.

cards.name: Clairvoyant Monitor
cards.text: [subroutine] You and the Runner secretly spend 0[credit], 1[credit], or 2[credit]. Reveal spent credits. If you and the Runner spent a different number of credits, place 1 advancement token on an installed card and end the run.

cards.name: Corporate Town
cards.text:
As an additional cost to rez this asset, forfeit 1 agenda.
When your turn begins, you may trash 1 installed resource. Trashing a resource this way cannot be prevented.
cards.flavor: If you can't buy the city council, create a new city.

cards.name: Crowbar
cards.text: If you have at least 2[link], the memory cost of this program is 0[mu], even if it is not installed. This program gets +1 strength for each installed icebreaker. Interface → [trash]: Break up to 3 code gate subroutines.

cards.name: Cybernetics Division: Humanity Upgraded
cards.text: Each player's maximum hand size is reduced by 1.
cards.flavor: Define Yourself.

cards.name: Immolation Script
cards.text: Run Archives. If successful, whenever you would access a faceup piece of ice in Archives this run, you may instead trash 1 rezzed copy of that ice. Use this ability only once this run.
cards.flavor: The most potent scripts are indistinguishable from magic to the sysop on the other side.

cards.name: Lab Dog
cards.text: [subroutine] The Runner trashes an installed piece of hardware. Trash Lab Dog.
cards.flavor: "Remember those FCC regulations about not creating harmful interference? No? Ah, before your time, I guess." -Cailan Heinrich, Senior Programmer

cards.name: Little Engine
cards.text:
[subroutine] End the run.
[subroutine] End the run.
[subroutine] The Runner gains 5[credit].
cards.flavor: "A sysop is not just a cog in the corporate machine. They have dreams—and nightmares—just like the rest of us." -Kate "Mac" McCaffrey

cards.name: Lockdown
cards.text: [subroutine] The Runner cannot draw cards for the remainder of this turn.
cards.flavor: "When your communications are disrupted, you are isolated from your resources. An attack will surely follow." -The Playbook

cards.name: Net-Ready Eyes
cards.text: When you install Net-Ready Eyes, suffer 2 meat damage. Whenever you initiate a run, choose an icebreaker. That icebreaker has +1 strength for the remainder of the run.

cards.name: Oaktown Grid
cards.text: The trash cost of each card in the root of this server is increased by 3. Limit 1 region per server.
cards.flavor: Built Oaktown tough.

cards.name: Oaktown Renovation
cards.text: Install only faceup. (This agenda is neither rezzed nor unrezzed.) Whenever you advance this agenda, gain 2[credit]. If there are 5 or more hosted advancement counters (including the counter just placed), gain 3[credit] instead.

cards.name: Quicksand
cards.text:
When the Runner encounters Quicksand, place 1 power counter on Quicksand.
Quicksand has +1 strength for each power counter on it.
[subroutine] End the run.

cards.name: Ryon Knight
cards.text: [trash]: Do 1 core damage. Use this ability only during a run against this server and only if the Runner has no unspent [click].
cards.flavor: "Bioroids recognize consciousness in others, but not in themselves."

cards.name: Self-Destruct Chips
cards.text: The Runner's maximum hand size is reduced by 1.
cards.flavor: Cyber enhancements can be dangerous in the wrong hands.

cards.name: Skulljack
cards.text:
When you install this hardware, suffer 1 core damage.
The trash cost of each Corp card is lowered by 1.
cards.flavor: The implanted brain-machine interface, or "skulljack," is the single most common cybernetic enhancement that isn't a medical necessity.

cards.name: Titanium Ribs
cards.text:
When you install Titanium Ribs, suffer 2 meat damage.
You choose the card(s) from your grip to trash whenever you take damage (including the damage taken by installing Titanium Ribs).

cards.name: Turntable
cards.text: +1[mu] Whenever you steal an agenda, you may swap that agenda with an agenda in the Corp's score area. Limit 1 console per player.

cards.name: Allele Repression
cards.text:
Allele Repression can be advanced.
[trash]: Swap 1 card in HQ with 1 card in Archives for each advancement token on Allele Repression.

cards.name: Armand "Geist" Walker: Tech Lord
cards.text: Whenever you use a [trash] ability, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: "Everything has a price."

cards.name: Chameleon
cards.text: When you install this program, choose barrier, code gate, or sentry. When your discard phase ends, add this program to your grip. Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 subroutine on a piece of ice that has the chosen subtype.

cards.name: Contract Killer
cards.text: Contract Killer can be advanced. If there are at least 2 advancement tokens on Contract Killer, it gains: "[click], [trash]: Trash a connection or do 2 meat damage."
cards.flavor: "You want no questions asked, hire someone else. I have two: who and how much?"

cards.name: Defective Brainchips
cards.text: This operation is not trashed until another current is played or an agenda is stolen. [interrupt] → The first time each turn the Runner would suffer core damage, increase that damage by 1.

cards.name: Drive By
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this event, spend [click].
Expose 1 card installed in the root of a remote server. If you do and that card is an asset or upgrade, trash it.

cards.name: Exposé
cards.text: You can advance this asset. [trash]: Remove 1 bad publicity for each hosted advancement counter.
cards.flavor: "Is your neighbor secretly a violent criminal? The answer to this chilling question and more, right after the break." -Shannon Claire, SSN 5

cards.name: Faust
cards.text: Interface → Trash a card from your grip: Break 1 subroutine. Trash a card from your grip: +2 strength.
cards.flavor: The server was quiet that night. I closed my eyes, the low-hum of the datastream lulling me into a trance. When I opened them, the construct stood before me in the shape of a man, clad in light of many colors. His stature was impressive, and his saccharine voice wormed its way into my very soul.

cards.name: Forger
cards.text: +1[link] [interrupt] → [trash]: Prevent 1 tag. [trash]: Remove 1 tag. Limit 1 console per player.
cards.flavor: Using the exact same rig as a million other people is just another form of security through anonymity.

cards.name: Gang Sign
cards.text: Whenever the Corp scores an agenda, breach HQ. You cannot access cards in the root of HQ during this breach.
cards.flavor: Muertos has no fear of the law. Muertos is the law.

cards.name: Hyperdriver
cards.text: When your turn begins, you may remove Hyperdriver from the game and gain [click][click][click].
cards.flavor: "It doesn't actually bend time. It just feels like it. That's relativity." -Hayley Kaplan

cards.name: Marcus Batty
cards.text: [trash]: You and the Runner secretly spend 0[credit], 1[credit], or 2[credit]. Reveal spent credits. If you and the Runner spent a different number of credits, resolve 1 subroutine on a rezzed piece of ice protecting this server. Use this ability only during a run on this server.

cards.name: Muertos Gang Member
cards.text:
When you install Muertos Gang Member, the Corp must derez a card.
When Muertos Gang Member is uninstalled, the Corp may rez a card, ignoring the rez cost.
[trash]: Draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: La Señora de las Sombras giveth and taketh away.

cards.name: Pachinko
cards.text:
[subroutine] End the run if the Runner is tagged.
[subroutine] End the run if the Runner is tagged.
cards.flavor: Pa-pa-pa-chinko!

cards.name: Shiv
cards.text: If you have at least 2[link], the memory cost of this program is 0[mu], even if it is not installed. This program gets +1 strength for each installed icebreaker. Interface → [trash]: Break up to 3 sentry subroutines.

cards.name: Spiderweb
cards.text:
[subroutine] End the run.
[subroutine] End the run.
[subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor: "Let me tell you a secret. There's no such thing as impenetrable ice. It has to allow access, or else why is the server on the Network in the first place? But that doesn't mean they have to make it easy." -g00ru

cards.name: Street Peddler
cards.text:
When you install Street Peddler, host the top 3 cards of your stack facedown on Street Peddler (you may look at these cards at any time).
[trash]: Install 1 card hosted on Street Peddler, lowering its install cost by 1.
cards.flavor: "Whaddya buyin'?"

cards.name: Test Ground
cards.text:
Test Ground can be advanced.
[trash]: Derez 1 card for each advancement token on Test Ground.
cards.flavor:
"Isn't this wrong?"
"Not legally. They didn't read the fine print."

cards.name: Underway Grid
cards.text: Ice protecting this server cannot be bypassed. Cards in the root of and/or protecting this server cannot be exposed. Limit 1 region per server.

cards.name: Underway Renovation
cards.text:
Install Underway Renovation faceup.
Whenever you advance Underway Renovation, trash the top card of the Runner's stack (or top 2 cards instead if there are 4 or more advancement tokens on Underway Renovation).

cards.name: An Offer You Can’t Refuse
cards.text: Choose a central server. The Runner may run that server. They cannot jack out during that run. If no run is made this way, add this operation to your score area as an agenda worth 1 agenda point.

cards.name: Award Bait
cards.text:
While the Runner is accessing this agenda in R&D, they must reveal it.
When the Runner accesses this agenda, you may place up to 2 advancement counters on 1 installed card you can advance.

cards.name: Back Channels
cards.text: Choose 1 card in the root of a remote server. Gain 3[credit] for each advancement counter on that card, then trash it.
cards.flavor: Sometimes corps have to bury projects, but that doesn't mean they can't make a profit on them.

cards.name: Casting Call
cards.text: Install 1 agenda from HQ faceup and host this operation on that agenda as a condition counter with "Whenever the Runner accesses host agenda, they take 2 tags."

cards.name: Drug Dealer
cards.text:
When your turn begins, lose 1[credit].
When the Corp's turn begins, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: "Just a bunch of knockoffs for the touristos. The real designer stuff isn't sold on the street."

cards.name: Early Premiere
cards.text: When your turn begins, you may pay 1[credit]. If you do, place 1 advancement counter on a card you can advance in the root of a server.

cards.name: Enforcer 1.0
cards.text: As an additional cost to rez this ice, forfeit 1 agenda. Lose [click]: Break 1 subroutine on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability. [subroutine] Trash 1 installed program. [subroutine] Do 1 core damage. [subroutine] Trash 1 installed console. [subroutine] Trash all installed virtual resources.

cards.name: Explode-a-palooza
cards.text:
While the Runner is accessing this agenda in R&D, they must reveal it.
When the Runner accesses this agenda, you may gain 5[credit].
cards.flavor: It's like Lethal Action 3, only with more explosions.

cards.name: Fan Site
cards.text: Whenever the Corp scores an agenda, add Fan Site to your score area as an agenda worth 0 agenda points.
cards.flavor: Your life is not your own, once you become famous on the Net.

cards.name: Film Critic
cards.text:
Film Critic can host a single agenda.
Whenever you access an agenda, you may host that agenda on Film Critic (the agenda is no longer being accessed and is uninstalled).
[click],[click]: Add an agenda hosted on Film Critic to your score area.
cards.flavor: "My gerbil could write a better screenplay."

cards.name: Haarpsichord Studios: Entertainment Unleashed
cards.text: The Runner cannot steal more than one agenda each turn.
cards.flavor: Home of Your Imagination.

cards.name: Hollywood Renovation
cards.text:
Install Hollywood Renovation faceup.
Whenever you advance Hollywood Renovation, you may place 1 advancement token on another card that can be advanced (or 2 advancement tokens instead if there are 6 or more advancement tokens on Hollywood Renovation).

cards.name: It's a Trap!
cards.text:
Whenever this ice is exposed, do 2 net damage.
[subroutine] The Runner trashes 1 of their installed cards. Trash this ice.
cards.flavor: I warned you.

cards.name: Old Hollywood Grid
cards.text: Persistent → The Runner cannot steal agendas from this server or its root. Ignore this ability for any agenda the Runner has a copy of in their score area. (If the Runner trashes this card while accessing it, this ability still applies for the remainder of this run.) Limit 1 region per server.

cards.name: Paparazzi
cards.text:
You are tagged.
[interrupt] → Whenever you would take meat damage, prevent all of that damage.
cards.flavor: "Yeah, we know right where she is. Just pull up Sizzler!"

cards.name: Rolodex
cards.text:
When you install Rolodex, look at the top 5 cards of your stack and arrange them in any order.
When Rolodex is trashed, trash the top 3 cards of your stack.
cards.flavor: "I told you to lose my number!"

cards.name: Ronald Five
cards.text: Whenever the Runner trashes a Corp card (including this asset), they lose [click].
cards.flavor: "It's our most pirated property ever. Great work, everyone."

cards.name: Spoilers
cards.text: Whenever the Corp scores an agenda, they trash the top card of R&D.
cards.flavor: Don't you hate it when you know everything before it's even out?

cards.name: Trope
cards.text: When your turn begins, place 1 power counter on Trope. [click], remove Trope from the game: Shuffle 1 card from your heap into your stack for each power counter on Trope.
cards.flavor: "Did you ever notice how everything goes in cycles? The stuff that's cool now was cool before. That's why I keep copy of everything!" -Princess Space Kitten

cards.name: Ancestral Imager
cards.text: Whenever the Runner jacks out, do 1 net damage.
cards.flavor: The more people submit their DNA and family history to the program, the more accurate it becomes.

cards.name: Bookmark
cards.text: [click]: Host up to 3 cards from your grip facedown on this hardware (you may look at these cards at any time). [click]: Add all hosted cards to your grip. [trash]: Add all hosted cards to your grip.

cards.name: Chronos Protocol: Selective Mind-mapping
cards.text: For the first net damage the Runner suffers each turn, you may look at the Runner's grip and select the card that is trashed.

cards.name: Cybernetics Court
cards.text: Your maximum hand size is increased by 4.
cards.flavor: The Cybernetics Court has seven floors of attractions. The plasteel used to construct it was even more expensive than the thousands of cybernetic implants displayed inside.

cards.name: DDoS
cards.text: [trash]: The Corp cannot rez the outermost piece of ice during a run on any server this turn.
cards.flavor: "First, you get a horde of zombies. Then you do whatever you want, 'cuz you have a horde of zombies." -Ji "Noise" Reilly

cards.name: DaVinci
cards.text:
Whenever you make a successful run, place 1 power counter on DaVinci.
[trash]: Install a card from your grip with an install cost equal to or less than the number of power counters on DaVinci, ignoring the install cost.
cards.flavor: "Our life is made by the death of others." -Leonardo Da Vinci

cards.name: Expo Grid
cards.text: When your turn begins, gain 1[credit] if there is a rezzed asset installed in the root of this server. Limit 1 region per server.
cards.flavor: The expo was built in the East California desert: a temporary city constructed for the advancement of humanity.

cards.name: Fisk Investment Seminar
cards.text:
Play only as your first [click].
Each player draws 3 cards.
cards.flavor: "The secret to investing is networking." -Laramy Fisk

cards.name: Franchise City
cards.text:
While the Runner is accessing an agenda in R&D, they must reveal it.
When the Runner accesses an agenda, add this asset to your score area as an agenda worth 1 agenda point.
cards.flavor: There are over 20,000 brands represented in Franchise City, all of them owned by fewer than 100 corps.

cards.name: Genetics Pavilion
cards.text: The Runner cannot draw more than 2 cards during each of their turns.
cards.flavor: The Genetics Pavilion was designed by renowned architect Meru Mati II. It was built without the aid of bioroids, instead relying on human and clone labor.

cards.name: Laramy Fisk: Savvy Investor
cards.text: The first time you make a successful run on a central server each turn, you may force the Corp to draw 1 card.

cards.name: Power to the People
cards.text:
Play only as your first [click].
The first time you access an agenda this turn, gain 7[credit].
cards.flavor: As the sun sank towards the horizon, the glittering lights of the expo remained dark. But the shanty city bloomed to life.

cards.name: Product Placement
cards.text:
While the Runner is accessing this upgrade in R&D, they must reveal it.
When the Runner accesses this upgrade anywhere except in Archives, gain 2[credit].

cards.name: Public Support
cards.text:
Place 3 power counters on Public Support when it is rezzed. When there are no power counters left on Public Support, add it to your score area as an agenda worth 1 agenda point.
When your turn begins, remove 1 power counter from Public Support.

cards.name: Surfer
cards.text: 2[credit]: Swap a piece of barrier ice currently being encountered with a piece of ice directly before or after it. The run continues from this new position. You are still encountering that ice.
cards.flavor: Cowabunga, dude!

cards.name: Team Sponsorship
cards.text: Whenever you score an agenda, you may install a card from Archives or HQ, ignoring the install cost.
cards.flavor: The SanSan Outlaws have a close relationship with Haas-Bioroid's sports engineering division, SHIFT.

cards.name: The Future is Now
cards.text: When you score The Future is Now, search R&D for a card and add it to HQ. Shuffle R&D.

cards.name: Tour Guide
cards.text: This ice gains "[subroutine] End the run." for each rezzed asset.
cards.flavor: "Hello, and welcome to the Universe of Tomorrow! You could live for five-hundred years and not see all of the attractions I can tell you about."

cards.name: Wireless Net Pavilion
cards.text: As an additional cost to take the basic action to trash 1 installed resource, the Corp must pay 2[credit].
cards.flavor: Almost a zettabyte of data flows each minute through one of the many net pavilions scattered around the expo.

cards.name: Worlds Plaza
cards.text:
Worlds Plaza can host up to 3 assets.
[click]: Install an asset from HQ on Worlds Plaza and rez it, lowering its rez cost by 2, if able.
cards.flavor: The holosculpture depicts the three inhabited worlds. The square can hold almost 1% of their total population.

cards.name: 15 Minutes
cards.text:
[click]: Shuffle 15 Minutes into R&D. The Corp can trigger this ability while 15 Minutes is in the Runner's score area.
Limit 1 per deck.
cards.flavor: You had your shot, and you blew it.

cards.name: 24/7 News Cycle
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play 24/7 News Cycle, forfeit an agenda.
Resolve the "when scored" ability on an agenda in your score area.
cards.flavor: The only thing worse than bad news...

cards.name: Ad Blitz
cards.text: As an additional cost to play this operation, spend [click]. Install and rez (paying all costs) X advertisements from Archives and/or HQ, if able.

cards.name: Adam: Compulsive Hacker
cards.text: You start the game with 3 different directive cards installed (these cards are not considered part of your deck).

cards.name: Always Be Running
cards.text: The first [click] you spend each turn must be spent to take the basic action to play an event or the basic action to run a server. You cannot take the action to play an event this way except if you play a run event. Once per turn → Lose [click][click]: Break 1 subroutine.
cards.flavor: The Second Directive requires a bioroid to complete its primary function above all other considerations, save the First Directive.

cards.name: Apex: Invasive Predator
cards.text: You cannot install non-virtual resources. When your turn begins, you may install 1 card from your grip facedown.

cards.name: Apocalypse
cards.text:
Play only if you made a successful run on HQ, R&D and Archives this turn.
Trash all installed Corp cards. Turn all installed Runner cards facedown.
cards.flavor: THE DESTROYER OF WORLDS

cards.name: Archangel
cards.text:
While the Runner is accessing this ice in R&D, they must reveal it.
When the Runner accesses this ice anywhere except in Archives, you may pay 3[credit]. If you do, they encounter it.
[subroutine] Trace[6]. If successful, add 1 installed Runner card to the grip.

cards.name: Assassin
cards.text:
[subroutine] Trace[5]. If successful, do 3 net damage.
[subroutine] Trace[4]. If successful, trash 1 program.
cards.flavor: Bounce rate is a well-understood measure of ice strength. But it is not the only measure.

cards.name: Brain Chip
cards.text: +X[mu] Your maximum hand size is increased by X. X is equal to the number of agenda points you have. Limit 1 console per player.

cards.name: Dr. Lovegood
cards.text: When your turn begins, choose 1 of your installed cards. That card loses its printed abilities for the remainder of the turn.
cards.flavor: "You look tore up, kid. Have a seat, I'll fire up the arc welder."

cards.name: Employee Strike
cards.text: This event is not trashed until another current is played or an agenda is scored. The Corp's identity loses its printed abilities.
cards.flavor: "Are you crazy? We can't send in prisec until the media gets bored and goes home."

cards.name: Endless Hunger
cards.text: Interface → Trash 1 installed card: Break 1 "[subroutine] End the run." subroutine.
cards.flavor: "I've been monitoring the anomaly's activity across the New Angeles Pacifica and Andea trunk lines and associated nodes. I have yet to detect a predictable pattern or even to formulate a theory as to the anomaly's nature." -Joséo Greene, SYNC Analyst

cards.name: GS Sherman M3
cards.text: If you have at least 2[link], the memory cost of this program is 0[mu], even if it is not installed. Interface → 2[credit]: Break any number of barrier subroutines. 2[credit]: +3 strength.
cards.flavor: Boom.

cards.name: GS Shrike M2
cards.text: If you have at least 2[link], the memory cost of this program is 0[mu], even if it is not installed. Interface → 2[credit]: Break any number of sentry subroutines. 2[credit]: +3 strength.
cards.flavor: Badder.

cards.name: GS Striker M1
cards.text: If you have at least 2[link], the memory cost of this program is 0[mu], even if it is not installed. Interface → 2[credit]: Break any number of code gate subroutines. 2[credit]: +3 strength.
cards.flavor: Bigger.

cards.name: Global Food Initiative
cards.text: Global Food Initiative is worth 1 fewer agenda point while in the Runner's score area.
cards.flavor: "Corporations are made up of people. It's ridiculous to think they'd be either all good or all bad." -Sunny Lebeau

cards.name: Globalsec Security Clearance
cards.text:
Install only if you have at least 2[link].
When your turn begins, you may lose [click]. If you do, look at the top card of R&D.
cards.flavor: She approached the server, flashed her credentials, and passed straight through. She wondered what it said about her that doing things the legal way felt like cheating.

cards.name: Harbinger
cards.text: [interrupt] → When this program would be trashed, turn it facedown instead of adding it to your heap. (It is still considered trashed.)
cards.flavor: I AM BECOME DEATH

cards.name: Heartbeat
cards.text: +1[mu] [interrupt] → Trash 1 of your installed cards: Prevent 1 damage. Limit 1 console per player.
cards.flavor: "Meantime the hellish tattoo of the heart increased. It grew quicker and quicker, and louder and louder every instant." -Edgar Allan Poe

cards.name: Hunting Grounds
cards.text: [interrupt], once per turn → 0[credit]: Prevent a "when encountered" ability on a piece of ice. [trash]: Install the top 3 cards of your stack facedown.
cards.flavor: "There's parts of the Network now that are different from how they used to be. I can't put my finger on it; just something twitching at my ganglion through my BMI." -Reeve

cards.name: Improved Tracers
cards.text: All tracer ice have +1 strength. The base trace strength of each subroutine is increased by 1.
cards.flavor: "The trick isn't software, it's hardware. Cyberspace is a collection of physical machines. If we control the machines, we control it all." -KR Kane, "Our Future"

cards.name: Independent Thinking
cards.text: Trash up to 5 of your installed cards. Draw 1 card for each card trashed (or 2 cards for each card trashed if you trashed at least 1 directive).
cards.flavor: Adam raised the hammer. He was free.

cards.name: Jak Sinclair
cards.text:
Reduce the cost to install Jak Sinclair by 1 for each [link] you have.
When your turn begins, you may make a run. You cannot use programs during this run.
cards.flavor: "I got an early start today...or maybe I forgot to go home last night."

cards.name: Keegan Lane
cards.text: [trash], remove 1 tag: Trash 1 program. Use this ability only during a run on this server.
cards.flavor: "We use ice on our servers. More runners should ice their own rigs."

cards.name: Launch Campaign
cards.text:
Place 6[credit] from the bank on Launch Campaign when it is rezzed. When there are no credits left on Launch Campaign, trash it.
When your turn begins, take 2[credit] from Launch Campaign.

cards.name: Lily Lockwell
cards.text: When you rez Lily Lockwell, draw 3 cards. [click], remove 1 tag: Search R&D for an operation, reveal it, and shuffle the rest of R&D. Add the operation to the top of R&D.
cards.flavor: "Live from New Angeles, this is Lily Lockwell."

cards.name: Media Blitz
cards.text: This card is not trashed until another current is played or an agenda is stolen. Choose an agenda in the Runner's score area. Media Blitz gains the text of that agenda.

cards.name: Multithreader
cards.text:
2[recurring-credit]
Use these credits to pay for using programs.
cards.flavor: Bioroids have two brains running in parallel, each capable of running sophisticated programming. There are certain advantages to the setup.

cards.name: Neutralize All Threats
cards.text:
The first time each turn you access a card with a trash cost, reveal it. You must trash that card by paying its trash cost, if able.
Whenever you breach HQ, access 1 additional card.
cards.flavor: The Third Directive requires a bioroid to preserve its ability to function and report frequently to Haas-Bioroid for repairs and updates.

cards.name: New Angeles Sol: Your News
cards.text: Whenever an agenda is scored or stolen, you may play 1 current from HQ or Archives (paying its play cost).
cards.flavor: Nothing but the Truth.

cards.name: News Hound
cards.text: [subroutine] Trace[3]. If successful, give the Runner 1 tag. If a current is active, this ice gains "[subroutine] End the run." after its other subroutines.
cards.flavor: "Most reporting these days can be done by AI. We just need the talent for the name recognition."

cards.name: News Team
cards.text:
While the Runner is accessing this asset in R&D, they must reveal it.
When the Runner accesses this asset, they must either take 2 tags or add this asset to their score area as an agenda worth -1 agenda point.

cards.name: Prey
cards.text: Make a run. Once during this run, when you pass a piece of ice, you may trash a number of your installed cards equal to the strength of that ice. If you do, trash that ice.

cards.name: Quantum Predictive Model
cards.text:
While the Runner is accessing this agenda in R&D, they must reveal it.
When the Runner accesses this agenda while they are tagged, add it to your score area.
cards.flavor: "Yes and No."

cards.name: Reality Threedee
cards.text:
When you rez this asset, take 1 bad publicity.
When your turn begins, if the Runner is tagged, gain 2[credit]. Otherwise, gain 1[credit].
cards.flavor: "They're gonna try and make you a star. Whether you want it or not." -MaxX

cards.name: Rebranding Team
cards.text: All assets gain advertisement.
cards.flavor: "Nobody ever lost a dollar by underestimating the taste of the public." -Phineas Taylor Barnum

cards.name: Resistor
cards.text:
Resistor has +1 strength for each tag the Runner has.
[subroutine] Trace[4]. If successful, end the run.
cards.flavor: "In the Olden Times, a 'resistor' was a vital component of practically all electronic equipment. You know, back when dinosaurs roamed the Earth." -Chaos Theory

cards.name: Rutherford Grid
cards.text: The base trace strength of each trace during a run on this server is increased by 2. Limit 1 region per server.
cards.flavor: To the worlds sitting on the couch and watching threedee, Rutherford District might as well be all of New Angeles.

cards.name: SYNC: Everything, Everywhere
cards.text:
[click]: Flip this identity.
The Runner pays 1[credit] more when spending a [click] to remove a tag (not through a card ability).
Flip side:
[click]: Flip this identity.
You may pay 2[credit] fewer when spending a [click] to trash a resource (not through a card ability).

cards.name: Safety First
cards.text:
Your maximum hand size is reduced by 2.
When your turn ends, draw 1 card if you do not have cards in your grip equal to or greater than your maximum hand size.
cards.flavor: The First Directive forbids a bioroid from harming, or through inaction allowing harm to befall, a human being.

cards.name: Security Chip
cards.text: [trash]: Choose an icebreaker (or any number of cloud icebreakers). Each chosen icebreaker has +1 strength for each [link] you have for the remainder of this run. Use this ability only during a run.
cards.flavor: Fortunately, Globalsec buys them by the case.

cards.name: Security Nexus
cards.text: +1[mu], +1[link] Once per turn → When you encounter a piece of ice, you may have the Corp trace[5]. If successful, they give you 1 tag and end the run. If unsuccesful, bypass the encountered ice. Limit 1 console per player.

cards.name: Shannon Claire
cards.text:
[click]: Draw 1 card from the bottom of R&D.
[trash]: Search R&D or Archives for an agenda and reveal it. Shuffle the rest of R&D if you searched it. Add the agenda to the bottom of R&D.
cards.flavor: No one can bury a story better.

cards.name: Spark Agency: Worldswide Reach
cards.text: The first time each turn you rez an advertisement, the Runner loses 1[credit].
cards.flavor: We're ready to start the fire.

cards.name: Special Offer
cards.text: [subroutine] The Corp gains 5[credit]. Trash Special Offer.
cards.flavor: "If I didn't know better, I'd say they got the better end of that deal." -John Masanori

cards.name: Surveillance Sweep
cards.text: This card is not trashed until another current is played or an agenda is stolen. The Runner must spend credits first for each trace attempt during a run.

cards.name: TL;DR
cards.text: [subroutine] The next time the Runner encounters a piece of ice during this run, that ice gains a second copy of each of its subroutines (after the original subroutine) for the remainder of that encounter.
cards.flavor: //tl;dr duplicate the subs on the next piece of ice

cards.name: Technical Writer
cards.text:
Whenever you install a piece of hardware or a program, place 1[credit] from the bank on Technical Writer.
[click],[trash]: Take all credits from Technical Writer.
cards.flavor: Technically correct: the best kind of correct.

cards.name: The All-Seeing I
cards.text:
Play only if the Runner is tagged.
Trash all installed resources unless the Runner removes 1 bad publicity.
cards.flavor: "Only with perfect information can we develop the perfect strategy." -The Playbook

cards.name: Turnpike
cards.text:
When the Runner encounters this ice, they lose 1[credit].
[subroutine] Trace[5]. If successful, give the Runner 1 tag.
cards.flavor: "Stay out of the fast lanes! If speed's your only concern, you're already tagged and halfway to fragged." -g00ru

cards.name: Victoria Jenkins
cards.text:
The Runner gets -1 allotted [click] for each of their turns.
When this asset is trashed from anywhere while being accessed, add it to the Runner's score area as an agenda worth 2 agenda points.

cards.name: Wasteland
cards.text: The first time each turn you trash 1 of your installed cards, gain 1[credit].
cards.flavor: Data goes in. Nothing comes out.

cards.name: Windfall
cards.text: Shuffle your stack. Trash the top card of your stack. Gain X[credit] where X is equal to the install cost of that card.
cards.flavor: She tried to remember who he was. Not that it mattered anymore.

cards.name: Advanced Concept Hopper
cards.text: The first time the Runner initiates a run each turn, you may draw 1 card or gain 1[credit].
cards.flavor: "I don't want a hopper. I've never even owned one. But every time I jack in, that same damn ad loads." -2xTiger

cards.name: Artist Colony
cards.text: Forfeit 1 agenda: Search your stack for 1 program, resource, or piece of hardware. Install that card.
cards.flavor: "We can forgive a man for making a useful thing as long as he does not admire it. The only excuse for making a useless thing is that one admires it intensely." -Oscar Wilde

cards.name: Chatterjee University
cards.text:
[click]: Place 1 power counter on Chatterjee University.
[click]: Install a program from your grip, lowering the install cost by 1 for each power counter on Chatterjee University. Remove 1 hosted power counter.
cards.flavor: Legions of software engineers have been manufactured within its halls.

cards.name: Dedication Ceremony
cards.text: Place 3 advancement tokens on a faceup card. You cannot score that card until your next turn begins.
cards.flavor: "Never cut the ribbon until you have something to show off." -Eta Shah, VP Global Expansion

cards.name: Heritage Committee
cards.text: This card costs 0 influence if you have 6 or more non-alliance [jinteki] cards in your deck. Draw 3 cards. Add 1 card from HQ to the top of R&D.
cards.flavor: It is only by respecting the past that we can build a better future.

cards.name: High-Stakes Job
cards.text: Make a run on a server with at least 1 piece of unrezzed ice. When the run ends, gain 12[credit] if it was successful.

cards.name: Interrupt 0
cards.text: [subroutine] For the remainder of this run, as an additional cost to use an icebreaker ability to break subroutines, the Runner must pay 1[credit]. [subroutine] For the remainder of this run, as an additional cost to use an icebreaker ability to break subroutines, the Runner must pay 1[credit]

cards.name: Jesminder Sareen: Girl Behind the Curtain
cards.text: [interrupt] → The first time each run you would take 1 or more tags, prevent 1 tag.
cards.flavor: "Mirrormode on."

cards.name: Kala Ghoda Real TV
cards.text: When your turn begins, you may look at the top card of the stack. [trash]: The Runner trashes the top card of the stack.
cards.flavor: "A new property has two, maybe three hours. If it doesn't sell, cut it and move on."

cards.name: Maya
cards.text: +2[mu] Once per turn → When you finish accessing a card in R&D, you may add that card to the bottom of R&D. If you do, take 1 tag. Limit 1 console per player.

cards.name: Mongoose
cards.text: You cannot use this program to break subroutines on more than one ice per run. Interface → 1[credit]: Break up to 2 sentry subroutines. 2[credit]: +2 strength.
cards.flavor: It is the hardest thing in the world to frighten a mongoose, because he is eaten up from nose to tail with curiosity. The motto of all the mongoose family is "Run and find out". -Rudyard Kipling, Rikki-Tikki-Tavi

cards.name: Mumba Temple
cards.text:
This card costs 0 influence if you have 15 or fewer ice in your deck.
2[recurring-credit]
Use these credits to rez cards.
cards.flavor: Those who are the wisest know the least.

cards.name: Mumbad City Grid
cards.text: Whenever the Runner passes a piece of ice protecting this server, you may swap that ice with another piece of ice protecting this server. Limit 1 region per server.

cards.name: Museum of History
cards.text:
This asset costs 0 influence if you have 50 or more cards in your deck.
When your turn begins, you may shuffle 1 card from Archives into R&D.
cards.flavor: "And here we see the Polar Bear, once the largest land carnivore on Earth."

cards.name: Panchatantra
cards.text: Once per turn → When you encounter a piece of ice, you may choose 1 subtype that is not barrier, code gate, or sentry. That ice gains the chosen subtype for the remainder of this run.
cards.flavor: "The basics should be like the stories you learned as a child—unconscious, never forgotten, and suddenly relevant at the most random times." -g00ru

cards.name: Ramujan-reliant 550 BMI
cards.text: [interrupt] → [trash]: Prevent up to X core damage or net damage. Trash cards from the top of your stack equal to the amount of damage prevented. X is equal to the number of other installed copies of Ramujan-reliant 550 BMI plus 1. Limit 6 per deck.

cards.name: Run Amok
cards.text: Make a run. When the run ends, trash 1 piece of ice that was rezzed during this run.
cards.flavor: "While there have been other anti-corporation movements before, like the Maroon Wave, this new one is different. It's organized." -Ramesh Gupta, One World Economy

cards.name: Street Magic
cards.text: Unbroken subroutines resolve in the order of your choice.
cards.flavor: The greatest trick is not the trick itself, but in making someone believe that it is no trick at all. To your average sysop, it's magic. To your average runner, it's a closely held trade secret.

cards.name: Vikram 1.0
cards.text: Lose [click]: Break 1 subroutine on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability. [subroutine] The Runner cannot use programs for the remainder of this run. [subroutine] Trace[4]. If successful, do 1 core damage. [subroutine] Trace[4]. If successful, do 1 core damage.

cards.name: Advanced Assembly Lines
cards.text:
When you rez Advanced Assembly Lines, gain 3[credit].
[trash]: Install a non-agenda card from HQ (paying the install cost). You cannot use this ability during a run.

cards.name: CBI Raid
cards.text: Run HQ. If successful, instead of breaching HQ, the Corp adds all cards in HQ to the top of R&D in the order of their choice.
cards.flavor: Designed by 2013 World Champion Jens Erickson

cards.name: Corporate Sales Team
cards.text:
When you score Corporate Sales Team, place 10[credit] on it.
When each player's turn begins, take 1[credit] from Corporate Sales Team.
cards.flavor: "You got it. We sell it. They buy it. Everyone wins."

cards.name: Corporate Scandal
cards.text: This event is not trashed until another current is played or an agenda is scored. The Corp is considered to have 1 additional bad publicity (even if they had no bad publicity).
cards.flavor: "We may be outraged, but we're not surprised." -Sunder

cards.name: Disposable HQ
cards.text:
While the Runner is accessing this upgrade in R&D, they must reveal it.
When the Runner accesses this upgrade, you may add any number of cards from HQ to the bottom of R&D.

cards.name: Diwan
cards.text:
When you install this program, choose a server. As an additional cost to install a card in the root of or protecting that server, the Corp must pay 1[credit].
When the Corp purges virus counters, trash this program.

cards.name: EMP Device
cards.text: [trash]: The Corp cannot rez more than 1 piece of ice for the remainder of this run. Use this ability only during a run.
cards.flavor: "No! Don't set that off HERE!"

cards.name: Harvester
cards.text:
[subroutine] The Runner draws 3 cards and then discards down to their maximum hand size.
[subroutine] The Runner draws 3 cards and then discards down to their maximum hand size.
cards.flavor: "We can help others, yet also help ourselves." -Soraiya Suresh, VP Public Programs

cards.name: Lakshmi Smartfabrics
cards.text: Whenever you rez a card, place 1 power counter on Lakshmi Smartfabrics. X hosted power counters: Reveal an agenda worth X points from HQ. The Runner cannot steal copies of that agenda for the remainder of this turn.

cards.name: Mumbad Construction Co.
cards.text:
When your turn begins, place 1 advancement token on Mumbad Construction Co.
2[credit]: Move 1 advancement token from Mumbad Construction Co. to a faceup card.

cards.name: NetChip
cards.text:
NetChip can host a program with a memory cost less than or equal to the number of copies of NetChip installed. The memory cost of the hosted program does not count against your memory limit.
Limit 6 per deck.

cards.name: New Construction
cards.text: Install only faceup. (This agenda is neither rezzed nor unrezzed.) Whenever you advance this agenda, you may install 1 card from HQ in the root of a new server. If there are 5 or more hosted advancement counters, rez that card, ignoring all costs.

cards.name: PAD Factory
cards.text:
This card costs 0 influence if you have 3 PAD Campaigns in your deck.
[click]: Place 1 advancement token on a card. You cannot score that card until your next turn begins.

cards.name: Populist Rally
cards.text: Play only if you have a seedy card installed. The Corp gets -1 allotted [click] for their next turn.
cards.flavor: "The corporations may be stronger than any of us, but they are not stronger than all of us." -Akshara Sareen

cards.name: Product Recall
cards.text: This card costs 0 influence if you have 6 or more non-alliance [haas-bioroid] cards in your deck. Trash a rezzed asset or upgrade. If you do, gain credits equal to its trash cost.

cards.name: Pālanā Agroplex
cards.text: When your turn begins, each player draws 1 card.
cards.flavor: Expensive to build but dramatically more efficient than traditional farming, agroplexes are emblems of the inevitable corporatization of the food industry.

cards.name: Pālanā Foods: Sustainable Growth
cards.text: The first time each turn the Runner draws a card, gain 1[credit].
cards.flavor: We Are What We Eat.

cards.name: Remote Data Farm
cards.text: Your maximum hand size is increased by 2.
cards.flavor: Data, not food, is one of the biggest exports from the Gujarat district of Mumbad.

cards.name: Tech Trader
cards.text: Whenever you use a [trash] ability, gain 1[credit].
cards.flavor: "Why would you dispose of perfectly good evidence when you can sell it?"

cards.name: "Clones are not People"
cards.text: This card is not trashed until another current is played or an agenda is stolen. When you score an agenda, add "Clones are not People" to your score area as an agenda worth 1 agenda point.

cards.name: "Freedom Through Equality"
cards.text: This card is not trashed until another current is played or an agenda is scored. When you steal an agenda, add "Freedom Through Equality" to your score area as an agenda worth 1 agenda point.

cards.name: Akshara Sareen
cards.text: Each player gets +1 allotted [click] for each of their turns.
cards.flavor: "Our shared humanity is our greatest strength. And as we share more broadly, our strength grows, not dwindles."

cards.name: Bailiff
cards.text:
Whenever the Runner breaks a subroutine on Bailiff, gain 1[credit].
[subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor: Efficiency means profiting from things everyone was doing anyway.

cards.name: Bio-Ethics Association
cards.text: When your turn begins, do 1 net damage if there is no ice protecting this server.
cards.flavor: "There's no conflict of interest here. These are complex issues with highly technical minutiae. It's only natural that the experts should lay down the guidelines."

cards.name: Clone Suffrage Movement
cards.text: When your turn begins, you may add 1 operation from Archives to HQ if there is no ice protecting this server.
cards.flavor: "Our research says the public views clones as more human than bioroids. Historically, this has been a liability. Let's make it a strength."

cards.name: Commercial Bankers Group
cards.text: When your turn begins, gain 3[credit] if there is no ice protecting this server.
cards.flavor: "Money is speech and I am listening intently." -Krishnan Sareen

cards.name: Councilman
cards.text: Whenever the Corp rezzes an asset or upgrade, you may pay credits equal to its rez cost and trash Councilman. If you do, derez that asset or upgrade. The Corp cannot rez it for the remainder of this turn.
cards.flavor: "Bureaucracy and red tape have been weaponized." -Fake-ir

cards.name: Mumbad City Hall
cards.text: [click]: Search R&D for an alliance card, reveal it, and play or install it (paying all costs). Shuffle R&D.
cards.flavor: Mumbad's public city corporation is tightly connected to all the other corporations.

cards.name: Nero Severn: Information Broker
cards.text: Once per turn → When you encounter a sentry, you may jack out.
cards.flavor: "Credits spend anywhere in the worlds, but there are other forms of currency."

cards.name: Political Dealings
cards.text: Whenever you draw an agenda, you may reveal and install it.
cards.flavor: "Politics is a dirty business. But so is business." -Krishnan Sareen

cards.name: Political Graffiti
cards.text: Run Archives. If successful, instead of breaching Archives, host this event on an agenda in the Corp's score area as a condition counter with "Host agenda is worth 1 less agenda point. When the Corp purges virus counters, trash this counter."

cards.name: Political Operative
cards.text: Install only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. [trash], X[credit]: Trash 1 rezzed card with trash cost equal to X.
cards.flavor: Leverage, secrets, access, and influence are currency as valuable as credits. But credits work, too.

cards.name: Reflection
cards.text: +1[mu] +1[link] Whenever you jack out, the Corp reveals 1 card from HQ at random. Limit 1 console per player.
cards.flavor: "I'm on a need-to-know basis. I need to know everything." -Nero Severn

cards.name: Sadyojata
cards.text: Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 subroutine on a piece of ice with 3 or more subtypes. 1[credit]: +1 strength. 2[credit]: Swap this program with a deva program from your grip.
cards.flavor: The Creator.

cards.name: Sensie Actors Union
cards.text: When your turn begins, you may draw 3 cards if there is no ice protecting this server. If you do, add 1 card from HQ to the bottom of R&D.
cards.flavor: Being a Mumbad sensie star means a glamorous life, though it is lived in constant fear of blackmail-or worse-from orgcrime.

cards.name: Spy Camera
cards.text:
[click]: Look at the top X cards of your stack and arrange them in any order. X is the number of copies of Spy Camera installed.
[trash]: Look at the top card of R&D.
Limit 6 per deck.

cards.name: Surat City Grid
cards.text: Whenever you rez another card in the root of or protecting this server, you may rez 1 card, paying 2[credit] less. Limit 1 region per server.
cards.flavor: The political centre of Mumbad.

cards.name: Voting Machine Initiative
cards.text:
Place 3 agenda counters on Voting Machine Initiative when you score it.
When the Runner's turn begins, you may spend 1 hosted agenda counter. If you do, the Runner loses [click], if able.

cards.name: Aryabhata Tech
cards.text: Whenever there is a successful trace, gain 1[credit] and the Runner loses 1[credit].
cards.flavor: "As the world shrinks, communications becomes the most essential technology." -Ramesh Gupta, One World Economy

cards.name: Bazaar
cards.text: Whenever you install a piece of hardware from your grip, you may install another copy of that hardware from your grip (paying all costs).
cards.flavor: In these days of digital full-sim browsing and widely available nano-assembly, it takes a special kind of crazy person to go shopping in meatspace. There are millions of them.

cards.name: Brahman
cards.text: Interface → 1[credit]: Break up to 2 subroutines. 2[credit]: +1 strength. Whenever an encounter ends, if you used this program to break a subroutine during that encounter, add 1 installed non-virus program to the top of your stack.

cards.name: Cobra
cards.text:
[subroutine] Trash 1 program.
[subroutine] Do 2 net damage.
cards.flavor: The naja naja is the king of all serpents.

cards.name: Exclusive Party
cards.text:
Draw 1 card. Gain 1[credit] for each copy of Exclusive Party in your heap.
Limit 6 per deck.
cards.flavor: The more parties she attended, the more they trusted her. The more they trusted her, the more entertaining her scams became.

cards.name: Executive Search Firm
cards.text: This card costs 0 influence if you have 6 or more non-alliance [weyland-consortium] cards in your deck. [click]: Search R&D for an executive, sysop, or character, reveal it, and add it to HQ. Shuffle R&D.

cards.name: Indian Union Stock Exchange
cards.text: Whenever you rez or play an out-of-faction card (including Indian Union Stock Exchange), gain 1[credit].
cards.flavor: "Wealth wisely invested is wealth earned." -The New Gospel of Wealth

cards.name: Jeeves Model Bioroids
cards.text: This card costs 0 influence if you have 6 or more non-alliance [haas-bioroid] cards in your deck. The first time you spend 3[click] on the same action each turn, gain [click].
cards.flavor: "Very good, sir."

cards.name: Localized Product Line
cards.text: Search R&D for any number of copies of a card, reveal them, and add them to HQ. Shuffle R&D.
cards.flavor: It's the exact same coffee, but the price sure is different.

cards.name: Making an Entrance
cards.text:
Play only as your first [click].
Look at the top 6 cards of your stack. You may trash any of those cards and arrange the rest in any order.
cards.flavor: Sometimes in an instant you realize who your friends really are.

cards.name: Mumbad Virtual Tour
cards.text:
This upgrade costs 0 influence if you have 7 or more assets in your deck.
When the Runner accesses this upgrade while it is installed, they must trash it, if able.

cards.name: Patron
cards.text:
When your turn begins, you may choose a server.
The first time each turn you make a successful run on the chosen server, instead of breaching it, draw 2 cards.
cards.flavor: "Anyone who can afford dwarf elephants can afford to be my friend." -Fake-ir

cards.name: Personality Profiles
cards.text: Whenever the Runner searches the stack or installs a card from the heap, they trash 1 card from the grip at random.

cards.name: Raman Rai
cards.text: This asset costs 0 influence if you have 6 or more non-alliance [jinteki] cards in your deck. Once per turn → When you draw a card, you may lose [click]. If you do, reveal that card and 1 card in Archives of the same type. Swap those cards.

cards.name: Salem's Hospitality
cards.text: This operation costs 0 influence if you have 6 or more non-alliance [nbn] cards in your deck. Choose a card name. The Runner reveals the grip and trashes all cards with the chosen name revealed this way.

cards.name: Salsette Slums
cards.text: Access, once per turn → Pay the trash cost of the card you are accessing: Remove that card from the game.
cards.flavor: "Underestimate those people at your own peril." -Akshara Sareen

cards.name: Sports Hopper
cards.text:
+1[link]
[trash]: Draw 3 cards.
cards.flavor: "Check out my new ride." -2xTiger

cards.name: Upayoga
cards.text: [subroutine] You and the Runner secretly spend 0[credit], 1[credit], or 2[credit]. Reveal spent credits. If you and the Runner spent a different number of credits, the Runner loses 2[credit]. [subroutine] Resolve a subroutine on a piece of rezzed psi ice.
cards.flavor: "Connect two truths. Connect two programs. All is one."

cards.name: Vamadeva
cards.text: Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 subroutine on a piece of ice with exactly 1 subroutine. 1[credit]: +1 strength. 2[credit]: Swap this program with a deva program from your grip.
cards.flavor: The Preserver.

cards.name: Brainstorm
cards.text: When the Runner encounters this ice, it gains X "[subroutine] Do 1 core damage." subroutines for the remainder of this run. X is equal to the number of cards in the grip.
cards.flavor:
has anyone heard from StatiX lately?
-post on Members Only newsgroup

cards.name: Chetana
cards.text:
[subroutine] Each player gains 2[credit].
[subroutine] You and the Runner secretly spend 0[credit], 1[credit], or 2[credit]. Reveal spent credits. If you and the Runner spent a different number of credits, do 1 net damage for each card in the Runner's grip.
cards.flavor: "Feel your consciousness expand and touch his. Now destroy it."

cards.name: Consulting Visit
cards.text: This card costs 0 influence if you have 6 or more non-alliance [weyland-consortium] cards in your deck. As an additional cost to play this operation, spend [click]. Search R&D for an operation and play it (paying all costs). Shuffle R&D.

cards.name: Dedicated Neural Net
cards.text: The first time there is a successful run on HQ each turn, you and the Runner secretly spend 0[credit], 1[credit], or 2[credit]. Reveal spent credits. If you and the Runner spent a different number of credits, you choose which cards the Runner accesses from HQ for the remainder of this run.

cards.name: Emptied Mind
cards.text: When your turn begins, gain [click] if you have no cards in your grip.
cards.flavor:
"They cloak themselves in our shared heritage, in the wisdom of our religions, but make no mistake: they are terrorists and criminals."
-Inspector Lakhani, Cybercrimes Division

cards.name: Exchange of Information
cards.text:
Play only if the Runner is tagged.
Swap an agenda in your score area with an agenda in the Runner's score area.

cards.name: Guru Davinder
cards.text:
[interrupt] → Whenever you would take net or meat damage, prevent all of that damage.
Whenever this resource prevents 1 or more damage, trash it unless you pay 4[credit].
cards.flavor: "This body that we inhabit is fleeting. We, all of us, can live forever."

cards.name: Information Sifting
cards.text: Run HQ. If successful, instead of breaching HQ, the Corp separates all cards in HQ into 2 facedown piles. Choose 1 of the piles. Access each card in the chosen pile.

cards.name: Liberated Chela
cards.text: [click][click][click][click][click], forfeit an agenda: The Corp may forfeit an agenda to remove this resource from the game. If they do not, add this resource to your score area as an agenda worth 2 agenda points.
cards.flavor: "Let go your material attachments and realize that we are all immaterial."

cards.name: Out of the Ashes
cards.text:
Make a run.
When your turn begins, if Out of the Ashes is in your heap, you may remove it from the game to make a run.
Limit 6 per deck.

cards.name: Puppet Master
cards.text: Whenever the Runner makes a successful run, you may place 1 advancement token on a card that can be advanced.

cards.name: Ravana 1.0
cards.text: Lose [click]: Break 1 subroutine on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability. [subroutine] Resolve 1 subroutine on another rezzed bioroid ice. [subroutine] Resolve 1 subroutine on another rezzed bioroid ice.

cards.name: Rebirth
cards.text:
Switch your identity with another identity from the same faction. Remove Rebirth from the game instead of trashing it.
Limit 1 per deck.
cards.flavor: "Who were you when you realized everything you knew was a lie?"

cards.name: Red Tape
cards.text: [subroutine] All ice has +3 strength for the remainder of this run.
cards.flavor:
Bureaucracy. Noun. A shell-game played by the rich with prosperity as the ball. The trick is that there is no ball.
-The Anarch's Dictionary, Volume Who's Counting?

cards.name: Temple of the Liberated Mind
cards.text: [click]: Place 1 power counter on this resource. Once per turn → Hosted power counter: Gain [click]. Use this ability only during your turn.
cards.flavor: It is rumored that g00ru himself studied at the temple, applying its teachings to cyberspace. Many runners have followed in his path, but none have reached its end.

cards.name: The Noble Path
cards.text: Trash all cards from your grip. Run any server. Whenever you would take damage during that run, prevent all of that damage.
cards.flavor:
"He with nothing to lose has strength beyond imagining."
-The Saffron Sutra

cards.name: The Turning Wheel
cards.text: Whenever a run on HQ or R&D ends, place 1 power counter on this resource if you stole no agendas during that run. 2 hosted power counters: Choose HQ or R&D. For the remainder of this run, access 1 additional card whenever you breach that server.

cards.name: Vanilla
cards.text: [subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor: A brand new invention.

cards.name: Waiver
cards.text: [subroutine] Trace[5]. If successful, the Runner reveals the grip. Trash each card revealed this way with a play or install cost of X or less. X is equal to the amount by which your trace strength exceeded the Runner's link strength.
cards.flavor: "It's amazing how small we can write the fine print these days."

cards.name: Aghora
cards.text: Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 subroutine on a piece of ice that has a rez cost of 5 or greater. 1[credit]: +1 strength. 2[credit]: Swap this program with a deva program from your grip.
cards.flavor: The Destroyer.

cards.name: Ankusa
cards.text: Whenever this program fully breaks a barrier, add that barrier to HQ. Interface → 2[credit]: Break 1 barrier subroutine. 1[credit]: +1 strength.

cards.name: Bhagat
cards.text: The first time you make a successful run on HQ each turn, force the Corp to trash the top card of R&D.
cards.flavor: "They don't want to listen, so we'll just have to crank up the volume."

cards.name: Election Day
cards.text: Trash all cards in HQ (minimum of 1). Draw 5 cards.
cards.flavor: "A new administration means we have to start greasing the wheels all over again. Let's get to work."

cards.name: Fear the Masses
cards.text:
Run HQ. If successful, instead of breaching HQ, reveal any number of copies of Fear the Masses from your grip. The Corp trashes X cards from the top of R&D, where X is equal to 1 plus the number of cards you revealed.
Limit 6 per deck.

cards.name: Full Immersion RecStudio
cards.text:
Full Immersion RecStudio can host up to 2 assets and/or agendas.
The trash cost of Full Immersion RecStudio is increased by 3 for each card hosted on it.
cards.flavor: The costumes aren't strictly necessary, but they improve the performances of the vactors and sensie stars.

cards.name: Harishchandra Ent.: Where You're the Star
cards.text: While the Runner is tagged, they play with the grip revealed.
cards.flavor: We Know What You Want.

cards.name: Ibrahim Salem
cards.text: This card costs 0 influence if you have 6 or more non-alliance [nbn] cards in your deck. As an additional cost to rez Ibrahim Salem, forfeit an agenda. When your turn begins, name a card type. Look at the Runner's grip and trash 1 card in it of the named type.

cards.name: Improved Protein Source
cards.text: When Improved Protein Source is scored or stolen, the Runner gains 4[credit].
cards.flavor: They eat us, we eat them, the cycle goes on and on. -Omar Keung, "the Flashpoint"

cards.name: Lateral Growth
cards.text: Gain 4[credit]. You may install 1 card (paying the install cost).
cards.flavor: "Practical effects are expensive, but worth it. I had to smash seventeen stunt bioroids to get this shot." -Parvati Kapoor, director

cards.name: Magnet
cards.text:
When you rez this ice, choose 1 installed program hosted on a piece of ice. Host that program on this ice.
Each hosted program loses all abilities and cannot gain abilities.
[subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor: "When the enemy has mastered the battlefield, change the battlefield." -The Playbook

cards.name: Merger
cards.text: Merger is worth 1 additional agenda point while in the Runner's score area.
cards.flavor: Survival of the fittest' is so outdated; in finance it's 'survival of the fattest.' -Omar Keung, "the Flashpoint"

cards.name: Navi Mumbai City Grid
cards.text: During runs on this server, the Runner cannot use paid abilities on their installed cards except for mid-access abilities and abilities on icebreakers. Limit 1 region per server.
cards.flavor: The entertainment capital of Mumbad.

cards.name: Rigged Results
cards.text: Secretly spend up to 2[credit]. The Corp guesses how much you spent. Reveal spent credits. If the Corp guessed incorrectly, choose a piece of ice protecting a server and run that server. The first time during this run you encounter the chosen ice, bypass it.

cards.name: Subcontract
cards.text:
Play only if the Runner is tagged.
Play up to 2 operations from HQ (paying all costs), resolving them one at a time.
cards.flavor: Judicious use of freelancers can increase efficiency and protect the company from legal repercussions. It's what they call a "win-win".

cards.name: The Black File
cards.text:
The Corp cannot win the game except if you are flatlined.
When your turn begins, place 1 power counter on this resource. If there are 3 or more hosted power counters, remove this resource from the game.
Limit 1 per deck.

cards.name: The Price of Freedom
cards.text: As an additional cost to play this event, trash 1 installed connection resource. The Corp cannot advance cards during their next turn. Remove this event from the game.

cards.name: Voter Intimidation
cards.text:
Play only if there is an agenda in the Runner's score area.
You and the Runner secretly spend 0[credit], 1[credit], or 2[credit]. Reveal spent credits. If you and the Runner spent a different number of credits, trash 1 resource.

cards.name: Zealous Judge
cards.text:
Zealous Judge can only be rezzed if the Runner is tagged.
[click], 1[credit]: Give the Runner 1 tag.

cards.name: Another Day, Another Paycheck
cards.text: This card is not trashed until another current is played or an agenda is scored. Whenever you steal an agenda, force the Corp to "Trace[0]. If unsuccessful, the Runner gains credits equal to the number of agenda points in both players' score areas."

cards.name: Chrysalis
cards.text:
While the Runner is accessing this ice in R&D, they must reveal it.
When the Runner accesses this ice anywhere except in Archives, they encounter it.
[subroutine] Do 2 net damage.

cards.name: Crisis Management
cards.text: If the Runner is tagged, Crisis Management gains "When your turn begins, do 1 meat damage."
cards.flavor: "For the duration of the emergency" is code for "this is the way things are now."

cards.name: Dai V
cards.text: Interface → 2[credit]: Break all subroutines. Spend credits only from stealth cards to use this ability. 1[credit]: +1 strength.
cards.flavor: In running, as in reality, all elements are connected.

cards.name: Deuces Wild
cards.text:
Resolve two of the following in any order:
  • Gain 3[credit].
  • Draw 2 cards.
  • Remove 1 tag.
  • Expose 1 piece of ice, then make a run.
cards.flavor: Designed by 2014 World Champion Dan D'Argenio

cards.name: Fairchild 1.0
cards.text: Lose [click]: Break 1 subroutine on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability. [subroutine] The Runner must pay 1[credit] or trash 1 of their installed cards. [subroutine] The Runner must pay 1[credit] or trash 1 of their installed cards.
cards.flavor: I foresee the end of all things...

cards.name: GPI Net Tap
cards.text: Whenever you approach a piece of ice, you may expose it. You may then trash GPI Net Tap to jack out.
cards.flavor: Sometimes the itsy-bitsy data is most important.

cards.name: Georgia Emelyov
cards.text:
Whenever the Runner makes an unsuccessful run on this server, do 1 net damage.
2[credit]: Move Georgia Emelyov to another server.
cards.flavor: "Your mistake is thinking that it's just business, when really it's a war."

cards.name: Hard-Hitting News
cards.text:
After you resolve this operation, your action phase ends.
Play only if the Runner made a run during their last turn.
Trace[4]. If successful, give the Runner 4 tags.

cards.name: Hernando Cortez
cards.text: If the Corp has at least 10[credit], as an additional cost to rez each piece of ice, the Corp must spend credits equal to the number of subroutines on that ice.
cards.flavor: "Take it from me, there is a point where you have so much money you stop caring. That's usually right before it all comes tumbling down."

cards.name: Hyoubu Research Facility
cards.text: The first time each turn you reveal secretly spent credits, gain that many credits.
cards.flavor: "I'm telling you, free up the emergency accounts. Something's coming; I haven't seen a reaction like that since the tsunami. My god, the screaming..."

cards.name: Injection Attack
cards.text: Choose 1 installed icebreaker and run any server. During that run, the chosen icebreaker gets +2 strength.
cards.flavor: They call it "running" because jacking in is mentally and physically exhausting.

cards.name: Mirror
cards.text: +2[mu] Whenever you make a successful run on R&D, you may replace 1 spent recurring credit. Limit 1 console per player.

cards.name: NBN: Controlling the Message
cards.text: The first time the Runner trashes an installed Corp card each turn, you may trace[4]. If successful, give the Runner 1 tag (cannot be avoided).

cards.name: Null: Whistleblower
cards.text: Once per turn → When you encounter a piece of ice, you may trash 1 card from your grip. If you do, that ice gets –2 strength for the remainder of this run.

cards.name: Sandburg
cards.text: If you have at least 10[credit], each piece of ice has +1 strength for every 5[credit] in your credit pool.
cards.flavor: Money is power.

cards.name: Sherlock 2.0
cards.text: Lose [click][click]: Break up to 2 subroutines on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability. [subroutine] Trace[4].
