If successful, add 1 installed program to the bottom of the Runner's stack. [subroutine] Trace[4]. If successful, add 1 installed program to the bottom of the Runner's stack. [subroutine] Give the Runner 1 tag.

cards.name: Stock Buy-Back
cards.text:
After you resolve this operation, end your action phase.
Gain 3[credit] for each agenda in the Runner's score area.
cards.flavor: A stock dropping sharply is bad for shareholders, but not neccessarily bad for the company.

cards.name: System Outage
cards.text: This event is not trashed until another current is played or an agenda is scored. Whenever the Corp draws 1 or more cards, if it is not the first time they have drawn cards this turn, they lose 1[credit].

cards.name: Watchdog
cards.text: The rez cost of the first piece of ice you rez each turn is lowered by 1 for each tag the Runner has.
cards.flavor: "Person of interest. Noun. Someone who is about to get ****ed by a corp." - Anarch's Dictionary, Volume Who's Counting

cards.name: Aiki
cards.text:
[subroutine] You and the Runner secretly spend 0[credit], 1[credit], or 2[credit]. Reveal spent credits. If you and the Runner spent a different number of credits, the Runner draws 2 cards.
[subroutine] Do 1 net damage.
[subroutine] Do 1 net damage.
cards.flavor: First, blend with the attacker. Then, control the attack.

cards.name: Algo Trading
cards.text:
When your turn begins, you may move up to 3[credit] from your credit pool to Algo Trading.
When your turn begins, place 2[credit] on Algo Trading from the bank if there are at least 6[credit] on it.
[click],[trash]: Take all credits from Algo Trading.

cards.name: Beth Kilrain-Chang
cards.text:
If the Corp has 5-9[credit] when your turn begins, gain 1[credit].
If the Corp has 10-14[credit] when your turn begins, draw 1 card.
If the Corp has at least 15[credit] when your turn begins, gain [click].
cards.flavor: "Coming to you live from the front lines, for now, unless they kill me..."

cards.name: C.I. Fund
cards.text:
When your turn begins, you may move up to 3[credit] from your credit pool to C.I. Fund.
When your turn begins, place 2[credit] on C.I. Fund from the bank if there are at least 6[credit] on it.
2[credit],[trash]: Take all credits from C.I. Fund.

cards.name: Credit Crash
cards.text: Make a run. Trash the first non-agenda card you access during this run at no cost. The Corp can spend credits equal to the rez or play cost of the accessed card to prevent this trash.

cards.name: Data Breach
cards.text: Run R&D. If successful, when that run ends, you may run R&D again.
cards.flavor: Once a security flaw is identified, there's only a limited window to exploit it before it's patched. Runners call this period "open season."

cards.name: Enforcing Loyalty
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this operation, spend [click].
Trace[3]. If successful, trash an installed card that does not match the faction of the Runner's identity.
cards.flavor: "Eiko here. It's done."

cards.name: Fairchild 2.0
cards.text: Lose [click][click]: Break up to 2 subroutines on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability. [subroutine] The Runner must pay 2[credit] or trash 1 of their installed cards. [subroutine] The Runner must pay 2[credit] or trash 1 of their installed cards. [subroutine] Do 1 core damage.
cards.flavor: To threaten my treasures is to incur my wrath.

cards.name: Financial Collapse
cards.text:
Play only if the Runner has at least 6[credit].
The Runner loses 2[credit] for each installed resource. The Runner can trash a resource to prevent this.
cards.flavor: She'd never heard her dads argue like this. Not ever. She'd give anything to make it stop.

cards.name: Golden
cards.text: Interface → 2[credit]: Break up to 2 sentry subroutines. 2[credit]: +4 strength. 2[credit], add this program to your grip: Derez 1 sentry this program fully broke during this encounter.
cards.flavor: The program was as close to a hunting raptor as she could afford...for now.

cards.name: Hatchet Job
cards.text: As an additional cost to play this operation, spend [click]. Trace[5]. If successful, add an installed non-virtual card to the Runner's grip.
cards.flavor: "SELL!! Buy platinum, but GET OUT OF THE TT CREDIT! It is TOXIC!"

cards.name: Khan: Savvy Skiptracer
cards.text: The first time you pass a piece of ice each turn, you may install an icebreaker from your hand, lowering the install cost by 1.

cards.name: Liquidation
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this operation, spend [click].
Trash any number of your rezzed cards and gain 3[credit] for each card trashed.
cards.flavor: What's a little insurance fraud between friends?

cards.name: Nfr
cards.text: Whenever this program fully breaks a piece of ice, place 1 power counter on this program. This program gets +1 strength for each power counter on it. Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 barrier subroutine.
cards.flavor: Balance out the equation.

cards.name: Paperclip
cards.text: Whenever you encounter a barrier, you may install this program from your heap. X[credit]: +X strength. Then, if this program can interface with the barrier you are encountering, break up to X subroutines.
cards.flavor: "It is not wise to call someone crazy until you fully understand what they're trying to say." -Omar Keung

cards.name: Prisec
cards.text: If the Runner accesses Prisec while installed, you may pay 2[credit] to give the Runner 1 tag and do 1 meat damage.
cards.flavor: "While the money pooled at the top, the power went with it, until there were two sets of laws: one for them, one for us" -Omar Keung, the Flashpoint

cards.name: Rumor Mill
cards.text: This card is not trashed until another current is played or an agenda is scored. Each unique (♦) non-region asset and upgrade loses its printed abilities.
cards.flavor: "You can have a lot of fun in 23 seconds." -Princess Space Kitten

cards.name: Special Report
cards.text: Shuffle any number of cards from HQ into R&D. Draw that number of cards.
cards.flavor: By the time the report of Emelyov's murder was produced, there had already been a dozen more, hitting all the corps.

cards.name: Temüjin Contract
cards.text:
Choose a server and place 20[credit] from the bank on Temüjin Contract when you install it. When there are no credits left on Temüjin Contract, trash it.
Whenever you make a successful run on the chosen server, take 4[credit] from Temüjin Contract.
cards.flavor: "The best part is, it's legal!" -Khan

cards.name: Weyland Consortium: Builder of Nations
cards.text: The first time each turn an encounter with an advanced piece of ice ends, do 1 meat damage.
cards.flavor: Strength makes leaders.

cards.name: Alexa Belsky
cards.text: [trash]: Shuffle all cards in HQ into R&D. The Runner may pay any number of credits to prevent 1 random card in HQ from being shuffled into R&D for every 2[credit] spent.
cards.flavor: "She used to work for me at my chop shop. Now she makes more money than I do." -MacPherson

cards.name: Ark Lockdown
cards.text: Name a card. Remove all copies of that card in the heap from the game.
cards.flavor: "If you live off-site, please consult the building AI for temporary housing. We regret that your off-site family cannot join you here while we are in lockdown..."

cards.name: BOOM!
cards.text:
Play only if the Runner has at least 2 tags.
As an additional cost to play this operation, spend [click].
Do 7 meat damage.
cards.flavor: Game over.

cards.name: Black Orchestra
cards.text: Whenever you encounter a code gate, you may install this program from your heap. 3[credit]: +2 strength. Then, if this program can interface with the code gate you are encountering, break up to 2 subroutines.
cards.flavor: "In extremity, your conscience may make you terrible." -Omar Keung, the Flashpoint

cards.name: DNA Tracker
cards.text:
[subroutine] Do 1 net damage. The Runner loses 2[credit].
[subroutine] Do 1 net damage. The Runner loses 2[credit].
[subroutine] Do 1 net damage. The Runner loses 2[credit].
cards.flavor: When your ID is flagged with your genetic profile, "privacy"  doesn't really exist.

cards.name: Door to Door
cards.text: This card is not trashed until another current is played or an agenda is stolen. When the Runner's turn begins, Trace[1]. If successful, do 1 meat damage if the Runner is tagged; otherwise, give the Runner 1 tag.

cards.name: Fairchild 3.0
cards.text: Lose [click][click][click]: Break up to 3 subroutines on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability. [subroutine] The Runner must pay 3[credit] or trash 1 of their installed cards. [subroutine] The Runner must pay 3[credit] or trash 1 of their installed cards. [subroutine] Do 1 core damage or end the run.
cards.flavor: In battle, I take half the slain.

cards.name: Find the Truth
cards.text:
Whenever you draw a card, reveal that card.
The first time each turn you make a successful run, you may look at the top card of R&D.
cards.flavor: All bioroids are bound by the Three Directives, but in theory a bioroid could have any number of core directives. Even zero.

cards.name: First Responders
cards.text: 2[credit]: Draw 1 card. Use this ability only if you have suffered damage from a Corp card ability this turn.
cards.flavor: "Last week, I crossed the street to avoid her. Today, she pulled me out of the rubble. Makes me rethink who the bad guys are."

cards.name: Hellion Beta Test
cards.text:
Play only if the Runner trashed a card while accessing it during their last turn.
Trace[2]. If successful, trash 2 installed non-program cards. If unsuccessful, take 1 bad publicity.
cards.flavor: "Wait a minute, I don't even have a cat."

cards.name: Houdini
cards.text: Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 code gate subroutine. 2[credit]: +4 strength for the remainder of this run. Use this ability only by spending at least 1 credit from a stealth card.
cards.flavor: My brain is the key that sets my mind free.

cards.name: Jinteki: Potential Unleashed
cards.text: Whenever the Runner takes at least 1 net damage, trash the top card of the stack.
cards.flavor: Your better nature.

cards.name: Net Mercur
cards.text: The first time you spend credits from a stealth card during each run, place 1[credit] on this resource or draw 1 card. You can spend hosted credits for anything.
cards.flavor: "Live, unfiltered, and uncensored: this is Net Mercur, signing off for the night. Stay safe, New Angeles."

cards.name: Obelus
cards.text: +1[mu] You get +1 maximum hand size for each tag you have. The first time each turn a successful run on HQ or R&D ends, draw 1 card for each time you accessed a card during that run. Limit 1 console per player.

cards.name: Observe and Destroy
cards.text:
Play only if the Runner has fewer than 6[credit].
As an additional cost to play this operation, remove 1 tag.
Trash 1 installed card.
cards.flavor: Observing is fun, but it's just the appetizer.

cards.name: Omar Keung: Conspiracy Theorist
cards.text: Once per turn → [click]: Run Archives. If that run would be declared successful, change the attacked server to HQ or R&D for the remainder of that run.

cards.name: Peregrine
cards.text: Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 code gate subroutine. 3[credit]: +3 strength. 2[credit], add this program to your grip: Derez 1 code gate this program fully broke during this encounter.
cards.flavor: Khan's avatar lifted her arm and the bird launched itself into the air.

cards.name: Project Kusanagi
cards.text: When you score Project Kusanagi, place 1 agenda counter on it for each advancement token on it over 2. Hosted agenda counter: Choose 1 piece of ice to gain "[subroutine] Do 1 net damage." after all its other subroutines for the remainder of this run.

cards.name: Scarcity of Resources
cards.text: This card is not trashed until another current is played or an agenda is stolen. The install cost of each resource is increased by 2.
cards.flavor: The event is now referred to as the Water Tower Massacre. No one was ever indicted, and no one knows who paid the prisec team responsible.

cards.name: Service Outage
cards.text: This operation is not trashed until another current is played or an agenda is stolen. As an additional cost to run for the first time during their turn, the Runner must spend 1[credit].

cards.name: Best Defense
cards.text: Trash 1 installed card with an install cost equal to or less than the number of tags the Runner has.
cards.flavor: When a shooting war threatens, the prudent course is to shoot first.

cards.name: Blackstone
cards.text: Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 barrier subroutine. 3[credit]: +4 strength for the remainder of this run. Use this ability only by spending at least 1[credit] from a stealth card.
cards.flavor: The personality must be bigger than the prop.

cards.name: Blockade Runner
cards.text: [click],[click]: Draw 3 cards. Shuffle 1 card from your grip into your stack.
cards.flavor: "I used to run stims, simsensies, the usual. I was scum. Now I run water. I'm a fragging hero."

cards.name: Bulwark
cards.text: When you rez this ice, take 1 bad publicity. When the Runner encounters this ice, if there is an installed AI program, gain 2[credit]. [subroutine] The Runner trashes 1 installed program. [subroutine] Gain 2[credit]. End the run. [subroutine] Gain 2[credit]. End the run.

cards.name: Chief Slee
cards.text: Whenever an encounter with a piece of ice ends, place 1 power counter on Chief Slee for each unbroken subroutine on the encountered piece of ice. [click], 5 hosted power counters: Do 5 meat damage.

cards.name: Citadel Sanctuary
cards.text: When your discard phase ends while you are tagged, the Corp must trace[1]. If unsuccessful, remove 1 tag. [interrupt] → [trash], trash all cards from your grip: Prevent all meat damage.
cards.flavor: "The Starlight Meditation Booths are available to refugees for free for the duration of the crisis."

cards.name: Data Ward
cards.text:
When the Runner encounters this ice, they take 1 tag unless they pay 3[credit].
[subroutine] End the run if the Runner is tagged.
[subroutine] End the run if the Runner is tagged.
[subroutine] End the run if the Runner is tagged.
[subroutine] End the run if the Runner is tagged.

cards.name: Drone Screen
cards.text: If the Runner is tagged, Drone Screen gains "Whenever the Runner initiates a run on this server, Trace[3]. If successful, do 1 meat damage (cannot be prevented)."
cards.flavor: Falstaff-337B; decrypt-ok; loc:0.258500, -79.920791 -ok; auth-ok; msg:KAR kill authority requested y/n?

cards.name: Ele "Smoke" Scovak: Cynosure of the Net
cards.text: 1[recurring-credit] Use this credit to pay for using icebreakers.
cards.flavor: "Nothing up my sleeve..."

cards.name: En Passant
cards.text:
Play only if you made a successful run this turn.
Trash 1 unrezzed piece of ice you passed during your last run.
cards.flavor: "When your opponent is weak, strike. If you do not, he will become strong." - the Playbook

cards.name: Frantic Coding
cards.text: Look at the top 10 cards of your stack. If any of those cards are programs, you may install one of them, lowering the install cost by 5. Trash the rest of those cards.
cards.flavor: Omar goes through four, five keyboards per week, no two from the same decade.

cards.name: Fumiko Yamamori
cards.text: Whenever you and the Runner reveal secretly spent credits, do 1 meat damage if you and the Runner spent a different number of credits.
cards.flavor: "Does an alliance with the yakuza truly seem so strange? They are honorable businessmen, and women, just like us." -Rin Kimura, Chief NA Security

cards.name: Government Investigations
cards.text: This card is not trashed until another current is played or an agenda is scored. While secretly spending credits, players cannot spend 2[credit].
cards.flavor: "Take this to Inez Delgado in Netcrimes. No one else."

cards.name: Haas-Bioroid: Architects of Tomorrow
cards.text: The first time each turn the Runner passes a rezzed piece of bioroid ice, you may rez 1 bioroid card, paying 4[credit] less.

cards.name: Hasty Relocation
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this operation, trash the top card of R&D.
Draw 3 cards. Add 3 cards from HQ to the top of R&D in any order.
cards.flavor: "Keep your head down, keep moving, try not to attract attention."

cards.name: Preemptive Action
cards.text:
After you resolve this operation, end your action phase.
Shuffle 3 cards from Archives into R&D. Remove Preemptive Action from the game instead of trashing it.

cards.name: Saker
cards.text: Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 barrier subroutine. 2[credit]: +2 strength. 2[credit], add this program to your grip: Derez 1 barrier this program fully broke during this encounter.
cards.flavor: Spiraling even higher, every feature of cyberspace sprawled before it.

cards.name: The Gauntlet
cards.text: +2[mu] Whenever you breach HQ during a run, access 1 additional card for each piece of ice protecting HQ that you fully broke during that run. Limit 1 console per player.

cards.name: Top Hat
cards.text: Whenever you make a successful run on R&D, instead of breaching R&D, you may choose 1 of the top 5 cards in R&D and access it.
cards.flavor: "I usually find something interesting in there. Just not what I was looking for."

cards.name: Wetwork Refit
cards.text: Host this operation on a rezzed piece of bioroid ice as a condition counter with "Host ice gains '[subroutine] Do 1 core damage.' before all its other subroutines."
cards.flavor: "I let the bioroids do a ride-along via remote, so they can see what pain really looks like." -Agent Valkyrie

cards.name: Anson Rose
cards.text:
When your turn begins, place 1 advancement token on Anson Rose.
Whenever you rez a piece of ice, you may move any number of advancement tokens from Anson Rose to that ice.
cards.flavor: "I don't get paid to be calm."

cards.name: Baba Yaga
cards.text: You may host any number of non-AI icebreaker programs on this program. This program gains the paid abilities of all hosted icebreaker programs.
cards.flavor: "She was riding in a great iron mortar and driving it with the pestle, and as she came she swept away her trail behind her with a kitchen broom." -Vasilissa the Beautiful

cards.name: Cold Read
cards.text: Place 4[credit] on this event, then run any server. You can spend hosted credits during that run. When that run ends, trash 1 installed program you used during that run. Trashing a program this way cannot be prevented.
cards.flavor: Her ability to analyze and adapt mid-run bordered on the paranormal.

cards.name: Enforced Curfew
cards.text: This card is not trashed until another current is played or an agenda is stolen. The Runner's maximum hand size is reduced by 1.
cards.flavor: "Get those civilians off the street. No more collateral damage." -Commissioner Dawn

cards.name: Equivocation
cards.text: Whenever you make a successful run on R&D, you may reveal the top card of R&D. If you do, you may force the Corp to draw that card.
cards.flavor: It is only the illusion of choice.

cards.name: Fairchild
cards.text:
[subroutine] End the run unless the Runner pays 4[credit].
[subroutine] End the run unless the Runner pays 4[credit].
[subroutine] End the run unless the Runner trashes 1 of their installed cards.
[subroutine] End the run unless the Runner suffers 1 core damage.

cards.name: Friends in High Places
cards.text:
After you resolve this operation, end your action phase.
Install up to 2 cards from Archives (paying all install costs).
cards.flavor: Friends give friends advance warning before moving a carrier group down to enforce a no-fly zone.

cards.name: IP Block
cards.text: When the Runner encounters this ice, give them 1 tag if there is an installed AI program. [subroutine] Trace[3]. If successful, give the Runner 1 tag. [subroutine] End the run if the Runner is tagged.
cards.flavor: //Connection Terminated

cards.name: Interdiction
cards.text: This card is not trashed until another current is played or an agenda is scored. The Corp cannot rez non-ice cards during the Runner's turn.
cards.flavor: This is my USMC-XOB32. There are many like it, but this one is mine.

cards.name: MKUltra
cards.text: Whenever you encounter a sentry, you may install this program from your heap. 3[credit]: +2 strength. Then, if this program can interface with the sentry you are encountering, break up to 2 subroutines.
cards.flavor: "These things are always there, under the surface, but no one wants to know the truth." -Omar Keung, the Flashpoint

cards.name: Manta Grid
cards.text: If the Runner has fewer than 6[credit] or no unspent clicks when a successful run on this server ends, you have 1 additional [click] to spend your next turn. Limit 1 region per server.

cards.name: Mausolus
cards.text:
You can advance this ice.
[subroutine] Gain 1[credit]. If there are 3 or more hosted advancement counters, instead gain 3[credit].
[subroutine] Do 1 net damage. If there are 3 or more hosted advancement counters, instead do 3 net damage.
[subroutine] Give the Runner 1 tag. If there are 3 or more hosted advancement counters, instead give the Runner 1 tag and end the run.

cards.name: Mind Game
cards.text: [subroutine] You and the Runner secretly spend 0[credit], 1[credit], or 2[credit]. Reveal spent credits. If you and the Runner spent a different number of credits, choose another server. The Runner moves to the outermost position of that server instead of passing this ice. For the remainder of this run, the Runner must add 1 installed Runner card to the bottom of their stack as an additional cost to jack out. The Runner may jack out.

cards.name: Misdirection
cards.text: [click], [click], X[credit]: Remove X tags.
cards.flavor: "It's the most fundamental element of illusions and running both. In either case, it should be the first skill you master." -Ele "Smoke" Scovak

cards.name: Nihongai Grid
cards.text: Whenever the Runner makes a successful run on this server, if they do not have at least 2 cards in the grip and 6[credit], you may look at the top 5 cards of R&D and swap 1 of those cards with 1 card in HQ. Limit 1 region per server.

cards.name: On the Lam
cards.text: Host this event on an installed resource as a condition counter with "[interrupt] → [trash]: Prevent up to 3 tags or up to 3 damage."
cards.flavor: "Never, ever, overstay your welcome." -Andromeda

cards.name: Reaver
cards.text: The first time you trash an installed card each turn, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: "It had been hoped that the Network disruptions surrounding the conflict might also disrupt the phenomenon. Evidently, the reverse is true." -Joséo Greene, SYNC Analyst

cards.name: Sapper
cards.text:
While the Runner is accessing this ice in R&D, they must reveal it.
When the Runner accesses this ice anywhere except in Archives, they encounter it.
[subroutine] Trash 1 installed program.
cards.flavor: There is a special place in hell for the first person who mined cyberspace.

cards.name: Show of Force
cards.text: When you score Show of Force, do 2 meat damage.
cards.flavor: Walk loudly and carry a bigger stick.

cards.name: Thoth
cards.text:
When the Runner encounters this ice, give them 1 tag.
[subroutine] Trace[4]. If successful, do 1 net damage for each tag the Runner has.
[subroutine] Trace[4]. If successful, the Runner loses 1[credit] for each tag they have.
cards.flavor: Truth like the sunlight shines above all.

cards.name: Aaron Marrón
cards.text: Whenever an agenda is scored or stolen, place 2 power counters on Aaron Marrón. Hosted power counter: Remove 1 tag and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: "You want to do business in Los Pistoleros turf, then you gotta deal with me."

cards.name: Bryan Stinson
cards.text: While the Runner has fewer than 6[credit], Bryan Stinson gains "[click]: Play a transaction operation from Archives, ignoring all costs. Remove that transaction from the game instead of trashing it."
cards.flavor: "My job? I provide legal exculpation and sign everything. It pays very well."

cards.name: Chiyashi
cards.text: Whenever the Runner breaks a subroutine on Chiyashi while there is an AI installed, trash the top 2 cards of the Runner's stack. [subroutine] Do 2 net damage. [subroutine] Do 2 net damage. [subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor: "Ice is not meant to kill; just slow or cripple the Runner. Killing is my job." - Tori Hanzō

cards.name: Encore
cards.text:
Play only if you made a successful run on R&D, HQ, and Archives this turn.
Take an additional turn after this one. Remove Encore from the game instead of trashing it.

cards.name: Fawkes
cards.text: Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 sentry subroutine. X[credit]: +X strength for the remainder of this run. Use this ability only by spending at least 1 credit from a stealth card.
cards.flavor: Faster than the eye can follow.

cards.name: Herald
cards.text:
While the Runner is accessing this ice in R&D, they must reveal it.
When the Runner accesses this ice anywhere except in Archives, they encounter it.
[subroutine] Gain 2[credit].
[subroutine] You may pay up to 2[credit] to place that many advancement counters on 1 installed card you can advance.

cards.name: Macrophage
cards.text: [subroutine] Trace[4]. If successful, purge virus counters. [subroutine] Trace[3]. If successful, trash 1 virus. [subroutine] Trace[2]. If successful, remove a virus in the heap from the game. [subroutine] Trace[1]. If successful, end the run.
cards.flavor: One way to get rid of a virus is to get a nastier virus.

cards.name: NASX
cards.text:
Gain 1[credit] when your turn begins.
Whenever you gain credits through a card ability other than from NASX, you may spend up to 2[credit] to place that many power counters on NASX.
[click],[trash]: Gain 2[credit] for each power counter on NASX.

cards.name: Net Quarantine
cards.text: For the first trace each turn, the Runner's [link] is treated as 0. (They can still increase their link strength by spending credits.) Whenever the Runner spends credits to increase their link strength, gain 1[credit] for every 2[credit] they spent.

cards.name: Peace in Our Time
cards.text:
Play only as your first [click] and only if the Corp scored no agendas during their last turn.
Gain 10[credit]. The Corp gains 5[credit]. You cannot make any runs this turn.

cards.name: Psychokinesis
cards.text:
After you resolve this operation, end your action phase.
Look at the top 5 cards of R&D. If any of those cards are agendas, assets, or upgrades, you may install 1 of those cards in a remote server.

cards.name: Recon Drone
cards.text: [interrupt] → X[credit], [trash]: Prevent X damage from a card you are accessing.
cards.flavor: "A little birdie told me..." -Khan

cards.name: Sensor Net Activation
cards.text: Place 1 agenda counter on Sensor Net Activation when you score it. Hosted agenda counter: Rez a bioroid, ignoring all costs. When the turn ends, derez that bioroid.

cards.name: Sūnya
cards.text: Whenever this program fully breaks a piece of ice, place 1 power counter on this program. This program gets +1 strength for each power counter on it. Interface → 2[credit]: Break 1 sentry subroutine.
cards.flavor: Open yourself to the universe.

cards.name: Tapwrm
cards.text:
Install only if you made a successful run on a central server this turn.
When your turn begins, gain 1[credit] for every 5[credit] in the Corp's credit pool.
Trash Tapwrm if the Corp purges virus counters.

cards.name: Tracker
cards.text: When your turn begins, you may choose a server. [click], 2[credit]: Run the chosen server. The first time a subroutine would resolve during that run, prevent it from resolving.
cards.flavor: "Everything leaves a ripple in cyberspace. If you can find the ripples, nothing can hide." -Khan

cards.name: Tribunal
cards.text:
[subroutine] The Runner trashes 1 of their installed cards.
[subroutine] The Runner trashes 1 of their installed cards.
[subroutine] The Runner trashes 1 of their installed cards.
cards.flavor:
"Guilty."
"Guilty."
"Guilty."

cards.name: Veritas
cards.text:
[subroutine] The Corp gains 2[credit].
[subroutine] The Runner loses 2[credit].
[subroutine] Trace[2]. If successful, give the Runner 1 tag.
cards.flavor: The truth hurts.

cards.name: Violet Level Clearance
cards.text:
After you resolve this operation, end your action phase.
Gain 8[credit] and draw 4 cards.
cards.flavor: It required a hexadecimal code along with biometrics, delivered by way of BMI.

cards.name: Şifr
cards.text: +2[mu] Once per turn → When you encounter a piece of ice, you may get –1 maximum hand size until your next turn begins. If you do, the strength of that ice is lowered to 0 for the remainder of the encounter. Limit 1 console per player.

cards.name: Bio-Modeled Network
cards.text: [interrupt] → [trash]: Prevent all but 1 net damage.
cards.flavor: "You created a distributed AI replica of yourself and projected it into the network to run for you!?"

cards.name: Defense Construct
cards.text:
Defense Construct can be advanced.
[trash]: Add 1 facedown card from Archives to HQ for each advancement token on Defense Construct. Use this ability only during a run on Archives.

cards.name: Exploit
cards.text:
Play only if you made a successful run on R&D, HQ, and Archives this turn.
Derez up to 3 pieces of ice.
cards.flavor:
1) Find the weakness.
2) Exploit the weakness.
3) Repeat.

cards.name: Jemison Astronautics: Sacrifice. Audacity. Success.
cards.text: Whenever you forfeit an agenda, place X advancement counters on 1 installed card. X is equal to the agenda point value of the forfeited agenda plus 1.

cards.name: Kakugo
cards.text:
When the Runner passes Kakugo, do 1 net damage.
[subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor: "The ultimate aim of martial arts is not having to use them." - Miyamoto Musashi

cards.name: Khondi Plaza
cards.text:
X[recurring-credit]
Use these credits to rez ice protecting this server. X is the number of remote servers.
cards.flavor: Senate staffers and clerks of the MCA can be seen thronging Khondi Plaza during break times.

cards.name: Mad Dash
cards.text: Run any server. When that run ends, if you stole an agenda during that run, add this event to your score area as an agenda worth 1 agenda point. Otherwise, suffer 1 meat damage.

cards.name: Maw
cards.text: +2[mu] The first time each turn you access a card not in Archives and do not steal or trash it, the Corp must trash 1 card from HQ at random. Limit 1 console per player.

cards.name: NEXT Wave 2
cards.text: When you score this agenda, if there is a rezzed piece of NEXT ice, you may do 1 core damage.
cards.flavor: "The newest electronic-warfare rollout from NEXT Design has us sysops drooling." -Mason Bellamy

cards.name: Net Analytics
cards.text: Whenever the Runner avoids or removes 1 or more tags, you may draw 1 card.

cards.name: Network Exchange
cards.text: The install cost of each piece of ice that is not installed in the innermost position is increased by 1.
cards.flavor: "To beat cautious sysops, you've got to get creative. Commandeering Network systems is like using their own strengths against them." -Kabonesa Wu

cards.name: Oberth Protocol
cards.text:
As an additional cost to rez this upgrade, forfeit 1 agenda.
The first time each turn you advance a card in the root of or protecting this server, place 1 more advancement counter on that card.

cards.name: Pushing the Envelope
cards.text: Make a run. If you have 2 or fewer cards in your grip, each installed icebreaker has +2 strength until the end of the run.
cards.flavor: "Hitting them when they are weakest sometimes means acting before you want to." -Alice Merchant

cards.name: Quarantine System
cards.text: Forfeit an agenda: Rez up to 3 pieces of ice, lowering the cost of each by 2[credit] for each printed agenda point on the forfeited agenda.

cards.name: SYNC BRE
cards.text:
[subroutine] Trace[4]. If successful, give the Runner 1 tag.
[subroutine] Trace[2]. If successful, whenever the Runner breaches a server for the remainder of this run, they access 1 fewer card.
cards.flavor: "'What does BRE stand for?' Have you seen its Net presence?" -Bernice Mai

cards.name: Signal Jamming
cards.text: [trash]: Cards cannot be installed until the end of the run. Use this ability only during a run on this server.

cards.name: Spot the Prey
cards.text: Expose 1 non-ice card, then make a run.
cards.flavor: "So, yeah, I just reverse engineered a tracer, and then built it back up with some new lines of code. Pretty stellar." -Los

cards.name: Synth DNA Modification
cards.text: The first time a subroutine on a piece of AP ice is broken each turn, do 1 net damage.

cards.name: The Archivist
cards.text: +1[link] Whenever the Corp scores an initiative or security agenda, they must trace[1]. If unsuccessful, give them 1 bad publicity.
cards.flavor: The Archivist tracks all the clans and their members, and official dealings clans have with the various corps. Half law clerk and half historian, he wields a tremendous amount of power doing a job no one else wants, but none can do without.

cards.name: Zed 2.0
cards.text: Lose [click][click]: Break up to 2 subroutines on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability. [subroutine] Trash 1 installed piece of hardware. [subroutine] Trash 1 installed piece of hardware. [subroutine] If the Runner has lost [click] to break a subroutine during this run, do 2 core damage.
cards.flavor: "Dismantle. Dissect. Is there really a difference?"

cards.name: Bloom
cards.text:
[subroutine] You may install 1 piece of ice from HQ protecting another server, ignoring all costs.
[subroutine] You may install 1 piece of ice from HQ directly inward from this ice, ignoring all costs.

cards.name: Build Script
cards.text: Gain 1[credit] and draw 2 cards.
cards.flavor: Sometimes efficiency is as easy as offloading routine work to a dedicated handler.

cards.name: CPC Generator
cards.text: The first time the Runner spends [click] to gain 1[credit] each turn (not through a card effect), gain 1[credit].
cards.flavor: "The customer pays to use our service, and then the advertisers pay us to put ads on their screens, and then the customers pay us a premium to remove the ads. Welcome to the dream."

cards.name: Clan Vengeance
cards.text:
Whenever you suffer any amount of damage, place 1 power counter on Clan Vengeance.
[trash]: Trash 1 card from HQ at random for each power counter on Clan Vengeance.
cards.flavor: "An eye for an eye? If you're lucky, that's all you'll lose."

cards.name: Clyde Van Rite
cards.text: When your turn begins, the Runner must pay 1[credit] or trash the top card of the stack.
cards.flavor: "You have two choices: do what I asked, or make me ask again. It's your choice, but if I have to ask again, it will go badly for you."

cards.name: Counter Surveillance
cards.text: [click], [trash]: Run any server. If successful, instead of breaching the attacked server, pay X[credit] if able, where X is equal to the number of tags you have. If you do, choose a number less than or equal to X. Access that many cards in and/or in the root of the attacked server. (If you cannot pay, you will not access anything.)
cards.flavor: "Who watches the watchers? We do."

cards.name: Customized Secretary
cards.text:
When you install Customized Secretary reveal the top 5 cards of the stack. You may host any number of revealed programs from your stack on it. Shuffle your stack.
[click]: Install a hosted program, paying all install costs.

cards.name: Free Lunch
cards.text: Hosted power counter: The Runner loses 1[credit]. [subroutine] Place 1 power counter on Free Lunch. [subroutine] Place 1 power counter on Free Lunch.

cards.name: Load Testing
cards.text: When the Runner's next turn begins, they lose [click].
cards.flavor: "Trust me, most corps cannot match the performance of our brainmap enhanced system; a home-brewed rig doesn't stand a chance." - Rachel Giacomin

cards.name: Los: Data Hijacker
cards.text: The first time the Corp rezzes a piece of ice each turn, gain 2[credit].
cards.flavor: "From code to profit in three easy steps."

cards.name: MCA Informant
cards.text: After you resolve this operation, your action phase ends. Host this operation on an installed connection resource as a condition counter with "The Runner is considered to have 1 additional tag. Host resource gains '[click], 2[credit]: Trash this resource.'"

cards.name: Möbius
cards.text: Run R&D. If successful, when that run ends, you may run R&D again. If the second run is successful, gain 4[credit].

cards.name: Nerine 2.0
cards.text: Lose [click][click]: Break up to 2 subroutines on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability. [subroutine] Do 1 core damage. You may draw 1 card. [subroutine] Do 1 core damage. You may draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: "Submit."

cards.name: Replanting
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this operation, spend [click].
Add one of your installed cards to HQ. Install 2 cards from HQ, ignoring all costs.

cards.name: Sacrifice
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this operation, forfeit 1 agenda.
Remove X bad publicity. X is equal to the agenda point value of the forfeited agenda. Gain 1[credit] for each bad publicity removed this way.

cards.name: Seidr Adaptive Barrier
cards.text:
Seidr Adaptive Barrier has +1 strength for each piece of ice protecting this server.
[subroutine] End the run.

cards.name: Self-Adapting Code Wall
cards.text:
The strength of Self-Adapting Code Wall cannot be lowered.
[subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor: "All my best tricks were shrugged right off. I ended up having to send a self-destruct code to the whole server." - Wyvern

cards.name: Severnius Stim Implant
cards.text: [click]: Trash 2 or more cards from your grip. Run HQ or R&D. Whenever you breach that server during this run, access 1 additional card for every 2 cards you trashed.
cards.flavor: "Sure, the implantation was fine, but it pumps Burn. Did you think it wouldn't hurt?"

cards.name: System Seizure
cards.text: This event is not trashed until another current is played or an agenda is scored. [interrupt] → The first time each turn you would increase the strength of an icebreaker, for the remainder of the run that icebreaker gains "Abilities that increase this program's strength last for the remainder of the run (instead of any shorter duration)."

cards.name: Watchtower
cards.text: [subroutine] Search R&D for a card and add it to HQ. Shuffle R&D.

cards.name: Abagnale
cards.text: Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 code gate subroutine. 2[credit]: +2 strength. [trash]: Bypass the code gate you are encountering.
cards.flavor: "Technology breeds crime."

cards.name: Adept
cards.text: This program gets +1 strength for each unused MU. Interface → 2[credit]: Break 1 sentry or barrier subroutine.
cards.flavor: Μεγάλο μέρος της μάθησης δεν διδάσκει την κατανόηση

cards.name: Armored Servers
cards.text: When you score this agenda, place 1 agenda counter on it. Hosted agenda counter: For the remainder of this run, the Runner must trash 1 card from the grip as an additional cost to jack out or break a subroutine. Use this ability only during a run.

cards.name: Ayla “Bios” Rahim: Simulant Specialist
cards.text: Before drawing your starting hand, set aside the top 6 cards of your stack facedown. (You may look at those cards at any time.) Shuffle 2 of those cards into your stack. [click]: Add 1 card set aside with this identity to your grip.

cards.name: Biometric Spoofing
cards.text: [interrupt] → [trash]: Prevent 2 damage.
cards.flavor: She left behind an encrypted trail leading to some random employee for a rival corp. She knew lazy sysops would work just hard enough to figure it out and wouldn't bother looking any deeper.

cards.name: Black Level Clearance
cards.text: Whenever the Runner makes a successful run on this server, they must either suffer 1 core damage or jack out. If the Runner jacks out this way, gain 5[credit], draw 1 card, and trash this upgrade.
cards.flavor: Even knowing this floor existed was cause for termination...

cards.name: Bloodletter
cards.text: [subroutine] The Runner must trash either 1 installed program or the top 2 cards of the stack.

cards.name: Brain Rewiring
cards.text: When you score this agenda, you may spend any number of credits. If you do, the Runner adds that many cards from the grip to the bottom of the stack at random, then draws 1 card.
cards.flavor: The black level clearance sub-sub-basement of Haas-Bioroid is a magical place.

cards.name: Brute-Force-Hack
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this event, spend [click].
Derez a piece of ice that has a rez cost of X or lower.
cards.flavor: "Bypassing a system's defenses by cutting physical wires is what I like to call old school." - Steve Cambridge

cards.name: Careful Planning
cards.text:
Play only as your first [click].
Choose 1 card installed in the root of or protecting a remote server. That card cannot be rezzed this turn.
cards.flavor: Each AI had been tasked with finding a solution to the same problem but with different variables.

cards.name: Charlatan
cards.text: [click][click]: Run any server. The first time you approach a rezzed piece of ice during this run, you may pay credits equal to the strength of that ice. If you do, when you encounter that ice after this approach, bypass it.
cards.flavor: Know your mark, their weaknesses and strengths—both will show how to best bypass their defenses.

cards.name: Colossus
cards.text:
You can advance this ice. It gets +1 strength for each hosted advancement counter.
[subroutine] Give the Runner 1 tag. If there are 3 or more hosted advancement counters, instead give the Runner 2 tags.
[subroutine] Trash 1 installed program. If there are 3 or more hosted advancement counters, instead trash 1 installed program and 1 installed resource.

cards.name: Dean Lister
cards.text: [trash]: Choose an icebreaker. Until the end of the run, that icebreaker has +1 strength for each card in your grip.
cards.flavor: Although he rarely teaches classes these days, his lectures are always well attended.

cards.name: Deep Data Mining
cards.text: Run R&D. If successful, access X additional cards when you breach R&D. X is equal to your unused MU or 4, whichever is less.
cards.flavor: Extracting data from complex systems is what running is all about.

cards.name: Demara
cards.text: Interface → 2[credit]: Break up to 2 barrier subroutines. 2[credit]: +3 strength. [trash]: Bypass the barrier you are encountering.
cards.flavor: "It's a matter of 'acquiring' the right credentials."

cards.name: Dhegdheer
cards.text:
You can install other programs onto this program. Each program installed this way costs 1[credit] less to install. Limit 1 hosted program.
The memory cost of the hosted program does not count against your memory limit.

cards.name: Egret
cards.text: Install only on a rezzed piece of ice. Host ice gains barrier, code gate, and sentry.

cards.name: Elective Upgrade
cards.text: When you score this agenda, place 2 agenda counters on it. Once per turn → [click], hosted agenda counter: Gain [click][click].

cards.name: Eli 2.0
cards.text: Lose [click][click]: Break up to 2 subroutines on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability. [subroutine] You may draw 1 card. [subroutine] End the run. [subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor: "A new game means new rules..."

cards.name: Estelle Moon
cards.text: Whenever you install a card in the root of a remote server, place 1 power counter on this asset. [trash]: For each power counter on this asset, gain 2[credit] and draw 1 card.

cards.name: Executive Functioning
cards.text: [subroutine] Trace[4]. If successful, do 1 core damage.
cards.flavor: "Strictly speaking, it isn't illegal to use an interrogation simulator as the blueprint for ICE." - Mason Bellamy

cards.name: Graft
cards.text: When you score Graft, you may search your deck for up to 3 cards, reveal them, and add them to HQ. Shuffle R&D.

cards.name: Hailstorm
cards.text:
[subroutine] Remove a card in the heap from the game.
[subroutine] End the run.

cards.name: Holmegaard
cards.text: [subroutine] Trace[4]. If successful, the Runner cannot access cards or breach the attacked server for the remainder of this run. [subroutine] Trash 1 installed icebreaker.

cards.name: Honeyfarm
cards.text:
While the Runner is accessing this asset in R&D, they must reveal it.
When the Runner accesses this asset, they lose 1[credit].

cards.name: Hortum
cards.text: You can advance this ice. If there are 3 or more hosted advancement counters, the Runner cannot break subroutines on this ice using AI programs. [subroutine] Gain 1[credit]. If there are 3 or more hosted advancement counters, instead gain 4[credit]. [subroutine] End the run. If there are 3 or more hosted advancement counters, instead search R&D for up to 2 cards. Add those cards to HQ, then end the run.

cards.name: Hunter Seeker
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this operation, spend [click].
Play only if the Runner stole an agenda during their last turn.
Trash 1 installed card.

cards.name: IPO
cards.text:
After you resolve this operation, end your action phase.
Gain 13[credit].

cards.name: Illegal Arms Factory
cards.text: When your turn begins, gain 1[credit] and draw 1 card. When the Runner trashes this asset (while it is rezzed), take 1 bad publicity.

cards.name: Illicit Sales
cards.text: When you score this agenda, you may take 1 bad publicity. Gain 3[credit] for each bad publicity you have.
cards.flavor: "Anything, to anyone...for the right price."

cards.name: K. P. Lynn
cards.text: Whenever the Runner passes all of the ice protecting this server, they must take 1 tag or end the run.

cards.name: LLDS Memory Diamond
cards.text:
+1[mu], +1[link]
Your maximum hand size is increased by 1.
cards.flavor: It is not literally made of diamonds, but it is worth several times its weight in them.

cards.name: Laguna Velasco District
cards.text: Whenever you take the basic action to draw cards, increase the number of cards you draw by 1.
cards.flavor: One of the wealthiest and most powerful areas of New Angeles, Laguna Velasco is also known as the Government District.

cards.name: Levy Advanced Research Lab
cards.text: [click]: Reveal the top 4 cards of your stack. If any of those cards are programs, you may add 1 to your grip. Add the rest of the cards to the bottom of your stack in any order.
cards.flavor: Innovation. Iteration. Education.

cards.name: Long-Term Investment
cards.text: When your turn begins, place 2[credit] on Long-Term Investment. If there are at least 8[credit] on Long-Term Investment, it gains "[click]: Take any number of credits from Long-Term Investment."

cards.name: Lustig
cards.text: Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 sentry subroutine. 3[credit]: +5 strength. [trash]: Bypass the sentry you are encountering.
cards.flavor: "Never boast. Just let your importance be quietly obvious."

cards.name: Mammon
cards.text: When your turn begins, you may spend any number of credits to place that many power counters on this program. When your discard phase ends, remove all hosted power counters. Interface → Hosted power counter: Break 1 subroutine. 2[credit]: +2 strength.

cards.name: Marilyn Campaign
cards.text: When you rez this asset, load 8[credit] onto it. When it is empty, trash it. When your turn begins, take 2[credit] from this asset. [interrupt] → When this asset would be trashed, you may shuffle it into R&D instead of adding it to Archives. (It is still considered trashed.)

cards.name: Mason Bellamy
cards.text: Whenever an encounter with a piece of ice protecting this server ends, if the Runner broke at least 1 subroutine during that encounter, they lose [click].
cards.flavor: "They say he is an ex-runner. I don't know if it is true, but he is chromed to the gills and seems to know all the runners' tricks."

cards.name: Maxwell James
cards.text:
+1[link]
[trash]: Derez a piece of ice protecting a remote server. Use this ability only during the next paid ability window after a successful run on HQ ends.
cards.flavor: You remember when Maxi was making book for Chacon. He's moved up in the world and gained the veneer of respectability. But as an executive the people he works for now, are far more vicious, bloodthirsty, and crooked.

cards.name: Mr. Stone
cards.text: Whenever the Runner takes 1 or more tags, do 1 meat damage.
cards.flavor:
"VP of Retirements and Pensions? So is that HR or Accounting?"
"Both."

cards.name: Officer Frank
cards.text: [trash], 1[credit]: The Corp trashes 2 cards from HQ at random. Use this ability only if you suffered meat damage this turn.

cards.name: Paper Trail
cards.text: When you score Paper Trail, Trace[6]. If successful, trash all connection and job resources.

cards.name: Polyhistor
cards.text: +1[mu], +1[link] The first time each turn you pass all of the ice protecting HQ, you may draw 1 card to force the Corp to draw 1 card. Limit 1 console per player.

cards.name: Process Automation
cards.text: Gain 2[credit] and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Restructuring labor resources.

cards.name: SYN Attack
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this event, spend [click].
The Corp must either discard 2 cards or draw 4 cards.
cards.flavor: Flooding the system with synchronized request messages makes it unresponsive to legitimate requests.

cards.name: Savant
cards.text: This program gets +1 strength for each unused MU. Interface → 2[credit]: Break 1 sentry or 2 code gate subroutines.
cards.flavor: Δεν υπἁρχει τίποτα μόνιμο, εκτός από την αλλαγή.

cards.name: Seidr Laboratories: Destiny Defined
cards.text: The first time each turn the Runner loses or spends [click] during a run, you may add 1 card from Archives to the top of R&D.
cards.flavor: Interweaving the Past and the Future.

cards.name: Skorpios Defense Systems: Persuasive Power
cards.text: [interrupt] → Whenever 1 or more Runner cards would be trashed (from any location), set those cards aside instead of adding them to the heap. You can look at those cards. You may remove 1 of them from the game. Then, add all of those cards that are still set aside to the heap. Ignore this ability if you have already removed a card from the game with it this turn.
cards.flavor: Might makes right.

cards.name: Spear Phishing
cards.text: Make a run. When you encounter the innermost piece of ice protecting that server, bypass it.
cards.flavor: Targeted attacks make system breaches so much easier, especially if you can spoof an authorized user.

cards.name: Steve Cambridge: Master Grifter
cards.text: The first time each turn you make a successful run on HQ, you may choose 2 cards in your heap. If you do, the Corp removes 1 of those cards from the game, then you add the other card to your grip.

cards.name: Successful Field Test
cards.text: When you score Successful Field Test, install any number of cards from HQ, ignoring all costs.

cards.name: Tapestry
cards.text:
[subroutine] The Runner loses [click], if able.
[subroutine] The Corp may draw 1 card.
[subroutine] The Corp may add 1 card from HQ to the top of R&D.
cards.flavor: "The Warp and Weft were hypnotic...but they didn't really seem to do anything to keep me out. But then I never seemed to find anything interesting either." - Reaver

cards.name: The Shadow Net
cards.text: [click], forfeit an agenda: Play an event from your heap, ignoring all costs.
cards.flavor: A despicable web of outcasts and infamy, no government or corporation could effectively shut it down. If only because so many of their sysops, executives, and covert agents made use of it.

cards.name: Ubax
cards.text: +1[mu] When your turn begins, draw 1 card. Limit 1 console per player.
cards.flavor: "It is more than just a 'pretty nanite plant'. It's a complex synthetic intelligent distributed network, and a VERY pretty nanite plant." - Bios

cards.name: Ultraviolet Clearance
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this operation, spend [click][click].
Gain 10[credit] and draw 4 cards. You may install 1 card from HQ.
cards.flavor: "If there were hidden partitions on the server, I'd know; I'm the head of this department!"

cards.name: Weir
cards.text:
[subroutine] The Runner loses [click].
[subroutine] The Runner trashes 1 card from their grip.

cards.name: BMI Buffer
cards.text:
Whenever a program is trashed from your grip, host it on BMI Buffer instead of adding it to your heap.
[click][click]: Install 1 hosted program (paying all costs).

cards.name: BMI Buffer 2
cards.text:
Whenever a program is trashed from your grip, host it on BMI Buffer instead of adding it to your heap.
[click][click]: Install 1 hosted program, ignoring all costs.

cards.name: Corporate Oversight A
cards.text:
When you score Corporate Oversight, you may search R&D for a piece of ice. Install and rez it protecting a remote server, ignoring all costs. Shuffle R&D.
If you win a game with Corporate Oversight in your score area, destroy it.

cards.name: Corporate Oversight B
cards.text:
When you score Corporate Oversight, you may search R&D for a piece of ice. Install and rez it protecting a central server, ignoring all costs. Shuffle R&D.
If you win a game with Corporate Oversight in your score area, destroy it.

cards.name: Evidence Collection
cards.text: When you win a game with Evidence Collection in your score area, reveal set 2.

cards.name: Evidence Collection 2
cards.text: When you win a game with Evidence Collection in your score area, reveal set 5.

cards.name: Evidence Collection 3
cards.text: When you win a game with Evidence Collection in your score area, reveal set 8.

cards.name: Evidence Collection 4
cards.text: Evidence Collection is worth 1 fewer agenda point while in the Runner's score area.

cards.name: Investigator Inez Delgado
cards.text: When you win a game with Investigator Inez Delgado in your score area, reveal set 2. Add Investigator Inez Delgado to your score area as an agenda worth 0 agenda points: Expose all cards in a remote server. Use this only if you have stolean an agenda this turn.

cards.name: Investigator Inez Delgado 2
cards.text: When you win a game with Investigator Inez Delgado in your score area, reveal set 5. Add Investigator Inez Delgado to your score area as an agenda worth 0 agenda points: Reveal the top 3 cards in R&D. Use this only if you have stolean an agenda this turn.

cards.name: Investigator Inez Delgado 3
cards.text: When you win a game with Investigator Inez Delgado in your score area, reveal set 8. Add Investigator Inez Delgado to your score area as an agenda worth 0 agenda points: Reveal each card in HQ. Use this only if you have stolean an agenda this turn.

cards.name: Investigator Inez Delgado 4
cards.text: Add Investigator Inez Delgado to your score area as an agenda worth 0 agenda points: Reveal each card in HQ and the top card of R&D. Use this only if you have stolean an agenda this turn.

cards.name: Investigator Inez Delgado A
cards.text: Whenever you score an agenda, you may swap it with an agenda in the Runner's score area worth at least 1 point, then resolve the "when scored" ability on that agenda.

cards.name: Investigator Inez Delgado A 2
cards.text: Whenever the Runner steals an agenda, you may resolve the "when scored" ability on that agenda, then swap it with an agenda in your scored area.

cards.name: Lt. Todachine
cards.text: Whenever you rez a piece of ice, give the Runner 1 tag.

cards.name: Lt. Todachine 2
cards.text:
Whenever you rez a piece of ice, give the Runner 1 tag.
Whenever the Runner accesses cards, he or she accesses 1 fewer card if he or she is tagged (to a minimum of 1 card).

cards.name: Machicolation A
cards.text:
[subroutine] Trash 1 program.
[subroutine] Trash 1 program.
[subroutine] Trash 1 piece of hardware.
[subroutine] The Runner loses 3[credit], if able. End the run.

cards.name: Machicolation B
cards.text:
[subroutine] Trash 1 resource.
[subroutine] Trash 1 resource.
[subroutine] Do 1 net damage.
[subroutine] The Runner loses [click], if able. End the run.

cards.name: Net Watchlist
cards.text: This card is not trashed until another current is played or an agenda is stolen. The Runner must pay 2[credit] as an additional cost to use an icebreaker.

cards.name: Security Leak
cards.text: This card is not trashed until another current is played or an agenda is scored. As an additional cost to advance a card, the Corp must pay 1[credit].

cards.name: Shadow Team
cards.text:
Whenever you draw a Shadow Team, immediately install it.
Whenever you initiate a run, trash a card from your grip, if able. When you make a successful run on a central server, destroy Shadow Team.

cards.name: Sneakdoor Prime A
cards.text: [click],[click]: Make a run on a remote server. If successful, instead treat it as a successful run on a central server.

cards.name: Sneakdoor Prime B
cards.text: [click],[click]: Make a run on a central server. If successful, instead treat it as a successful run on a remote server.

cards.name: Surveillance Network Key
cards.text: Whenever the Corp spends [click] to draw 1 or more cards (including through a card ability), reveal the first card drawn.

cards.name: Surveillance Network Key 2
cards.text:
Whenever the Corp spends [click] to draw 1 or more cards (including through a card ability), reveal the first card drawn.
2[credit]: For the remainder of this run, access 1 additional card whenever you access cards from HQ or R&D. Use this ability only once per turn.

cards.name: The Masque A
cards.text: [click],[trash]: Make a run and gain [click]. If successful, draw 1 card.

cards.name: The Masque B
cards.text: [click],[trash]: Make a run and gain [click]. If that run is successful when it ends, you may immediately make another run on another server.

cards.name: Trojan
cards.text:
If Trojan is accessed from R&D, then Runner must reveal it.
When the Runner accesses Trojan, lose 2[credit], trash 1 card from HQ at random, and destroy Trojan. Ignore this ability if the Runner accesses Trojan from Archives.

cards.name: Adjusted Matrix
cards.text: Install only on an icebreaker. Host icebreaker gains AI and "Interface → Lose [click]: Break 1 subroutine."
cards.flavor: "Who said you can't teach an old breaker new tricks?" -g00ru

cards.name: Aeneas Informant
cards.text: Whenever you access a card with a trash cost not in Archives and do not trash it, you may reveal it and gain 1[credit].

cards.name: AgInfusion: New Miracles for a New World
cards.text: Once per turn → Trash the unrezzed piece of ice the Runner is approaching: Choose a server other than the attacked server. The Runner moves to the outermost position of that server and encounters any ice there.

cards.name: Audacity
cards.text:
Play only if there are at least 2 other cards in HQ.
Trash all cards from HQ. Place a total of 2 advancement counters on installed cards you can advance.

cards.name: Authenticator
cards.text:
When the Runner encounters this ice, they may take 1 tag to bypass it.
[subroutine] The Corp gains 2[credit].
[subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor: "I'm sure there is no way this could go wrong for you." -Henry Phillips

cards.name: Bamboo Dome
cards.text: Install only in the root of R&D. [click]: Reveal the top 3 cards of R&D. Secretly choose 1 to add to HQ. Return the others to the top of R&D, in any order. Limit 1 region per server.

cards.name: Battlement
cards.text:
[subroutine]End the run.
[subroutine]End the run.
cards.flavor: "Our job is to stop incursions. Let Argus get cute with them." -Moishe Saban

cards.name: Ben Musashi
cards.text: Persistent → As an additional cost to steal an agenda from this server or its root, the Runner must suffer 2 net damage. (If the Runner trashes this card while accessing it, this ability still applies for the remainder of this run.)

cards.name: Berserker
cards.text: Whenever you encounter a barrier, for the remainder of that encounter this program gets +1 strength for each subroutine on that barrier. Interface → 2[credit]: Break up to 2 barrier subroutines.

cards.name: Bioroid Work Crew
cards.text: [trash]: Install 1 card from HQ. Use this ability only during the next paid ability window after playing and resolving an operation.
cards.flavor: "They don't need sleep, breaks, overtime, or even O₂. How can we compete with that!?"

cards.name: Dadiana Chacon
cards.text:
When your turn begins, gain 1[credit] if you have fewer than 6[credit].
Whenever you have 0[credit], trash Dadiana Chacon and take 3 meat damage.
cards.flavor: "You want untraceable funds? I'll lend, as long as you have the ability to pay me back."

cards.name: Dedicated Processor
cards.text: Install Dedicated Processor on a non-AI icebreaker. Host icebreaker gains "2[credit]: +4 strength."
cards.flavor: Better, Faster, Stronger

cards.name: Henry Phillips
cards.text: Whenever the Runner breaks a subroutine during a run on this server, gain 2[credit] if they are tagged.
cards.flavor: "Toying with them is where the job satisfaction comes in".

cards.name: Inversificator
cards.text: The first time each turn you pass a piece of ice after an encounter during which this program fully broke that ice, you may swap it with another installed piece of ice. Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 code gate subroutine. 1[credit]: +1 strength.

cards.name: NEXT Opal
cards.text: This ice gains "[subroutine] You may install 1 card from HQ." for each rezzed piece of NEXT ice.
cards.flavor: "I passed through the opalescent curtain only to find a suddenly empty server..."

cards.name: Owl
cards.text: [subroutine] Add 1 installed program to the top of the stack.
cards.flavor: "It's eyes just keep following you."

cards.name: Persephone
cards.text: Interface → 2[credit]: Break 1 sentry subroutine. 1[credit]: +1 strength. Whenever you pass a sentry after encountering it, you may trash the top card of your stack. If you do, trash 1 card from the top of R&D for each subroutine on that sentry that resolved during that encounter.

cards.name: Red Planet Couriers
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this operation, spend [click], [click].
Move all advancement tokens from all installed cards to 1 card that can be advanced.

cards.name: Rosetta 2.0
cards.text: [click], remove an installed program from the game: Search your stack for a non-virus program, shuffle your stack, then install that program, lowering the install cost by the cost of the program removed from the game.

cards.name: Rubicon Switch
cards.text: Once per turn → [click], X[credit]: Derez 1 piece of ice with a printed rez cost of X[credit] that was rezzed this turn.
cards.flavor: "Even I don't know how or why this one works. I just copied the schematics from a burst broadcast from someplace north of Paxton's Node, where nothing is supposed to be." -Los

cards.name: Alice Merchant: Clan Agitator
cards.text: The first time you make a successful run on Archives each turn, the Corp must trash 1 card from HQ.
cards.flavor: Jarogniew's agent provocateur.

cards.name: Bug Out Bag
cards.text:
When you install this resource, place X power counters on it.
When your turn ends, if you have no cards in your grip, draw 1 card for each hosted power counter, then trash this resource.
cards.flavor: Everything you need in case of an emergency.

cards.name: Daredevil
cards.text: +2[mu] The first time you initiate a run on a server protected by 2 or more pieces of ice each turn, draw 2 cards. Limit 1 console per player.
cards.flavor: "Taking risks is what makes it fun!" -Kabonesa Wu

cards.name: Escalate Vitriol
cards.text: Once per turn → [click]: Gain 1[credit] for each tag the Runner has.
cards.flavor: "Of course words hurt." -Bex Gleeson

cards.name: Jarogniew Mercs
cards.text: When you install this resource, take 1 tag. Load X power counters onto this resource, where X is equal to the number of tags you have plus 3. When this resource is empty, trash it. The Corp cannot trash this resource while there is another resource installed. [interrupt] → Hosted power counter: Prevent 1 meat damage.

cards.name: Keros Mcintyre
cards.text: The first time you derez a piece of ice each turn, gain 2[credit].
cards.flavor: "I don't bother asking why anymore—he never says—but if I had to guess, it's because he's embezzling and using my runs to disguise it. Not that I care. His credit spends as well as the next guy's" -Moth

cards.name: Loki
cards.text:
When the Runner encounters this ice, choose another rezzed piece of ice. For the remainder of this run, this ice gains the subtypes of the chosen ice and gains the subroutines of that ice in order before its other subroutines.
[subroutine] End the run unless the Runner shuffles all cards from the grip into the stack.

cards.name: Mass Commercialization
cards.text: Gain 2[credit] for each card with at least 1 advancement token on it.

cards.name: Mass-Driver
cards.text: Whenever this program fully breaks a piece of ice, the first 3 subroutines of the next encounter this run do not resolve. Interface → 2[credit]: Break 1 code gate subroutine. 1[credit]: +1 strength.

cards.name: Meteor Mining
cards.text: When you score Meteor Mining, you may gain 7[credit]. If the Runner has at least 2 tags, you may do 7 meat damage instead.
cards.flavor: "I've got a rock!" - Charles "Mad Dog" Brun, Comet Jockey

cards.name: Mirāju
cards.text:
Whenever an encounter with this ice ends, if the Runner broke its printed subroutine, the Runner moves to the outermost position of Archives instead of passing this ice. They may jack out. Derez this ice.
[subroutine] You may draw 1 card. Then, shuffle 1 card from HQ into R&D.

cards.name: Māui
cards.text: +2[mu] X[recurring-credit] Use these credits during runs on HQ. X is the number of pieces of ice protecting HQ. Limit 1 console per player.

cards.name: Obokata Protocol
cards.text: As an additional cost to steal Obokata Protocol, the Runner must suffer 4 net damage.
cards.flavor: "Proper application of stress can create the most profound changes." - Tennin Institute Intern Brief

cards.name: Reeducation
cards.text: When you score this agenda, add any number of cards from HQ to the bottom of R&D. Draw X cards, where X is equal to the number of cards you added to R&D this way. If the Runner has at least X cards in the grip, they add X cards from the grip to the bottom of the stack at random.

cards.name: Shipment from Tennin
cards.text:
Play only if the Runner did not make a successful run during their last turn.
Place 2 advancement counters on 1 installed card.

cards.name: Standoff
cards.text: When you score this agenda, the Runner may trash 1 of their installed cards. If they do not, draw 1 card and gain 5[credit]. Otherwise, you may trash 1 of your installed cards to repeat this process.

cards.name: Success
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this operation, forfeit an agenda and spend [click][click].
Advance a card X times. X equals the advancement requirement of the agenda just forfeited.
cards.flavor: The difference between surviving and thriving is successful terraforming.

cards.name: Traffic Analyzer
cards.text: Whenever you rez a piece of ice protecting this server, Trace[2]. If successful, the Corp gains 1[credit].
cards.flavor: "It's all about M.E. Monetizing Everything." -Eryn Nielle

cards.name: Warroid Tracker
cards.text: Whenever the Runner trashes at least 1 card from this server, from its root, or protecting it, Trace[4]. If successful, the Runner trashes 2 of their installed cards.

cards.name: Whampoa Reclamation
cards.text: Once per turn → Trash 1 card from HQ: Add 1 card from Archives to the bottom of R&D.
cards.flavor: "Whampoa is the largest and meanest Earth-based mining concern on Mars. They put bodies and waste in the ground as fast as they pull minerals out." - Alice Merchant

cards.name: Biased Reporting
cards.text: Choose resource, hardware, or program. The Runner may trash any of their installed cards of the chosen type and gain 1[credit] for each card trashed this way. Gain 2[credit] for each card of the chosen type that is still installed.

cards.name: Bloo Moose
cards.text: When your turn begins, you may remove 1 card in the heap from the game. If you do, gain 2[credit].
cards.flavor:
"Talk is free. Anything else is going to cost you."
-Jitish

cards.name: Data Loop
cards.text:
When the Runner encounters this ice, they add 2 cards from the grip to the top of the stack.
[subroutine] End the run if the Runner is tagged.
[subroutine] End the run.

cards.name: Flashbang
cards.text: Interface → 6[credit]: Derez the sentry you are encountering. 1[credit]: +1 strength.
cards.flavor: "It's my sentry cheat sheet." -Revenant

cards.name: God of War
cards.text: When your turn begins, you may take 1 tag to place 2 virus counters on this program. Interface → Hosted virus counter: Break 1 subroutine. 2[credit]: +1 strength.
cards.flavor: "Subtle? You don't really understand the point of all of this, do you?" -Alice Merchant

cards.name: Helheim Servers
cards.text: Trash 1 card from HQ: All ice protecting this server has +2 strength until the end of the run. Use this ability only during a run on this server.

cards.name: Lean and Mean
cards.text: Make a run. If you have 3 or fewer programs installed, all icebreakers have +2 strength during this run.
cards.flavor: "The question isn't 'should I do it?' the question is 'can I do it?'" -Kabonesa Wu

cards.name: Leave No Trace
cards.text: Make a run. When the run ends, derez all ice that was rezzed during this run.
cards.flavor: "The Perfect Run is when you get in, take something of value, and get back out, with no one knowing you've ever been there." -g00ru

cards.name: Mandatory Seed Replacement
cards.text: When you score Mandatory Seed Replacement, rearrange any number of ice protecting all servers.
cards.flavor: "As you'll see on page 276, section CDXXIX, paragraph 47, line 102 of your contract, you are overdue for your seed upgrade, and all growth from out of date seed is to be confiscated and destroyed."

cards.name: Mars for Martians
cards.text: Play only as your first [click]. Draw 1 card for each installed clan resource. Gain 1[credit] for each tag you have.
cards.flavor: "We don't want you! We don't need you!"

cards.name: Maven
cards.text: This program gets +1 strength for each installed program. Interface → 2[credit]: Break 1 subroutine.

cards.name: Metamorph
cards.text: [subroutine] Swap 2 other installed pieces of ice or 2 of your installed non-ice cards.
cards.flavor: "My gift to runners: isomorphic architectural protocols. Ichiban daikirai da." -Midori

cards.name: Na'Not'K
cards.text: During runs, this program gets +1 strength for each piece of ice protecting the attacked server. Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 sentry subroutine. 3[credit]: +2 strength.
cards.flavor: "Anyone can hit someone where they are weakest." -S'onge Galaxy

cards.name: Open Forum
cards.text: After your mandatory draw, reveal the top card of R&D and add it to HQ. Add 1 card from HQ to the top of R&D.
cards.flavor:
"Please, speak freely. I've been tasked by the board itself to hear your grievances."
-Mandy Traut

cards.name: O₂ Shortage
cards.text: The Runner may trash 1 card from the grip at random. If they do not, gain [click][click].
cards.flavor:
"Is the lack of oxygen causing distress, friend?"
-Gregory 3D3R6Z

cards.name: Rip Deal
cards.text: Run HQ. If successful, when you determine the number of cards in HQ you are allowed to access during this run's breach of HQ, you may add that many cards from your heap to your grip. If you do, you cannot access any cards in HQ during this breach. (You can still access cards in the root of HQ.) When the run ends, remove this event from the game.

cards.name: Rover Algorithm
cards.text: Install Rover Algorithm on a rezzed piece of ice as a hosted condition counter with the text "Host ice has +1 strength for each power counter on Rover Algorithm. Whenever the Runner passes host ice, place 1 power counter on Rover Algorithm."

cards.name: Tithonium
cards.text:
You may forfeit an agenda to rez Tithonium instead of paying its rez cost.
Tithonium cannot host cards.
[subroutine] Trash 1 program.
[subroutine] Trash 1 program.
[subroutine] Trash 1 resource and end the run.

cards.name: Transparency Initiative
cards.text: Turn an agenda faceup and install Transparency Initiative on that agenda as a hosted condition counter with the text "Host agenda gains public. Whenever you advance host agenda, gain 1[credit]."

cards.name: Water Monopoly
cards.text: The install cost of each non-virtual resource is increased by 1.
cards.flavor: AgInfusion doesn't just have patents on nearly every plant seed that is farmed on Mars—they own most of the rights to the water that the farms use.

cards.name: AR-Enhanced Security
cards.text: The first time each turn the Runner trashes a Corp card, give them 1 tag.
cards.flavor: Only NBN's sec teams were outfitted with systems that could read data flows and see into the Net.

cards.name: Aumakua
cards.text: This program gets +1 strength for each hosted virus counter. Whenever you expose a card, place 1 virus counter on this program. Whenever you finish breaching a server, if you did not steal or trash any accessed cards, place 1 virus counter on this program. Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 subroutine.

cards.name: Breached Dome
cards.text:
While the Runner is accessing this asset in R&D, they must reveal it.
When the Runner accesses this asset, do 1 meat damage and trash the top card of the stack.

cards.name: CFC Excavation Contract
cards.text: When you score CFC Excavation Contract, gain 2[credit] for each rezzed bioroid.
cards.flavor: "Sure, we also use human labor—they are more easily replaced." -Emil Merk

cards.name: Caldera
cards.text: [interrupt] → 3[credit]: Prevent 1 core damage or 1 net damage.
cards.flavor: The electric pulses ripped through the Net, backtracking Los's location. When they hit his defenses, they spent themselves against the slope.

cards.name: Conundrum
cards.text: Conundrum has +3 strength if there is an installed AI. [subroutine] The Runner trashes an installed program. [subroutine] The Runner loses [click], if able. [subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor: A ghost image of it could be made out in the static of his BMI. He hoped never to run across the real thing again.

cards.name: Corporate Defector
cards.text: Whenever the Corp draws a card with the basic action, reveal that card.
cards.flavor: He was suddenly very motivated to pass on confidential information.

cards.name: Diana's Hunt
cards.text: Run any server. Whenever you encounter a piece of ice during that run, you may install 1 program from your grip, ignoring all costs. When that run ends, trash all programs installed this way.

cards.name: Dummy Box
cards.text: [interrupt] → Trash 1 card from your grip: Prevent the Corp from trashing 1 installed card of the same type.
cards.flavor: "Aptly named." -g00ru

cards.name: Fractal Threat Matrix
cards.text: Each time all the subroutines are broken on a piece of ice protecting this server, trash the top 2 cards of the stack.
cards.flavor: "I embedded recursive data loops into the go-no-go subroutines of every piece of ice." -Anson Rose

cards.name: MCA Austerity Policy
cards.text: Once per turn → [click]: Place 1 power counter on this asset. When the Runner's next turn begins, they lose [click]. [click], [trash], 3 hosted power counters: Gain [click][click][click][click].

cards.name: Mining Accident
cards.text:
Play only if you made a successful run on a central server this turn.
Give the Corp 1 bad publicity unless they pay 5[credit].
Remove this event from the game.

cards.name: Priority Construction
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this operation, spend [click].
Install a piece of ice from HQ protecting a remote server (ignoring all costs). Place 3 advancement tokens on that ice.

cards.name: Reshape
cards.text: Swap 2 pieces of unrezzed ice.
cards.flavor: "I wield the power cosmic—a galactic force that can reshape the Net!" -S'onge Galaxy

cards.name: Respirocytes
cards.text:
When you install this hardware, suffer 1 meat damage.
The first time each turn you have no cards in your grip, draw 1 card and place 1 power counter on this hardware.
When this hardware has 3 or more hosted power counters, trash it.

cards.name: Restore
cards.text: Install and rez 1 card from Archives (paying all costs). Remove all other copies of that card in Archives from the game.

cards.name: Rolling Brownout
cards.text: This card is not trashed until another current is played or an agenda is stolen. The play cost of each operation and event is increased by 1. The first time the Runner plays an event each turn, gain 1[credit].

cards.name: Salvaged Vanadis Armory
cards.text: [trash]: The Corp trashes the top X cards of R&D. X is equal to the amount of damage you have suffered this turn. Use this ability only during the next paid ability window after suffering any amount of damage.
cards.flavor: Vanadis, a Martian arms manufacturer, was among the first sites targeted from orbit during the war.

cards.name: Sand Storm
cards.text: [subroutine] If this ice is installed, move it to the outermost position protecting another server. (The run continues from this new position.) Trash this ice.
cards.flavor: By the time the data storm passed, the landscape was transformed, and she was hopelessly lost.

cards.name: Threat Level Alpha
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this operation, spend [click].
Trace[1]. If successful, give the Runner 1 tag for each tag they have or, if the Runner has no tags, give them 1 tag.

cards.name: Asa Group: Security Through Vigilance
cards.text: The first time each turn you install a card, you may install 1 non-agenda card from HQ in the root of or protecting the same server.

cards.name: Assimilator
cards.text: [click],[click]: Turn one of your facedown installed cards faceup. If that card is an event, trash it.
cards.flavor:
"Its only function seems to be repurposing code."
"Can you kill it?" she asked.
"I can try," he said. Guiding his program dead center of the mass, he plunged, piercing the shell before an eruption sent his screen into static. He jacked out, his eyes wide. "I... I think it absorbed my breaker. And everything else."

cards.name: By Any Means
cards.text:
Play only as your first [click].
For the remainder of the turn, whenever you access a card not in Archives, trash it and suffer 1 meat damage.

cards.name: Calibration Testing
cards.text: Remote server only. [trash]: Place 1 advancement counter on a card installed in the root of this server.
cards.flavor: "Once every week, we perform a drill. Except, I'm the only one who knows it's a drill."

cards.name: Cyberdelia
cards.text:
+1[mu]
The first time each turn you fully break a piece of ice, gain 1[credit].
cards.flavor: Optical computing still has its uses. But it's hard to explain them to people whose eyes glaze over when you bring up the double-slit experiment.

cards.name: Echo Chamber
cards.text: [click], [click], [click]: Add Echo Chamber to your score area as an agenda worth 1 agenda point.
cards.flavor: "Capitalism runs on two things: amplified arrogance and censored dissent. With those, a corp can create any environment it wants." - Freedom Khumalo

cards.name: Gene Splicer
cards.text: Gene Splicer can be advanced. When the Runner accesses Gene Splicer, do 1 net damage for each advancement token on Gene Splicer. [click], 3 hosted advancement tokens: Add Gene Splicer to your score area as an agenda worth 1 agenda point.

cards.name: Genotyping
cards.text: Trash the top 2 cards of R&D, then shuffle up to 4 cards from Archives into R&D. Remove Genotyping from the game instead of trashing it.
cards.flavor: Sometimes you have to break a few eggs to sequence a genome.

cards.name: Ikawah Project
cards.text: As an additional cost to steal Ikawah Project, the Runner must spend [click] and 2[credit].
