cards.flavor: "The average citizen of Nairobi speaks six languages. Every culture, language, ethnicity of the east of Africa collides here, collapses together. What happens slowly by nature can happen quickly in our lab. We will bring peace." - Dr. Muchina, Project Lead

cards.name: Lewi Guilherme
cards.text:
When your turn begins, either lose 1[credit] or trash Lewi Guilherme.
The Corp's maximum hand size is reduced by 1.
cards.flavor: Brought up in the slums of Jinja, Lewi made his fortune through back alley deals, well-placed bets, and savvy showmanship.

cards.name: Mganga
cards.text: [subroutine] You and the Runner secretly spend 0[credit], 1[credit] or 2[credit]. Reveal spent credits. If you and the Runner spend a different number of credits, do 2 net damage; otherwise do 1 net damage. Trash Mganga.
cards.flavor: Thin enough to pierce netspace. Deadly enough to pierce your mind.

cards.name: Najja 1.0
cards.text: Lose [click]: Break 1 subroutine on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability. [subroutine] End the run. [subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor: Earth and Sun, together as one.

cards.name: Puffer
cards.text: This program gets +1 strength and costs +1[mu] for each hosted power counter. Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 sentry subroutine. 2[credit]: +1 strength. [click]: Place 1 power counter on this program or remove 1 hosted power counter.

cards.name: Reconstruction Contract
cards.text:
Whenever the Runner suffers any amount of meat damage, you may place 1 advancement token on Reconstruction Contract.
[trash]: Move any number of advancement tokens from Reconstruction Contract to a card that can be advanced.

cards.name: Self-Growth Program
cards.text:
Play only if the Runner is tagged.
Add 2 installed Runner cards to the grip.
cards.flavor: Our patented ClearMind™ technology pacifies the trials and tribulations of everyday life.

cards.name: Upya
cards.text: Whenever you make a successful run on R&D, you may place 1 power counter on this program. Once per turn → [click], 3 hosted power counters: Gain [click][click].
cards.flavor: New life through new understanding.

cards.name: Urban Renewal
cards.text:
Place 3 power counters on Urban Renewal when it is rezzed. When there are no power counters left on Urban Renewal, trash it and do 4 meat damage.
When your turn begins, remove 1 power counter from Urban Renewal.

cards.name: Wake Up Call
cards.text: Play only if the Runner trashed a Corp card during their last turn and the Runner has at least 1 installed piece of hardware or non-virtual resource. Choose 1 installed piece of hardware or non-virtual resource. The Runner must either trash that card or suffer 4 meat damage. Remove this operation from the game.

cards.name: Yusuf
cards.text: Whenever you make a successful run, you may place 1 virus counter on this program. Interface → Any virus counter: Break 1 barrier subroutine. Any virus counter: +1 strength.

cards.name: Zamba
cards.text: +2[mu] Whenever a Corp card is exposed, you may gain 1[credit]. Limit 1 console per player.
cards.flavor: Mounted holistic lenses download, recompile, and broadcast data faster than a corporate cover-up.

cards.name: Acacia
cards.text: Whenever the Corp purges virus counters, you may gain 1[credit] for each virus counter removed and trash Acacia.
cards.flavor: The system is so deeply rooted, who knows how far the cables run?

cards.name: Aimor
cards.text: [subroutine] Trash the top 3 cards of the stack. Trash Aimor.
cards.flavor: "Starving, dehydrated, delirious, I picked a direction and ran, ran for days, maybe even weeks. I ran until my legs couldn't carry me. Then I crawled. When I was finally out, finally free of the shroud, I checked the time, the date. How long had I been gone, trapped in the all-encompassing blackness? Turns out, 3 minutes."

cards.name: Bacterial Programming
cards.text: When Bacterial Programming is scored or stolen, you may look at the top 7 cards of R&D, add any number of them to HQ, trash any number of them, and arrange the rest in any order.

cards.name: Credit Kiting
cards.text:
Play only if you made a successful run on a central server this turn.
Install a card from your grip, lowering its install cost by 8[credit], and take 1 tag.
cards.flavor: The gap of 0.19 seconds was all he needed.

cards.name: Distract the Masses
cards.text: The Runner gains 2[credit]. Trash up to 2 cards from HQ, then shuffle up to 2 cards from Archives into R&D. Remove Distract the Masses from the game instead of trashing it.
cards.flavor: "Food. Drinks. Entertainment. It doesn't take much to gratify the bourgeoisie."

cards.name: Economic Warfare
cards.text:
Play only if the Runner made a successful run during their last turn.
If the Runner has at least 4[credit], they lose 4[credit].
cards.flavor: He found it odd that three frozen yogurt shops, all less than a block from his, opened within the same week.

cards.name: Emergent Creativity
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this event, spend [click].
Trash any number of programs and/or pieces of hardware from your grip. Search your stack for 1 program or piece of hardware. Install it, paying X[credit] less. X is equal to the total install cost of the trashed cards.

cards.name: Forced Connection
cards.text:
While the Runner is accessing this upgrade in R&D, they must reveal it.
When the Runner accesses this upgrade anywhere except in Archives, Trace[3]. If successful, give the Runner 2 tags.

cards.name: Jinja City Grid
cards.text: Whenever you draw a piece of ice, you may reveal it and install it protecting this server, paying 4[credit] less. Limit 1 region per server.
cards.flavor: "The site of the world's second beanstalk, or I'll die trying." - Miria Byanyima, Director of VSEP

cards.name: Jua
cards.text:
When the Runner encounters this ice, they cannot install cards for the remainder of the turn.
[subroutine] Choose 2 installed Runner cards, if able. The Runner must add 1 of the chosen cards to the top of the stack.
cards.flavor: "It wasn't until the spots cleared that I realized half of my rig was gone." - Kabonesa Wu

cards.name: Kabonesa Wu: Netspace Thrillseeker
cards.text: [click]: Search your stack for a non-virus program and install it, lowering its install cost by 1[credit], then shuffle your stack. If that program is still installed when your turn ends, remove it from the game.

cards.name: Kongamato
cards.text: [trash]: Break the first subroutine on the encountered piece of ice.
cards.flavor: A winged terror, the Kongamato dives from above, rending its prey in one ferocious bite.

cards.name: NGO Front
cards.text: NGO Front can be advanced. [trash],1 hosted advancement token: Gain 5[credit]. [trash],2 hosted advancement tokens: Gain 8[credit].
cards.flavor: "Who knew non-profits could be so profitable?"

cards.name: Nightdancer
cards.text:
[subroutine] The Runner loses [click], if able. You have an additional [click] to spend during your next turn.
[subroutine] The Runner loses [click], if able. You have an additional [click] to spend during your next turn.
cards.flavor: Witchcraft to the nescient; beauty to the wise.

cards.name: Plague
cards.text:
When you install Plague, choose a server.
Whenever you make a successful run on the chosen server, you may place 2 virus counters on Plague.
cards.flavor: Embedded in the mainframe, it proliferates and devours with each agitation.

cards.name: RNG Key
cards.text: The first time you make a successful run on HQ or R&D each turn, you may name a number. If you do, reveal the next card that you access this run. If it has a rez cost, play cost, or advancement requirement equal to the named number, either gain 3[credit] or draw 2 cards.
cards.flavor: Between nothing and infinity.

cards.name: SSL Endorsement
cards.text:
When this agenda is scored or stolen, place 9[credit] on it.
When the Corp's turn begins, they may take 3[credit] from this agenda. This ability is active even while this agenda is in the Runner's score area.

cards.name: Takobi
cards.text: Whenever you fully break a piece of ice, you may place 1 power counter on this program. 2 hosted power counters: Choose 1 installed non-AI icebreaker. That icebreaker gets +3 strength for the remainder of the current encounter.
cards.flavor: When standard breaking just doesn't cut it.

cards.name: Threat Assessment
cards.text:
Play only if the Runner trashed a Corp card during their last turn and the Runner has at least 1 installed card.
Choose 1 installed Runner card. The Runner must take 2 tags or add that card to the top of the stack.
Remove this operation from the game.

cards.name: Wari
cards.text: The first time you make a successful run on HQ each turn, you may trash Wari to name sentry, code gate or barrier. Expose a piece of ice, then add it to HQ if it has the named subtype.
cards.flavor: "He's probably the best pet I've ever had but I'd still trade him for something better." - 419

cards.name: Anansi
cards.text:
Whenever an encounter with this ice ends, if the Runner did not fully break it, do 3 net damage.
[subroutine] Look at the top 5 cards of R&D and arrange them in any order.
[subroutine] You may draw 1 card. The Runner may pay 2[credit] to draw 1 card.
[subroutine] Do 1 net damage.

cards.name: Armed Intimidation
cards.text: When you score Armed Intimidation, the Runner must either suffer 5 meat damage or take 2 tags.
cards.flavor: "The way I see it, you've got two options: die here or die running. I'll enjoy both."

cards.name: Azmari EdTech: Shaping the Future
cards.text: When your turn ends, you may name a card type. Gain 2[credit] the first time each turn the Runner plays or installs a card that has the type you last named this way.

cards.name: Code Replicator
cards.text: Whenever the Runner passes a rezzed piece of ice protecting this server, you may trash this upgrade. If you do, the Runner must approach that ice again. They may jack out.
cards.flavor: for (;;)

cards.name: Corporate "Grant"
cards.text: This card is not trashed until another current is played or an agenda is scored. The first time you install a card each turn, the Corp loses 1[credit].
cards.flavor: You'd think someone would have noticed a program entitled "Career Opportunities in Hacking" earlier.

cards.name: Crypt
cards.text: Whenever you make a successful run on Archives, you may place 1 virus counter on Crypt. [click], [trash], 3 hosted virus counters: Search your stack for a virus program and install it (paying its install cost), then shuffle your stack.
cards.flavor: The smell of rot strengthens with each step.

cards.name: Death and Taxes
cards.text: This card is not trashed until another current is played or an agenda is stolen. Whenever the Runner installs a card or trashes an installed card, you may gain 1[credit].
cards.flavor: The only certainties.

cards.name: Degree Mill
cards.text: As an additional cost to steal Degree Mill, the Runner must shuffle 2 installed Runner cards into the stack.
cards.flavor:
Master any subject in 30 minutes or less!*
*Azmari EdTech is not responsible for altered memories or reduced temporal lobe functionality. Level of mastery may vary.

cards.name: Friday Chip
cards.text: Whenever you trash a Corp card, you may place 1 virus counter on Friday Chip. When your turn begins, you may move 1 hosted virus counter to a virus program.
cards.flavor:
"It makes every bad thing that you do so much better."
- g00ru

cards.name: Gbahali
cards.text: [trash]: Break the last subroutine on the encountered piece of ice.
cards.flavor: Ripples are all the prey sees before Gbahali swallows it whole.

cards.name: Kuwinda K4H1U3
cards.text: When your turn begins, you may trace[X], where X is equal to the number of hosted power counters. If successful, do 1 core damage and trash this asset. If unsuccessful, place 1 power counter on this asset.

cards.name: Marathon
cards.text: Make a run on a remote server. When the run ends, gain [click] and add Marathon to your grip instead of trashing it if the run was successful. You may not make another run on that server for the remainder of this turn.

cards.name: NEXT Sapphire
cards.text: X is the number of rezzed NEXT ice. [subroutine] Draw up to X cards. [subroutine] Add up to X cards from Archives to HQ. [subroutine] Shuffle up to X cards from HQ into R&D.
cards.flavor: Every level of protection for all of your security needs.

cards.name: No One Home
cards.text: [interrupt] → The first time each turn you would take tags or suffer net damage, you may trash this resource to have the Corp trace[0]. If unsuccessful, prevent all tags or all net damage.
cards.flavor: "Go away! I'm not here!"

cards.name: Personalized Portal
cards.text: When your turn begins, the Runner draws 1 card. You may gain 1[credit] for every 2 cards in the grip.
cards.flavor: "Welcome to Azmari Mail! You have 4,196 unread messages."

cards.name: Reverse Infection
cards.text:
Choose one:
  • Purge virus counters. Trash 1 card from the top of the stack for every 3 virus counters removed.
  • Gain 2[credit].

cards.name: TechnoCo
cards.text: The install cost of each program, piece of hardware, and virtual resource is increased by 1. Whenever the Runner installs a program, piece of hardware, or virtual resource, you may gain 1[credit].

cards.name: Trojan Horse
cards.text:
Play only if the Runner accessed a card during their last turn.
Trace[4]. If successful, trash 1 installed program with an install cost of X or less, where X is equal to the amount by which your trace strength exceeded the Runner's link strength.

cards.name: White Hat
cards.text:
Play only if you made a successful run on a central server this turn.
Force the Corp to "Trace[3]. If unsuccessful, reveal all cards in HQ. The Runner may choose up to 2 of the revealed cards. Shuffle those cards into R&D."

cards.name: eXer
cards.text:
Whenever you breach R&D, access 1 additional card.
When the Corp purges virus counters, trash this program.
cards.flavor: "Amateurs feign it as 'random packet loss'. They do this for safety. They do this out of fear. But why should we cower? We will collapse the Corporatocracy, piece by piece! They are not the ones to fear. We are." - Freedom Khumalo

cards.name: 419: Amoral Scammer
cards.text: The first time the Corp installs a card each turn, you may expose that card unless the Corp pays 1[credit].
cards.flavor: "Is there anything better than free money?"

cards.name: Amani Senai
cards.text: Whenever an agenda is scored or stolen, you may trace[X]. If successful, add an installed Runner card to the grip. X is the advancement requirement of the scored or stolen agenda.
cards.flavor: Azmari EdTech's most popular instructor, Amani Senai regularly broadcasts to millions of students.

cards.name: Because I Can
cards.text: Run a remote server. If successful, instead of breaching that server, you may force the Corp to shuffle all cards in the root of that server into R&D.
cards.flavor: At least this time around, the graphic was family-friendly.

cards.name: Bio Vault
cards.text: Remote server only. You can advance this upgrade. [trash], 2 hosted advancement counters: End the run. Use this ability only during a run.
cards.flavor: Many things go in. Nothing comes out.

cards.name: City Works Project
cards.text:
Install City Works Project faceup.
When the Runner accesses City Works Project while it is installed, do 2 meat damage and 1 additional meat damage for each advancement token on it.

cards.name: Consume
cards.text:
Whenever you trash a Corp card, you may place 1 virus counter on Consume.
[click]: Gain 2[credit] for each hosted virus counter, then remove all virus counters from Consume.
cards.flavor:
"It 'ate' the vertex grid?! What does that even mean?"
- Nkiru Qiū, Asa Group sysop

cards.name: Endless EULA
cards.text:
[subroutine]End the run unless the Runner pays 1[credit].
[subroutine]End the run unless the Runner pays 1[credit].
[subroutine]End the run unless the Runner pays 1[credit].
[subroutine]End the run unless the Runner pays 1[credit].
[subroutine]End the run unless the Runner pays 1[credit].
[subroutine]End the run unless the Runner pays 1[credit].
cards.flavor: "Has anyone ever actually read one of these things?" - 419

cards.name: Falsified Credentials
cards.text: Name a card type. Expose a card in a remote server, then gain 5[credit] if the exposed card has the named card type.
cards.flavor:
"I'm sorry, sir, we weren't expecting you! You look different than I remember..."
"Haircut."

cards.name: Glut Cipher
cards.text: Run Archives. If successful, instead of breaching Archives, the Corp adds exactly 5 cards from Archives to HQ, if able. If they do, they trash 5 cards from HQ at random.
cards.flavor: "Ever watch a server vomit?"

cards.name: Kill Switch
cards.text: This operation is not trashed until another current is played or an agenda is stolen. While the Runner is accessing an agenda in R&D, they must reveal it. Whenever an agenda is accessed or scored, Trace[3]. If successful, do 1 core damage.
cards.flavor: "Don't worry, he won't feel a thing! Probably."

cards.name: Knobkierie
cards.text: +3[mu] Use the MU on Knobkierie only for virus programs. The first time you make a successful run each turn, you may place 1 virus counter on an installed virus program. Limit 1 console per player.

cards.name: Malia Z0L0K4
cards.text: When you rez this asset, choose 1 installed non-virtual resource. The chosen resource loses its printed abilities.
cards.flavor: A Model G21V Tracker, Malia Z0L0K4 excels at locating assignments and subduing them.

cards.name: Nyashia
cards.text:
When you install this program, place 3 power counters on it.
Whenever you breach R&D, you may remove 1 hosted power counter to access 1 additional card.
cards.flavor: Speed gets you in, intuition gets you out.

cards.name: Oduduwa
cards.text:
When the Runner encounters Oduduwa, place 1 advancement token on it. You may place X advancement tokens on another piece of ice. X is the number of advancement tokens on Oduduwa.
[subroutine] End the run.
[subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor: Might given form.

cards.name: Rashida Jaheem
cards.text: When your turn begins, you may trash Rashida Jaheem to gain 3[credit] and draw 3 cards.
cards.flavor: She gets the job done. And then some.

cards.name: Rogue Trading
cards.text:
Place 18[credit] from the bank on Rogue Trading when it is installed. When there are no credits left on Rogue Trading, trash it.
[click], [click]: Take 6[credit] from Rogue Trading and take 1 tag.

cards.name: SSO Industries: Fueling Innovation
cards.text: When your turn ends, you may choose a piece of ice with no advancement tokens on it. If you do, place 1 advancement token on that piece of ice for each agenda point on all installed faceup agendas.

cards.name: Sadaka
cards.text:
[subroutine] Look at the top 3 cards of R&D and either arrange them in any order or shuffle R&D. You may draw 1 card.
[subroutine] You may trash 1 card in HQ. If you do, trash 1 resource. Trash Sadaka.

cards.name: Sandman
cards.text:
[subroutine]Add an installed Runner card to the grip.
[subroutine]Add an installed Runner card to the grip.
cards.flavor: Your first dog, your favorite food, your own mother's name. Your love, your hate, your fear. Hopes and dreams, pain and sorrow. All of it, everything, slips away.

cards.name: Tempus
cards.text:
While the Runner is accessing this upgrade in R&D, they must reveal it.
When the Runner accesses this upgrade anywhere except in Archives, Trace[3]. If successful, the Runner must lose [click][click] or suffer 1 core damage.

cards.name: Compile
cards.text: Make a run. The first time you encounter a piece of ice during this run, you may search your stack or heap for a program and install it, ignoring all costs. When the run ends, add that program to the bottom of your stack if it is still installed.

cards.name: Contaminate
cards.text: Place 3 virus counters on an installed Runner card with no hosted virus counters.
cards.flavor: "What kind of maniac infects their own rig?!"

cards.name: Embezzle
cards.text: Run HQ. If successful, instead of breaching HQ, name asset, ice, operation or upgrade, then reveal 2 cards from HQ at random. Trash each revealed card that has the named type, then gain 4[credit] for each card trashed this way.

cards.name: Envelope
cards.text:
[subroutine] Do 1 net damage.
[subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor: "On one hand, I knew I shouldn't touch it. On the other, it was really shiny." - Kabonesa Wu

cards.name: Freedom Khumalo: Crypto-Anarchist
cards.text: Access, once per turn → Any X virus counters: Trash the non-agenda card you are accessing. X must be equal to that card's rez or play cost.

cards.name: Gebrselassie
cards.text: [click]: Host this hardware on an installed non-AI icebreaker. Abilities that increase host icebreaker's strength last for the remainder of the turn (instead of any shorter duration).
cards.flavor: Go for distance.

cards.name: Intake
cards.text: While the Runner is accessing this upgrade in R&D, they must reveal it. When the Runner accesses this upgrade anywhere except in Archives, Trace[4]. If successful, add 1 installed program or virtual resource to the grip.

cards.name: Jackpot!
cards.text:
When your turn begins, you may place 1[credit] on Jackpot!.
Whenever an agenda is added to your score area, you may take any number of credits from Jackpot!. If you do, trash Jackpot!.
cards.flavor: "Jackpot!"

cards.name: Kamali 1.0
cards.text: Lose [click]: Break 1 subroutine on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability. [subroutine] Do 1 core damage unless the Runner trashes 1 installed resource. [subroutine] Do 1 core damage unless the Runner trashes 1 installed piece of hardware. [subroutine] Do 1 core damage unless the Runner trashes 1 installed program.

cards.name: Laamb
cards.text: Once per turn → When you encounter a piece of ice, you may pay 2[credit]. If you do, it gains barrier for the remainder of that encounter. Interface → 2[credit]: Break any number of barrier subroutines. 3[credit]: +6 strength.

cards.name: Logic Bomb
cards.text: [trash]: Bypass a piece of ice you are currently encountering. Lose any remaining clicks.
cards.flavor: "Could God create a stone so heavy, He could not lift it?"

cards.name: Masvingo
cards.text:
You can advance this ice.
When you rez this ice, place 1 advancement counter on it.
This ice gains "[subroutine] End the run." for each hosted advancement counter.
cards.flavor: No matter which direction ze climbed, the blocks reshuffled, zipping in from left to right, bottom to top. It was going to be a long hike.

cards.name: Mwanza City Grid
cards.text: Root of HQ or R&D only. Whenever the Runner breaches this server, they access 3 additional cards. When the breach ends, gain 2[credit] for each time the Runner accessed a card during that breach. Limit 1 region per server.

cards.name: Overseer Matrix
cards.text: Persistent → Whenever the Runner trashes a card from this server or its root, you may pay 1[credit] to give the Runner 1 tag. (If the Runner trashes this card while accessing it, this ability still applies for the remainder of this run.)
cards.flavor: The blast doesn't hurt, but what comes after does.

cards.name: Remote Enforcement
cards.text: When you score Remote Enforcement, you may search R&D for a piece of ice, install it protecting a remote server (paying its install cost), and rez it, ignoring its rez cost, then shuffle R&D.

cards.name: Slipstream
cards.text: Whenever you pass a rezzed piece of ice, you may trash this resource. If you do, choose 1 piece of ice protecting a central server in the same position as the passed ice. Move to that ice and approach it. You may jack out.
cards.flavor: Filaments occasionally flare from the Network, manifesting ephemeral threads between random domains.

cards.name: Standard Procedure
cards.text:
Play only if the Runner made a successful run during their last turn.
Choose a card type, then reveal the grip. Gain 2[credit] for each card of the chosen type revealed this way.

cards.name: Trypano
cards.text:
Install only on a piece of ice.
When your turn begins, you may place 1 virus counter on this program.
When there are 5 or more hosted virus counters, trash host ice.
cards.flavor: Twisting, writhing, ripping into all that it touches.

cards.name: Viral Weaponization
cards.text: When the turn on which you scored Viral Weaponization ends, do 1 net damage for each card in the grip.
cards.flavor: Quicker and deadlier than ever imagined, the trial was an outstanding success.

cards.name: Warden Fatuma
cards.text: Each rezzed piece of bioroid ice gains "[subroutine] The Runner loses [click]." before its other subroutines.
cards.flavor: "It's neither cruel nor unusual. Merely efficient."

cards.name: Amina
cards.text: Interface → 2[credit]: Break up to 3 code gate subroutines. 2[credit]: +3 strength. The first time each turn this program fully breaks a piece of ice, the Corp loses 1[credit].
cards.flavor: Her gallop, thunder; her blade, lightning.

cards.name: Better Citizen Program
cards.text: The first time the Runner plays a run event or installs an icebreaker program each turn, you may give the Runner 1 tag.
cards.flavor: "Deep down, everyone wants to be good. We ensure that desire is met." - Taavi Gyula

cards.name: Black Hat
cards.text: The Corp must trace[4]. If unsuccessful, for the remainder of the turn, access 2 additional cards whenever you breach HQ or R&D.
cards.flavor: "The way I see it, I'm teaching them a lesson in the importance of basic security." - Sunny Lebeau

cards.name: Diversion of Funds
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this event, spend [click].
Run HQ. If successful, instead of breaching HQ, you may force the Corp to lose up to 5[credit], then you gain 1[credit] for each credit lost.

cards.name: Engolo
cards.text: Once per turn → When you encounter a piece of ice, you may pay 2[credit]. If you do, it gains code gate for the remainder of that encounter. Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 code gate subroutine. 2[credit]: +4 strength.

cards.name: False Flag
cards.text: False Flag can be advanced. When the Runner accesses False Flag, give the Runner 1 tag for every 2 advancement tokens on False Flag. [click], 7 hosted advancement tokens: add False Flag to your score area as an agenda worth 3 agenda points.

cards.name: Flame-out
cards.text:
Flame-out can host a single program.
When you install Flame-out, place 9[credit] on it. Use these credits to pay for using hosted program.
When a turn ends in which you used credits on Flame-out, trash hosted program.

cards.name: High-Profile Target
cards.text:
Play only if the Runner is tagged.
Do 2 meat damage for each tag the Runner has.
cards.flavor: "You can't do thi..."

cards.name: Hippo
cards.text: The first time each turn you fully break the outermost piece of ice protecting the attacked server during a run, you may remove this hardware from the game to trash that ice.
cards.flavor: Getting it up the stairs was enough for him to know that if he ever moved, it was staying.

cards.name: Kasi String
cards.text:
The first time each turn a successful run on a remote server ends, if you breached the server but stole no agendas, you may place 1 power counter on this resource.
When this resource has 4 or more hosted power counters, add it to your score area as an agenda worth 1 agenda point.

cards.name: Market Forces
cards.text:
Play only if the Runner is tagged.
The Runner loses 3[credit] for each tag they have, then you gain 1[credit] for each credit lost this way.
cards.flavor: "Once we have enough data, we can make the Invisible Hand more like an Invisible Fist."

cards.name: Mlinzi
cards.text:
[subroutine] Do 1 net damage unless the Runner trashes the top 2 cards of the stack.
[subroutine] Do 2 net damage unless the Runner trashes the top 3 cards of the stack.
[subroutine] Do 3 net damage unless the Runner trashes the top 4 cards of the stack.

cards.name: Mti Mwekundu: Life Improved
cards.text: Once per turn → When the Runner approaches a server, you may install 1 piece of ice from HQ in the innermost position protecting that server, ignoring all costs. The Runner moves to that ice and approaches it. If this is not the first time they have approached ice this run, they may jack out.

cards.name: Musaazi
cards.text: Whenever you make a successful run, you may place 1 virus counter on this program. Interface → Any virus counter: Break sentry subroutine. Any virus counter: +1 strength.

cards.name: NEXT Diamond
cards.text: The rez cost of this ice is lowered by 1[credit] for each other rezzed piece of NEXT ice. [subroutine] Do 1 core damage. [subroutine] Do 1 core damage. [subroutine] Trash 1 installed Runner card.
cards.flavor: Defenses that last forever.

cards.name: PAD Tap
cards.text:
The first time the Corp gains credits through a card ability each turn, you may gain 1[credit].
[click], 3[credit]: Trash PAD Tap. Only the Corp can use this ability.
cards.flavor:
"You called me, sir?"
"Why does my PAD keep flashing 'Sensitive Information Transfer'?!"
"Hmm, that's strange. Mine only does that on Tuesdays."

cards.name: Reclaim
cards.text: [click], [trash], trash a card from your grip: Install a program, piece of hardware, or virtual resource from your heap, paying its install cost.
cards.flavor: It was a deal, to be sure. She just didn't know for which party.

cards.name: Riot Suppression
cards.text:
Play only if the Runner trashed a Corp card during their last turn.
The Runner may suffer 1 core damage. If they do not, they get -3 allotted [click] for their next turn.
Remove this operation from the game.

cards.name: Surveyor
cards.text:
X is twice the number of ice protecting this server.
[subroutine]Trace[X]. If successful, give the Runner 2 tags.
[subroutine]Trace[X]. If successful, end the run.
cards.flavor:
INTRUDER ALERT!
INTRUDER ALERT!
INTRUDER NEUTRALIZED!

cards.name: Zer0
cards.text: Once per turn → [click], suffer 1 net damage: Gain 1[credit] and draw 2 cards.
cards.flavor: Eat. Code. Sleep. Eat. Code. Sleep. Eat. Code. Eat. Code. Sleep. Eat. Code. Code. Sleep. Code. Code. Code. Eat. Code. Code. Code. Code. Code. Code.

cards.name: API-S Keeper Isobel
cards.text: When your turn begins, you may remove an advancement token from an installed card to gain 3[credit].
cards.flavor: "Supersedure is all part of our scheduled maintenance."

cards.name: Acme Consulting: The Truth You Need
cards.text: The Runner is considered to have 1 additional tag (even if they have 0) during encounters with the outermost piece of ice protecting any server.

cards.name: Akiko Nisei: Head Case
cards.text: Whenever you breach R&D, you and the Corp secretly spend 0[credit], 1[credit], or 2[credit]. Reveal spent credits. If you and the Corp spent the same number of credits, access 1 additional card.

cards.name: Algernon
cards.text: When your turn begins, you may pay 2[credit] to gain [click]. If you do, trash Algernon when your turn ends if you did not make a successful run this turn.
cards.flavor: "When we're together, I feel like I can do anything!"

cards.name: Arella Salvatore
cards.text: Whenever an agenda is scored from this server, you may install a card from HQ, ignoring all costs, and place 1 advancement token on it.
cards.flavor: "Cheers, Philbert."

cards.name: Attitude Adjustment
cards.text: Draw 2 cards. Reveal up to 2 agendas in HQ and/or Archives. Gain 2[credit] for each agenda revealed, then shuffle those agendas into R&D.
cards.flavor: "Good news, ma'am. The compliance training was completed with little resistance."

cards.name: Bankroll
cards.text:
Whenever you make a successful run, you may place 1[credit] from the bank on Bankroll.
[trash]: Take all credits from Bankroll.
cards.flavor:
"With the rise of crypto, banking has become much more complicated. Financial crime has not only kept pace, but exploded exponentially."
-After the Flash: A History of the War-That-Wasn't

cards.name: Blockchain
cards.text: This ice gains "[subroutine] Gain 1[credit] and the Runner loses 1[credit]." before its other subroutines for every 2 faceup transaction operations in Archives. [subroutine] Gain 1[credit] and the Runner loses 1[credit]. [subroutine] End the run.

cards.name: Broad Daylight
cards.text: When you score this agenda, you may take 1 bad publicity. Place 1 agenda counter on this agenda for each bad publicity you have. Once per turn → [click], hosted agenda counter: Do 2 meat damage.

cards.name: Building Blocks
cards.text: Reveal a barrier from HQ. Install and rez it, ignoring all costs.
cards.flavor: "It looks like a mistake but I'm pretty sure they leave the gaps on purpose." -Gnat

cards.name: Cradle
cards.text: This program gets -1 strength for each card in your grip. Interface → 2[credit]: Break any number of code gate subroutines.
cards.flavor: ... clack... clack... clack...

cards.name: DJ Fenris
cards.text: Host a g-mod identity that does not match the faction of your identity on DJ Fenris when he is installed. Remove hosted identity from the game if DJ Fenris is uninstalled. DJ Fenris gains the text of hosted identity. Limit 1 per deck.

cards.name: Daruma
cards.text: When the Runner approaches this server, you may trash this upgrade. If you do, choose 1 card in the root of another server or 1 agenda, asset, or upgrade in HQ. Swap that card with 1 card in the root of this server. If you swap cards this way, the Runner may jack out.

cards.name: District 99
cards.text: The first time each turn a program or a piece of hardware is trashed (from any location), you may place 1 power counter on District 99. [click], 3 hosted power counters: Add a card that matches the faction of your identity from your heap to your grip.
cards.flavor: Another man's treasure.

cards.name: Divert Power
cards.text: Derez any number of cards. You may rez a card, lowering its rez cost by 3 for each card that you derezzed this way.
cards.flavor: If that doesn't work, try reversing the polarity.

cards.name: Divide and Conquer
cards.text: Run Archives. If successful, after breaching Archives, breach HQ, then breach R&D. You cannot access cards in the root of HQ or R&D during these breaches.
cards.flavor: All roads lead to Rome.

cards.name: Drudge Work
cards.text: Place 3 power counters on Drudge Work when it is rezzed. When there are no power counters left on Drudge Work, trash it. [click], hosted power counter: Reveal an agenda in HQ or Archives. Gain credits equal to its agenda points, then shuffle it into R&D.

cards.name: Eavesdrop
cards.text: Install Eavesdrop on a piece of ice as a hosted condition counter with the text "Whenever the Runner encounters host ice, Trace[3]. If successful, give the Runner 1 tag."
cards.flavor: "No, the audio is fine. It just never seems to turn off."

cards.name: Fast Break
cards.text: Gain X[credit]. Draw up to X cards. Install up to X cards in the root of and/or protecting a single remote server. X is equal to the number of agendas in the Runner's score area.
cards.flavor: "Oh, my! He's on fire!"

cards.name: Fly on the Wall
cards.text: When you score Fly on the Wall, give the Runner 1 tag.
cards.flavor: Only half as annoying as the real thing.

cards.name: Formicary
cards.text:
Whenever the Runner approaches a server, you may rez this ice. If you do, move this ice to the innermost position protecting the approached server. The Runner moves to this ice and encounters it.
[subroutine] End the run unless the Runner suffers 2 net damage.
cards.flavor: A place of decay and death, a plane out of phase, a place of monsters.

cards.name: Game Changer
cards.text: Gain [click] for each agenda in the Runner's score area. Remove Game Changer from the game instead of trashing it.
cards.flavor: Coach Walden's pep talks were renowned for improving in direct proportion to the amount by which his team was losing.

cards.name: Gatekeeper
cards.text:
Gatekeeper has +6 strength if you rezzed it this turn.
[subroutine] Draw up to 3 cards. Reveal up to 3 agendas in HQ and/or Archives, then shuffle those agendas into R&D.
[subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor: Banana who?

cards.name: Giordano Memorial Field
cards.text: Whenever the Runner makes a successful run on this server, end the run unless they pay 2[credit] for each agenda in their score area.
cards.flavor: The world changed. Concession prices did not.

cards.name: Guinea Pig
cards.text:
Trash your grip.
Gain 10[credit].
cards.flavor: "Worth it."

cards.name: Hangeki
cards.text:
Play only if the Runner trashed a Corp card during their last turn and you have at least 1 installed card.
Choose 1 of your installed cards. The Runner may access that card. If they do, remove this operation from the game; otherwise, add this operation to the Runner's score area as an agenda worth -1 agenda point.

cards.name: Hijacked Router
cards.text:
Whenever the Corp creates a server, they lose 1[credit].
Whenever you make a successful run on Archives, you may trash this hardware. If you do, the Corp loses 3[credit].

cards.name: Hot Pursuit
cards.text: Make a run on HQ. If successful, gain 9[credit] and take 1 tag.
cards.flavor: "We have you surrounded! For real, this time."

cards.name: Hydra
cards.text:
[subroutine] Do 3 net damage if the Runner is tagged; otherwise, give the Runner 1 tag.
[subroutine] Gain 5[credit] if the Runner is tagged; otherwise, give the Runner 1 tag.
[subroutine] End the run if the Runner is tagged; otherwise, give the Runner 1 tag.

cards.name: Hyperloop Extension
cards.text: When Hyperloop Extension is scored or stolen, the Corp gains 3[credit].
cards.flavor: "Our analysis shows significant support from both the public and private sectors."

cards.name: Ika
cards.text: 2[credit]: Host this program on a piece of ice. Interface → 1[credit]: Break up to 2 subroutines on host sentry. 2[credit]: +3 strength.
cards.flavor: "Running is all metaphor, all symbols and plumbing into the depths of the psyche. Sometimes that means tentacles." -Akiko Nisei

cards.name: Insight
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this event, spend [click].
The Corp may look at the top 4 cards of R&D and arrange them in any order.
Reveal the top 4 cards of R&D.

cards.name: Jumon
cards.text: When your turn ends, place 2 advancement counters on 1 card in the root of a remote server.
cards.flavor: "Jumon, all too Jumon..."

cards.name: Kyuban
cards.text:
Install only on a piece of ice.
Whenever you pass host ice, gain 2[credit].
cards.flavor: The journey is its own reward.

cards.name: Lady Liberty
cards.text: When your turn begins, place 1 power counter on Lady Liberty. [click], [click], [click]: Add an agenda from HQ to your score area worth agenda points equal to the exact number of hosted power counters. Limit 1 region per server. Limit 1 per deck.

cards.name: Liza Talking Thunder: Prominent Legislator
cards.text: The first time you make a successful run on a central server each turn, draw 2 cards and take 1 tag.
cards.flavor: "You think you're the first to come after me?"

cards.name: Meridian
cards.text: [subroutine] Gain 4[credit] and end the run unless the Runner adds this ice to their score area as an agenda worth -1 agenda point.
cards.flavor: You don't cross it—it crosses you.

cards.name: Mind's Eye
cards.text: +1[mu] Whenever you make a successful run on R&D, you may place 1 power counter on this hardware. [click], 3 hosted power counters: Breach R&D. You cannot access cards in the root of R&D during this breach. Limit 1 console per player.

cards.name: Miss Bones
cards.text:
Place 12[credit] from the bank on Miss Bones when she is installed. When there are no credits left on Miss Bones, trash her.
Use these credits to trash installed cards.
cards.flavor: "If I can't kill it, I know who can."

cards.name: Mâché
cards.text: The first time you trash an accessed card each turn, you may place power counters on Mâché equal to that card's trash cost. 3 hosted power counters: Draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: "What are you making?" "What aren't I making?"

cards.name: Nathaniel "Gnat" Hall: One-of-a-Kind
cards.text: When your turn begins, gain 1[credit] if you have 2 or fewer cards in your grip.
cards.flavor: "Damn, I'm good."

cards.name: Neurostasis
cards.text:
Neurostasis can be advanced.
If you pay 3[credit] when the Runner accesses Neurostasis, choose 1 installed Runner card for each advancement token on Neurostasis. The Runner must shuffle the chosen cards into the stack.

cards.name: Office Supplies
cards.text:
Reduce the play cost of Office Supplies by 1 for each [link] you have.
Gain 4[credit] or draw 4 cards.
cards.flavor: "So, Miriam, hear anything good lately?"

cards.name: Otoroshi
cards.text: [subroutine] You may place up to 3 advancement counters on 1 card installed in the root of a remote server. If you do, the Runner accesses that card unless they pay 3[credit].
cards.flavor: "If the sysop offers you a link, it's because they want you to go there. But if you wanted to go where the sysop suggested, you wouldn't be trying to break in at all." -How Not to Get Fragged

cards.name: Paragon
cards.text: +1[mu] The first time you make a successful run each turn, you may gain 1[credit] and look at the top card of your stack. If you do, you may add that card to the bottom of your stack. Limit 1 console per player.

cards.name: Patchwork
cards.text: +1[mu] [interrupt], once per turn → When you would play or install a card, you may trash 1 card from your grip. If you do, instead play or install that card paying 2[credit] less. Limit 1 console per player.

cards.name: Peeping Tom
cards.text: When the Runner encounters this ice, choose a card type, then reveal all cards in the grip. For the remainder of this run, this ice gains "[subroutine] End the run unless the Runner takes 1 tag." for each revealed card of the chosen type.
cards.flavor: "I lost the staring contest. And all seven rematches." -Kabonesa Wu

cards.name: Psych Mike
cards.text: The first time each turn a successful run on R&D ends, you may gain 1[credit] for each time you accessed a card in R&D during that run.
cards.flavor:
"Breathe, girl. Breathe." Mike flickered into focus as she brushed Akiko's tears away. "What did you see?"
"I..." Akiko hesitated. "Everything."

cards.name: Reboot
cards.text:
Run Archives. If successful, instead of breaching Archives, install up to 5 cards from your heap facedown.
Remove this event from the game.
cards.flavor: I LIVE AGAIN

cards.name: SIU
cards.text: When your turn begins, you may trash SIU to Trace[3]. If successful, give the Runner 1 tag.
cards.flavor:
"What's so special about the Special Investigations Unit?"
"Their budget, for starters."

cards.name: Saraswati Mnemonics: Endless Exploration
cards.text: [click], 1[credit]: Install 1 card from HQ in the root of a remote server, then place 1 advancement counter on it. You cannot score or rez that card until your next turn begins.

cards.name: Sportsmetal: Go Big or Go Home
cards.text: Whenever an agenda is scored or stolen, gain 2[credit] or draw 2 cards.
cards.flavor: Want It More.

cards.name: The Outfit: Family Owned and Operated
cards.text: Whenever you take 1 or more bad publicity, gain 3[credit].
cards.flavor: We do things our way.

cards.name: Thimblerig
cards.text:
When your turn begins and whenever the Runner passes this ice, you may swap this ice with another installed piece of ice.
[subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor: Step right up!

cards.name: Thunder Art Gallery
cards.text: The first time you avoid or remove a tag each turn, you may install a card from your grip, lowering its install cost by 1.
cards.flavor: A classy alibi.

cards.name: Too Big to Fail
cards.text:
Play only if you have less than 10[credit].
Gain 7[credit] and take 1 bad publicity.
cards.flavor: "This is blackmail!" "No, this is extortion."

cards.name: Tycoon
cards.text: Interface → 1[credit]: Break up to 2 barrier subroutines. 2[credit]: +3 strength. Whenever an encounter ends, if you used this program to break a subroutine during that encounter, the Corp gains 2[credit].
cards.flavor:
"Any piece of ice is really just a paywall."
-Liza Talking Thunder

cards.name: Under the Bus
cards.text: Play only if the Runner accessed a card during their last turn. Trash 1 installed connection resource and take 1 bad publicity.

cards.name: Border Control
cards.text:
[trash]: End the run. Use this ability only during a run on this server.
[subroutine] Gain 1[credit] for each piece of ice protecting this server.
[subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor: Designed by 2016 World Champion Chris Dyer

cards.name: Crowdfunding
cards.text:
When you install this resource, load 3[credit] onto it. When it is empty, trash it and draw 1 card.
When your turn begins, take 1[credit] from this resource.
When your turn ends, if you made at least 3 successful runs this turn and this card is in your heap, you may install it, ignoring all costs.
cards.flavor: Designed by 2017 GenCon Champion Sam Suied

cards.name: Embolus
cards.text: When your turn begins, you may pay 1[credit] to place 1 power counter on this upgrade. Whenever the Runner makes a successful run, remove 1 power counter from this upgrade. Hosted power counter: End the run. Use this ability only during a run on this server.
cards.flavor: Designed by 2016 GenCon Champion Dan D'Argenio

cards.name: Hired Help
cards.text:
As an additional cost to run this server, the Runner must trash 1 agenda from their score area. Ignore this ability if the Runner made a successful run on HQ this turn.
Limit 1 per deck.
cards.flavor: Designed by the Day 1B players at Magnum Opus

cards.name: Labor Rights
cards.text: Trash the top 3 cards of your stack. Shuffle 3 cards from your heap into your stack. Draw 1 card. Remove this event from the game instead of trashing it.
cards.flavor: Designed by 2017 European Champion Mike Sheehan

cards.name: Slot Machine
cards.text:
When the Runner encounters this ice, they put the top card of the stack on the bottom, then you reveal the top 3 cards of the stack.
[subroutine] The Runner loses 3[credit].
[subroutine] If you revealed 2 or more cards that share a type when this encounter began, gain 3[credit].
[subroutine] If you revealed 3 or more cards that share a type when this encounter began, place 3 advancement tokens on an installed card.
cards.flavor: Designed by 2017 World Champion Jess Horig

cards.name: Timely Public Release
cards.text: When you score this agenda, place 1 agenda counter on it. Hosted agenda counter: Install 1 piece of ice from HQ or Archives in any position protecting a server, ignoring all costs.
cards.flavor: Designed by 2015 World Champion Dan D'Argenio

cards.name: Watch the World Burn
cards.text:
After you resolve this event, end your action phase.
Make a run on a remote server. If successful, remove the first non-agenda card that you access from the game.
Until the game ends, whenever you access a copy of that card, remove it from the game.
Limit 1 per deck.
cards.flavor: Designed by the Day 1A players at Magnum Opus

cards.name: Cyber Bureau: Keeping the Peace
cards.text:
You draw a starting hand of 10 cards.
Before taking your first turn, install up to 5 cards, ignoring all install costs. Rez any number of them, lowering the total rez cost among all cards by 20. Flip this identity.
Detective's Bureau: Upholding the Law
The first time the Runner initiates a run each turn, force the Runner to lose 1[credit] for each agenda point in his or her score area, then you gain 1[credit] for each credit lost.
[click]: Gain 3[credit] or draw 3 cards.

cards.name: Afshar
cards.text:
While this ice is protecting HQ, the Runner cannot break more than 1 of its printed subroutines during each encounter.
[subroutine] The Runner loses 2[credit].
[subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor: A choice occurs. The waveform collapses.

cards.name: Always Have a Backup Plan
cards.text: Run any server. When that run ends, if it was unsuccessful, you may run the attacked server again, ignoring any additional costs to run. During the second run, whenever you encounter the last piece of ice you encountered during the first run, bypass it.
cards.flavor:
“Everyone told me she was reliable in a pinch.”
—Az McCaffrey

cards.name: Architect Deployment Test
cards.text: When you score this agenda, look at the top 5 cards of R&D. You may install and rez 1 of those cards, ignoring all costs.
cards.flavor:
“Early success should be rewarded, as it will encourage a culture of drive and competition.”
—Corporate Leadership for Dummies

cards.name: Az McCaffrey: Mechanical Prodigy
cards.text: The first job resource, connection resource, or piece of hardware you install each turn costs 1[credit] less to install.
cards.flavor: “You’re not listening.”

cards.name: Blueberry!™ Diesel
cards.text: Look at the top 2 cards of your stack. You may add 1 of those cards to the bottom of your stack. Draw 2 cards.
cards.flavor: Blue flames burn the hottest!

cards.name: Bukhgalter
cards.text: Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 sentry subroutine. 1[credit]: +1 strength. The first time each turn this program fully breaks a piece of ice, gain 2[credit].
cards.flavor:
“Do the job. Get paid. Leave feelings at the door.”
—“Baklan” Bochkin

cards.name: CSR Campaign
cards.text: When your turn begins, you may draw 1 card.
cards.flavor:
“By matching funds on your donations, the Space Elevator Authority has already planted over eight million trees on the Pacific coast. Together we can restore New Angeles to its former glory.”
—Elizabeth Mills

cards.name: Calvin B4L3Y
cards.text: Once per turn → [click]: Draw 2 cards. When the Runner trashes this asset, you may draw 2 cards.
cards.flavor: Unit is holding .78 asimovs of stress potential in all three directive logic traps. Psychiatric session mandated during next maintenance cycle.

cards.name: Chisel
cards.text:
Install only on a piece of ice.
Host ice gets −1 strength for each hosted virus counter.
Whenever you encounter host ice, if its strength is 0 or less, trash it. Otherwise, place 1 virus counter on this program.
cards.flavor: *tap* *tap* *tap*

cards.name: Climactic Showdown
cards.text: When your turn begins, remove this resource from the game. Choose a server protected by ice. The Corp may trash 1 piece of ice protecting that server. If they do not, the first time this turn you breach either R&D or HQ, access 2 additional cards.

cards.name: Cold Site Server
cards.text: [click]: Place 1 power counter on this upgrade. As an additional cost to run this server, the Runner must spend [click] and 1[credit] for each hosted power counter. When your turn begins, remove all hosted power counters.
cards.flavor: The Net abhors a vacuum. Any unexplained gap must be made.

cards.name: Complete Image
cards.text:
Play only if the Runner has 3 or more agenda points and they made a successful run during their last turn.
After you resolve this operation, your action phase ends.
Choose a card name, then do 1 net damage. If you trash a card with the chosen name this way, repeat this process.

cards.name: Congratulations!
cards.text:
When the Runner passes this ice, gain 1[credit].
[subroutine] Gain 2[credit]. The Runner gains 1[credit].
cards.flavor: You are the ONE BILLIONTH visitor!

cards.name: Daily Quest
cards.text:
Rez only during your action phase.
Whenever the Runner makes a successful run on this server, they gain 2[credit].
When your turn begins, if the Runner did not make a successful run on this server during their last turn, gain 3[credit].

cards.name: Demolisher
cards.text: +1[mu] The trash cost of each Corp card is lowered by 1[credit]. The first time each turn you trash a Corp card, gain 1[credit]. Limit 1 console per player.
cards.flavor:
Step 1: Apply to Problem.
Step 2: No more Problem!

cards.name: Direct Access
cards.text:
While you are resolving this event, each playerʼs identity loses all abilities.
Run any server. When that run ends, you may shuffle this event into your stack.
cards.flavor: Get into the ducts on the roof and keep crawling till you hit that old network root. Dirty work, I know, but it beats playing by the rules.

cards.name: Divested Trust
cards.text: Whenever the Runner steals another agenda, you may forfeit this agenda to gain 5[credit] and add the stolen agenda to HQ.
cards.flavor: As the documents show, for eight months they have operated as an entirely independent fiscal entity. We are as appalled at the carelessness as you are, and fully support City Hall’s investigation.

cards.name: Fencer Fueno
cards.text:
When your turn begins and whenever you steal an agenda, place 1[credit] on this resource.
Whenever you make a successful run, you can spend hosted credits for the remainder of that run.
When your turn ends, if there are 3 or more hosted credits, you must pay 1[credit] or trash this resource.
cards.flavor: Friends break your walls.

cards.name: Flip Switch
cards.text: Use this hardware only during your turn. [trash]: Jack out. [trash]: Remove 1 tag. [interrupt] → [trash]: Reduce the base trace strength of a trace to 0.
cards.flavor: BMI switches let runners surface without a true disconnect. Handy for a break… immediately.

cards.name: Focus Group
cards.text:
Play only if the Runner made a successful run during their last turn.
Choose a card type, then reveal the grip. Choose a value for X equal to or less than the number of revealed cards of the chosen type. You may pay X[credit] to place X advancement counters on 1 installed card.
cards.flavor: “There’s gonna be catering, right?”

cards.name: Fully Operational
cards.text: Gain 2[credit] or draw 2 cards. Repeat this process for each remote server that has a card in its root and is protected by ice.
cards.flavor: Haas’ unsecured servers were fortified just before the storm. Are their bioroid oracles that good, or were they tipped off?

cards.name: Game Over
cards.text: Play only if the Runner stole an agenda during their last turn. Choose a Runner card type. Trash all installed non-icebreaker cards of the chosen type. For each card that would be trashed this way, the Runner may pay 3[credit] to prevent that card from being trashed. Take 1 bad publicity.
cards.flavor: It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a Troll.

cards.name: Gauss
cards.text: When you install this program, it gets +3 strength for the remainder of the turn. Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 barrier subroutine. 2[credit]: +2 strength.
cards.flavor: It is not knowledge, but the act of learning, not possession, but the act of getting there, which grants the greatest enjoyment.

cards.name: Hagen
cards.text: This ice gets −1 strength for each installed icebreaker. [subroutine] Trash 1 installed program that is not a decoder, fracter, or killer. [subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor: Old warriors have seen all the tricks; be forthright or fail.

cards.name: Hyoubu Institute: Absolute Clarity
cards.text: The first time each turn you reveal a card, gain 1[credit]. [click]: Reveal 1 card from the grip at random or the top card of the stack.
cards.flavor: No Stone Unturned.

cards.name: In the Groove
cards.text:
Play only as your first [click].
For the remainder of this turn, whenever you install a card with a printed install cost of 1[credit] or greater, draw 1 card or gain 1[credit].
cards.flavor: Do you know how many food deliveries I’ve missed this week?

cards.name: Increased Drop Rates
cards.text:
While the Runner is accessing this upgrade in R&D, they must reveal it.
When the Runner accesses this upgrade, remove 1 bad publicity unless they take 1 tag.
cards.flavor: Ultra-Mythic chance ↑!↑!↑! Free Vorpal Tommy Gun [epic] and pinstripe suit [cosmetic] with 10× buy-in!

cards.name: Isolation
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this event, trash 1 installed resource.
Gain 7[credit].
cards.flavor: With each passing day alone, Hoshiko found it harder to think. With each hour, the static grew louder.

cards.name: Khusyuk
cards.text: Run R&D. If successful, instead of breaching R&D, choose an install cost greater than 0[credit]. The Corp sets aside the top X cards of R&D faceup, where X is equal to the number of your installed cards with that printed install cost, up to 6. Access 1 of the set-aside cards. The Corp shuffles the set-aside cards into R&D.

cards.name: Lat: Ethical Freelancer
cards.text: When your discard phase ends, if you have the same number of cards in your grip as the Corp has in HQ, you may draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Letʼs do it fast fast, then back to mine for tuak.

cards.name: Letheia Nisei
cards.text: The first time the Runner approaches this server during each run, play a Psi Game. (Players secretly bid 0–2[credit]. Then each player reveals and spends their bid.) If the bids differ, you may trash this upgrade. If you do, the Runner moves to the outermost position of this server. They may jack out.

cards.name: Loot Box
cards.text:
[subroutine] End the run unless the Runner pays 2[credit].
[subroutine] Reveal the top 3 cards of the stack. Add 1 of those cards to the grip and gain X[credit], where X is equal to that cardʼs play or install cost. The Runner shuffles the stack. Trash this ice.
cards.flavor: Though many countries attempted to regulate digital loot boxes in the early 21st century, GameNET has managed to circumvent any such laws via explicit, transparent percentage rates… and some very determined lobbyists.

cards.name: Lucky Charm
cards.text: [interrupt] → Remove this hardware from the game: Prevent a Corp card ability from ending the run. Use this ability only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn.
cards.flavor: Want to win a coinflip? Use a coin with two heads.

cards.name: Masterwork (v37)
cards.text: +1[mu] The first time each turn you install a piece of hardware, draw 1 card. Whenever a run begins, you may install 1 piece of hardware from your grip, paying 1[credit] more. Limit 1 console per player.
cards.flavor:
v35: Springs to the mount ejectors (new feature)
v36: Reduced power to springs (×5)

cards.name: MirrorMorph: Endless Iteration
cards.text: If the first, second, and third actions you take on your turn are each different from one another, when the third action completes, you may gain 1[credit] or take another different action, paying [click] less.
cards.flavor: Reflection, Not Imitation.

cards.name: Nanoetching Matrix
cards.text: Once per turn → [click]: Gain 2[credit]. When the Runner trashes this asset, you may gain 2[credit].
cards.flavor: At the scale where nanobots cut glass, quantum mechanics dictate error. A silicon atom here, an oxygen there, an erbium out of place. Each bioroid is born unique.

cards.name: Pelangi
cards.text: When you install this program, place 2 virus counters on it. Once per turn → Hosted virus counter: Choose an ice subtype. The ice you are encountering gains that subtype for the remainder of this encounter.
cards.flavor: It makes sysops see red. And orange, yellow, green…

cards.name: Project Yagi-Uda
cards.text: When you score this agenda, place 1 agenda counter on it for each hosted advancement counter past 3. Hosted agenda counter: Swap 1 card from HQ with 1 card in the root of or protecting the attacked server. The Runner may jack out. Use this ability only during a run.

cards.name: Public Health Portal
cards.text: When your turn begins, reveal the top card of R&D and gain 2[credit].
cards.flavor: Hyoubu is our vanguard in the battle for hearts and minds.

cards.name: Red Level Clearance
cards.text:
Resolve 2 of the following in any order:
  • Draw 2 cards.
  • Gain 2[credit].
  • Install 1 non-agenda card from HQ.
  • Gain [click].
cards.flavor: Not all secrets lie in vaults.

cards.name: Reduced Service
cards.text:
When you rez this upgrade, you may pay up to 4[credit] to place that many power counters on it.
As an additional cost to run this server, the Runner must pay 2[credit] for each hosted power counter.
Whenever the Runner makes a successful run on a central server, remove 1 hosted power counter.

cards.name: Rejig
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this event, add 1 installed program or piece of hardware to your grip.
Install 1 program or piece of hardware from your grip, paying X[credit] less. X is equal to the printed install cost of the card you added to your grip.
cards.flavor: I didn’t say your hopper should be hauling garbage. I said it should be hauled away as garbage.

cards.name: Remastered Edition
cards.text: When you score this agenda, place 1 agenda counter on it. Hosted agenda counter: Place 1 advancement counter on an installed card.
cards.flavor:
Scrub-loving devs nerfed cannon rushes cause whiny bronzers complained. Left me four wins down in finals.
Anyway I won.

cards.name: Rezeki
cards.text: When your turn begins, gain 1[credit].
cards.flavor:
“It takes such simple things to sustain us, the most important of which is to be thankful.”
—Lat

cards.name: Rime
cards.text:
During runs against this server, you can rez this ice any time you could rez non-ice cards.
Each piece of ice protecting this server gets +1 strength.
[subroutine] The Runner loses 1[credit].

cards.name: Roughneck Repair Squad
cards.text: [click][click][click]: Gain 6[credit]. You may remove 1 bad publicity.
cards.flavor:
“There’s something about the human touch that androids will never replace.”
—Mila Braun

cards.name: SDS Drone Deployment
cards.text:
As an additional cost to steal this agenda, the Runner must trash 1 installed program.
When you score this agenda, trash 1 installed program.
cards.flavor:
“Drones are precision instruments. Collateral damage is merely an undisclosed target.”
—Chief “Pinchy” Wilson

cards.name: Saisentan
cards.text:
When the Runner encounters this ice, choose a card type. For the remainder of the encounter, whenever you trash a card of the chosen type with net damage from a subroutine on this ice, do 1 net damage.
[subroutine] Do 1 net damage.
[subroutine] Do 1 net damage.
[subroutine] Do 1 net damage.

cards.name: Sandstone
cards.text:
When the Runner encounters this ice, place 1 virus counter on it.
This ice gets −1 strength for each hosted virus counter.
[subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor: Effective, Cheap, Durable. Pick two.

cards.name: Secure and Protect
cards.text: As an additional cost to play this operation, spend [click]. Search R&D for 1 piece of ice and reveal it. (Shuffle R&D after searching it.) Install that ice protecting a central server, paying 3[credit] less.
cards.flavor:
Secure Servers. Contain Infections. Protect Data.
—The SecTech Mantra

cards.name: Spec Work
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this event, trash 1 installed program.
Gain 4[credit] and draw 2 cards.
cards.flavor:
“There is never a wasted program. Someone, somewhere, will have a use for that code. Even corps are scrambling for quick fixes nowadays.”
—Lat

cards.name: Stargate
cards.text: Once per turn → [click]: Run R&D. If successful, instead of breaching R&D, reveal the top 3 cards of R&D. Trash 1 of the revealed cards.
cards.flavor: “Net space is an abstraction, a white lie protecting fragile comprehensions. Do not limit yourself.” —z\h/r

cards.name: Sting!
cards.text: When a player scores or steals this agenda, do X net damage. X is equal to 1 plus the number of copies of Sting! in the other playerʼs score area.
cards.flavor:
“‘It is my nature,’ said the scorpion.”
—Conceptual Frameworks in Bio-Ethics and Synthetic Morality, Moser University Press

cards.name: Storgotic Resonator
cards.text: The first time each turn you trash a card that matches the faction of the Runnerʼs identity (from any location), place 1 power counter on this asset. [click], hosted power counter: Do 1 net damage.
cards.flavor:
“Memory is a tangle of emotional threads. Pull one, it twists a second, unravels a third!”
—Letheia Nisei

cards.name: Supercorridor
cards.text: +2[mu] You get +1 maximum hand size. When your turn ends, if you and the Corp have the same number of credits, you may gain 2[credit]. Limit 1 console per player.
cards.flavor: The Net is boundless, but the right access port is worth a road trip.

cards.name: The Artist
cards.text: Once per turn → [click]: Gain 2[credit]. Once per turn → [click]: Install 1 program or piece of hardware from your grip, paying 1[credit] less.
cards.flavor: “…then let me paint you a picture.”

cards.name: The Class Act
cards.text:
When a discard phase ends, if you installed this resource this turn, draw 4 cards.
[interrupt] → The first time each turn you would draw any number of cards, look at the top X cards of your stack. Add 1 of those cards to the bottom of your stack. X is equal to the number of cards you would draw plus 1.
cards.flavor: “…but I am without compare.”

cards.name: The Nihilist
cards.text: The first time each turn you install a virus program, place 2 virus counters on this resource. When your turn begins, you may remove any 2 virus counters from your installed cards. If you do, draw 2 cards unless the Corp trashes the top card of R&D.
cards.flavor: “…well, I’m laughing.”

cards.name: Tiered Subscription
cards.text: The first time each turn a run begins, gain 1[credit].
cards.flavor: Subscribe for 12 months to get that premium uplink you need to blaze ahead of the crowd!

cards.name: Trebuchet
cards.text:
When you rez this ice, take 1 bad publicity.
[subroutine] Trash 1 installed Runner card.
[subroutine] Trace[6]. If successful, the Runner cannot steal or trash Corp cards for the remainder of this run.

cards.name: Trickster Taka
cards.text:
When your turn begins and whenever you steal an agenda, place 1[credit] on this resource.
You can spend hosted credits to use programs during runs.
When your turn ends, if there are 3 or more hosted credits, you must take 1 tag or trash this resource.
cards.flavor: Friends hide your fears.

cards.name: Utae
cards.text: Interface → X[credit]: Break X code gate subroutines. Use this ability only once per run. Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 code gate subroutine. Use this ability only if you have 3 or more installed virtual resources. 1[credit]: +1 strength.
cards.flavor: Sing, sing as your heart desires!

cards.name: Vulnerability Audit
cards.text: You cannot score this agenda if it was installed this turn.
cards.flavor: The Fracture was no different from any other crisis. As always, Management’s first instinct was to find someone to blame. Getting food up to Midway or He3 down to power Earthside hospitals are trivialities compared to the important work of salving Executive ego and keeping one’s job.

cards.name: Whistleblower
cards.text: Whenever you make a successful run, you may trash this resource to choose a card name. The next time this run you access an agenda with the chosen name, steal it, ignoring all costs. (You are no longer accessing it.)
cards.flavor:
“Corporations are made of people; just normal people doing their 6-to-6. The right truths, the right critique, and they can be redeemed.”
—Lat

cards.name: “Baklan” Bochkin
cards.text: The first time you encounter a piece of ice during each run, place 1 power counter on this resource. [trash], X hosted power counters: Derez the ice you are encountering if its strength is X or less. Take 1 tag.
cards.flavor:
“Psh, let them gossip. The cat knows whose meat it has eaten.”
—“Baklan” Bochkin

cards.name: Cayambe Grid
cards.text: When your turn begins, place 1 advancement counter on a piece of ice protecting this server. Whenever the Runner approaches this server, end the run unless they pay 2[credit] for each advanced piece of ice protecting this server. Limit 1 region per server.
cards.flavor: The Apu spirits of the great mountains bridge this world and the realm above.

cards.name: Cybertrooper Talut
cards.text: +1[link] Whenever you install a non-AI icebreaker, that icebreaker gets +2 strength for the remainder of the turn.
cards.flavor: He's nice enough, but not when there are 5,187 of him.

cards.name: Digital Rights Management
cards.text: Play only if the Runner did not make a successful run on HQ during their last turn. Search R&D for 1 agenda and reveal it. (Shuffle R&D after searching it.) Add that agenda to HQ. You may install 1 card from HQ in the root of a remote server. You cannot score agendas for the remainder of the turn.

cards.name: La Costa Grid
cards.text: Remote server only. When your turn begins, place 1 advancement counter on a card in the root of this server. Limit 1 region per server.
cards.flavor: Some slums of New Angeles are so worn down, City Hall calls the acres of windowless clone barracks "gentrification" with a straight face.

cards.name: Megaprix Qualifier
cards.text:
When you score this agenda, if there is another copy of Megaprix Qualifier in either playerʼs score area, place 1 agenda counter on this agenda.
While this agenda has a hosted agenda counter, it is worth 1 more agenda point.
cards.flavor:
"Win Hard or Lose Hard. All that matters is they're talking about you and not the competition."
- Tan "Nitro" Nyugen, Toretto-Extreme Team Manager

cards.name: Mystic Maemi
cards.text:
When your turn begins and whenever you steal an agenda, place 1[credit] on this resource.
You can spend hosted credits to play events.
When your turn ends, if there are 3 or more hosted credits, you must trash 1 card from your grip at random or trash this resource.
cards.flavor: Friends lift your spirits.

cards.name: Swift
cards.text: +1[mu] The first time each turn you play a run event, gain [click]. Limit 1 console per player.
cards.flavor: "Red ones go faster." - Ken "Express" Tenma

cards.name: Afterimage
cards.text: Once per turn → When you encounter a sentry, you may pay 2[credit] to bypass it. Spend credits only from stealth cards to use this ability. Interface → 1[credit]: Break up to 2 sentry subroutines. 1[credit]: +2 strength. Spend credits only from stealth cards to use this ability.

cards.name: Akhet
cards.text:
You can advance this ice.
While there are 3 or more hosted advancement counters, this ice gets +3 strength and the Runner cannot break more than 1 of its printed subroutines during each encounter.
[subroutine] Gain 1[credit]. Place 1 advancement counter on an installed card.
[subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor:
Thou slept not in thy house on earth.
Thou openest thy place in heaven.

cards.name: Aniccam
cards.text: +1[mu] The first time each turn an event is trashed (from any location), draw 1 card. Limit 1 console per player.
cards.flavor: Objects are but modulations in a continuous cycle of energy—illusory and impermanent echoes of the Self.

cards.name: Argus Crackdown
cards.text: Play only if there is no active lockdown. This operation is not trashed until your next turn begins. Whenever the Runner makes a successful run on a server protected by ice, do 2 meat damage.
cards.flavor:
“If it moves, shoot it. Then shoot it again.”
—Chief Slee

cards.name: Bass CH1R180G4
cards.text: [click], [trash]: Gain [click][click].
cards.flavor:
The Coordinator is always calm, always smiling, and always tolerant. A worker who knows his skills, knows his role, and knows his place. No master need look into his plastic eyes and fear the flames of revolution, or quake at a forgotten class reaching for self-expression.
…but who ordered him to wear that hat?

cards.name: Bellona
cards.text:
As an additional cost to steal this agenda, the Runner must pay 5[credit].
When you score this agenda, gain 5[credit].
cards.flavor: Mars’ tiny population made rich multiplayer experiences a big challenge. We cracked it by live-beaming the gestalt of our Earth playerbase second-by-second. Bellona weaves these “lag-ghosts” into compelling interactables—more responsive than the real thing!

cards.name: Boomerang
cards.text: When you install this hardware, choose 1 installed piece of ice. Use this hardware only during encounters with that ice. [trash]: Break up to 2 subroutines. When this run ends, if it was successful, you may shuffle 1 copy of Boomerang from your heap into your stack.
cards.flavor: Return to sender.

cards.name: Bravado
cards.text: Run a server protected by ice. When that run ends, gain 6[credit] plus 1[credit] for each piece of ice you passed during that run.
cards.flavor:
“Hold my wine. I’m going in.”
—Red Comyn

cards.name: Buffer Drive
cards.text: The first time each turn 1 or more cards are trashed from your grip or stack, you may add 1 of those cards to the bottom of your stack. Remove this hardware from the game: Add 1 card from your heap to the top of your stack.
cards.flavor: “Future me needs those 60 petabytes of cat vids.” —Princess Space Kitten

cards.name: Cordyceps
cards.text:
When you install this program, place 2 virus counters on it.
Once per turn → When you make a successful run on a central server, you may remove 1 hosted virus counter to swap 1 piece of ice protecting that server with another installed piece of ice.

cards.name: Cyberdex Sandbox
cards.text:
The first time each turn you purge virus counters, gain 4[credit].
When you score this agenda, you may purge virus counters.
cards.flavor: “All Dragon-rated threats should only be stored in a single clean-start air-gapped server, in a shielded room, under at least 200 metres of bedrock[…]” —Section 5.18.4, Cyberdex Employee Handbook

cards.name: Devil Charm
cards.text: Whenever you encounter a piece of ice, you may remove this hardware from the game. If you do, that ice gets −6 strength for the remainder of this run.
cards.flavor: A simple little box, brimming with temptation.

cards.name: Drafter
cards.text:
[subroutine] You may add 1 card from Archives to HQ.
[subroutine] You may install 1 card from Archives or HQ, ignoring all costs.
cards.flavor: Each generation of design assistants makes a sysop’s job easier. They need only speak and it will be so.

cards.name: DreamNet
cards.text: The first time each turn you make a successful run, draw 1 card. If your identity is digital or you have at least 2[link], also gain 1[credit].
cards.flavor: Did I dream that dance through virtual space, or does that program now dream of flesh?

cards.name: Earth Station: SEA Headquarters
cards.text: Limit 1 remote server. As an additional cost to run HQ, the Runner must pay 1[credit]. [click]: Flip this identity. Flip side: Limit 1 remote server. As an additional cost to run a remote server, the Runner must pay 6[credit]. When the Runner makes a successful run on HQ, flip this identity.
cards.flavor:
The First Step…
…Further Beyond

cards.name: Engram Flush
cards.text:
When the Runner encounters this ice, choose a card type. For the remainder of the encounter, whenever you reveal the grip with a subroutine on this ice, you may trash 1 revealed card of the chosen type.
[subroutine] Reveal the grip.
[subroutine] Reveal the grip.
cards.flavor: $BMI.001 > Out of Memory Error

cards.name: Euler
cards.text: Interface → 0[credit]: Break 1 code gate subroutine. Use this ability only if this program was installed this turn. Interface → 2[credit]: Break up to 2 code gate subroutines. 1[credit]: +1 strength.
cards.flavor: Find truth not in the observation, but in the demonstration.

cards.name: F2P
cards.text: 2[credit]: Break 1 subroutine on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability, and only if they are not tagged. [subroutine] Add 1 installed Runner card to the grip. [subroutine] Give the Runner 1 tag.
cards.flavor: Free to Pay

cards.name: Flower Sermon
cards.text: When you score this agenda, place 5 agenda counters on it. Once per turn → Hosted agenda counter: Reveal the top card of R&D. Draw 2 cards. Add 1 card from HQ to the top of R&D.
cards.flavor:
“Voice is a sledgehammer. Text, a blunt saw. Truth requires subtler instruments.”
—Dr. Tang, Address to the Hyoubu Steering Committee

cards.name: Gachapon
cards.text: [trash]: Set aside the top 6 cards of your stack faceup. You may install 1 program or virtual resource from among those cards, paying 2[credit] less. Shuffle 3 of the remaining cards into your stack, then remove the rest from the game.
cards.flavor: Win a new friend today!

cards.name: GameNET: Where Dreams are Real
cards.text: Whenever a Corp card ability causes the Runner to spend or lose at least 1[credit] during a run, gain 1[credit].
cards.flavor: Your Favorite Distraction.

cards.name: Ganked!
cards.text:
While the Runner is accessing this upgrade in R&D, they must reveal it.
When the Runner accesses this upgrade, you may trash it to choose a rezzed piece of ice protecting this server. The Runner encounters that ice.
cards.flavor: Roll Initiative…

cards.name: Gold Farmer
cards.text:
Whenever the Runner breaks a printed subroutine on this ice, they lose 1[credit].
[subroutine] End the run unless the Runner pays 3[credit].
[subroutine] End the run unless the Runner pays 3[credit].
cards.flavor: [Pay 15 gems to access this content]

cards.name: Harmony AR Therapy
cards.text:
Choose up to 5 cards with different names in your heap. Shuffle those cards into your stack.
Remove this event from the game.
cards.flavor: Breathe in and visualise your happy place. Breathe out. It’s safe and calm and all your best days are there. Breathe in. Very good. The cortex scan has finished. Breathe out and open your eyes…

cards.name: Hoshiko Shiro: Untold Protagonist
cards.text:
When your turn ends, if you accessed a card this turn, gain 2[credit] and flip this identity.
Flip side:
When your turn begins, draw 1 card and lose 1[credit].
When your turn ends, if you did not access any cards this turn, flip this identity.
cards.flavor:
Please, let me have this dream.
I’m going to be my own kind of hero.

cards.name: Hyoubu Precog Manifold
cards.text: Play only if there is no active lockdown. This operation is not trashed until your next turn begins. When you play this operation, choose a server. Whenever the Runner makes a successful run on the chosen server, play a Psi Game. (Players secretly bid 0–2[credit]. Then each player reveals and spends their bid.) If the bids differ, end the run.

cards.name: Kakurenbo
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this operation, spend [click][click].
Trash any number of cards from HQ. Turn all cards in Archives facedown. You may install 1 card from Archives in the root of a remote server and place 2 advancement counters on it.
Remove this operation from the game.

cards.name: Keiko
cards.text: +2[mu] The first time each turn you install a companion card or spend credits from an installed companion card, gain 1[credit]. Limit 1 console per player.
cards.flavor: “…and friends hold you close. I vow never to let go of my princess.”

cards.name: Konjin
cards.text: When the Runner encounters this ice, play a Psi Game. (Players secretly bid 0–2[credit]. Then each player reveals and spends their bid.) If the bids differ, you may choose another rezzed piece of ice. The Runner encounters that ice. (When that encounter ends, if the run has not ended, finish encountering this ice.)
cards.flavor: “The Konjin dons the mask of our fears, but what lies underneath?”

cards.name: Makler
cards.text: Interface → 2[credit]: Break up to 2 barrier subroutines. 2[credit]: +2 strength. The first time each turn this program fully breaks a piece of ice, gain 1[credit].
cards.flavor: “Debt is beautiful… after it is repaid.” —“Baklan” Bochkin

cards.name: Mantle
cards.text:
1[recurring-credit]
You can spend hosted credits to use hardware and programs.
cards.flavor: “Invisibility made it possible to get them, but it made it impossible to enjoy them when they are got.” —H.G. Wells, The Invisible Man

cards.name: Moshing
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this event, trash 3 cards from your grip.
Gain 3[credit] and draw 3 cards.
cards.flavor: Let’s start a RIOT.

cards.name: Mu Safecracker
