cards.text: Spend credits only from stealth cards to use this hardware. Whenever you make a successful run on HQ, you may pay 1[credit] to access 1 additional card when you breach HQ. Whenever you make a successful run on R&D, you may pay 2[credit] to access 1 additional card when you breach R&D.

cards.name: NAPD Cordon
cards.text: Play only if there is no active lockdown. This operation is not trashed until your next turn begins. As an additional cost to steal an agenda, the Runner must pay 4[credit] plus 2[credit] for each advancement counter on that agenda.
cards.flavor: Crisis is the true test of loyalty. Kick the anthill and see where the ants swarm.

cards.name: NEXT Activation Command
cards.text: Play only if there is no active lockdown. This operation is not trashed until your next turn begins. Each piece of ice gets +2 strength. The Runner cannot use non-icebreaker cards to break subroutines.
cards.flavor: “Uh oh, Keiko! Looks like we’ve pulled aggro!”

cards.name: Odore
cards.text: Interface → 2[credit]: Break any number of sentry subroutines. Interface → 0[credit]: Break 1 sentry subroutine. Use this ability only if you have 3 or more installed virtual resources. 3[credit]: +3 strength.
cards.flavor: Dance, and forget about time!

cards.name: Paladin Poemu
cards.text: When your turn begins and whenever you steal an agenda, place 1[credit] on this resource. You can spend hosted credits to install non-connection cards. When your turn ends, if there are 3 or more hosted credits, trash 1 of your installed cards.
cards.flavor: Friends guard your passions.

cards.name: Pauleʼs Café
cards.text: [click]: Host 1 program or piece of hardware from your grip faceup on this resource. 1[credit]: Install 1 hosted card. The first card you install this way during each of your turns costs 1[credit] less to install for each unique (♦) connection resource you have installed.
cards.flavor: Designed by 2018 Eternal Champion Oguz Han Asnaz

cards.name: Penrose
cards.text: Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 barrier subroutine. Use this ability only if this program was installed this turn. Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 code gate subroutine. 1[credit]: +3 strength. Spend credits only from stealth cards to use this ability.
cards.flavor: Look at the problem from a different angle.

cards.name: Penumbral Toolkit
cards.text:
If you made a successful run on HQ this turn, this resource costs 2[credit] less to install.
When you install this resource, load 4[credit] onto it. When it is empty, trash it.
You can spend hosted credits during runs.
cards.flavor: Shadow Net marketplaces have such venerability that they differ from legal platforms only in the products offered.

cards.name: Prognostic Q-Loop
cards.text: The first time each turn a run begins, you may look at the top 2 cards of your stack. Once per turn → 1[credit]: Reveal the top card of your stack. If that card is a program or piece of hardware, you may install it.
cards.flavor:
“Overinflate a superposition-stack and optimal code forms the negentropy traverse.”
“Aha, like putting too much air into a balloon?!”

cards.name: Project Vacheron
cards.text:
[interrupt] → When this agenda would be added to the Runnerʼs score area from anywhere except Archives, instead it is added to their score area with 4 hosted agenda counters.
While this agenda is in the Runnerʼs score area with 1 or more hosted agenda counters, it is worth 0 agenda points and gains “When the Runnerʼs turn begins, remove 1 hosted agenda counter.“

cards.name: Prāna Condenser
cards.text: [interrupt] → Whenever you would do 1 or more net damage, you may prevent 1 net damage. If you do, place 1 power counter on this asset and gain 3[credit]. [click][click], [trash]: Do 1 net damage for each hosted power counter.
cards.flavor: Constructive feedback to the neural field reliably causes greater degradation than spike inputs. The mind has no defense against its own echoes.

cards.name: SYNC Rerouting
cards.text: Play only if there is no active lockdown. This operation is not trashed until your next turn begins. Whenever a run begins, give the Runner 1 tag unless they pay 4[credit].
cards.flavor:
“Deep inspect every packet on the continent. Burn out all our stacks if you have to. We cannot let these terrorists cover their tracks.”
—CEO Jenkins

cards.name: Scapenet
cards.text: Play only if the Runner made a successful run during their last turn. Trace[7]. If successful, remove 1 installed chip or virtual card from the game.
cards.flavor: The Net is the consensual hallucination of the world’s electronic architecture. Our electronic architecture. Don’t get mad when the Runners succeed—change the rules.

cards.name: Simulchip
cards.text: As an additional cost to use this hardware, trash 1 installed program. Ignore this cost if an installed program has already been trashed this turn. [trash]: Install 1 program from your heap, paying 3[credit] less.
cards.flavor:
“I could let my code evolve something new, but sometimes I just want to remember yesterday’s solution.”
—Lane

cards.name: The Back
cards.text: The first time each turn you use a piece of hardware during a run, place 1 power counter on this resource. [click], remove this resource from the game: For each hosted power counter, choose up to 2 cards in your heap with [trash] abilities. Shuffle the chosen cards into your stack.
cards.flavor:
“Junk plus undiscerning buyers equals profit.”
—Az McCaffrey

cards.name: Tranquility Home Grid
cards.text: Remote server only. The first time each turn you install a card in the root of this server, gain 2[credit] or draw 1 card. Limit 1 region per server.
cards.flavor: The oldest of Heinlein’s domes, the self-proclaimed heart of Lunar culture.

cards.name: Transport Monopoly
cards.text: When you score this agenda, place 2 agenda counters on it. Once per turn → Hosted agenda counter: This run cannot be declared successful. (This effect does not cause the run to become unsuccessful.) Use this ability only during a run.
cards.flavor: Once you’re on the Space Elevator Authority’s blacklist, you aren’t going anywhere.

cards.name: Týr
cards.text: Lose [click]: Break 1 subroutine on this ice. The Corp gets +1 allotted [click] for their next turn. Only the Runner can use this ability. [subroutine] Do 2 core damage. [subroutine] Trash 1 installed Runner card. Gain 3[credit]. [subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor: The valiant do not hesitate.

cards.name: Vaporframe Fabricator
cards.text: Once per turn → [click]: Install 1 card from HQ, ignoring all costs. When the Runner trashes this asset, you may install 1 card from HQ, ignoring all costs. You cannot install that card in the root of this server.
cards.flavor: A staccato of laser pulses fuses the vapor to solid form. The embryonic part accretes metal layer by layer.

cards.name: Wall to Wall
cards.text:
When your turn begins, if you have any other rezzed assets, resolve 1 of the following; otherwise, resolve up to 3 in any order:
  • Draw 1 card.
  • Gain 1[credit].
  • Place 1 advancement counter on an installed piece of ice.
  • Add this asset to HQ.

cards.name: Winchester
cards.text:
[subroutine] Trace[4]. If successful, trash 1 installed program.
[subroutine] Trace[3]. If successful, trash 1 installed piece of hardware.
While this ice is protecting HQ, it gains “[subroutine] Trace[3]. If successful, end the run.” after its other subroutines.
cards.flavor:
“I donʼt know how Skorpios gets these designs past Brand Management.”
—Liz Campbell, VP Project Security

cards.name: AMAZE Amusements
cards.text: Persistent → Whenever a run on this server ends, if the Runner stole any agendas during that run, give the Runner 2 tags. (If the Runner trashes this card while accessing it, this ability still applies for the remainder of this run.)
cards.flavor: Free commemorative souvenir!

cards.name: Above the Law
cards.text:
When you score this agenda, you may trash 1 installed resource.
Limit 1 per deck.
cards.flavor: We are judge, jury, and executioner.

cards.name: Anoetic Void
cards.text: Whenever the Runner approaches this server, you may pay 2[credit] and trash 2 cards from HQ. If you do, end the run.
cards.flavor:
The self-evolving Net twists into spaces unthought and unthinkable: realms of gods and other infohazards, mocking our sacrifices to petty causality.
–Conceptual Frameworks for Applied Theology

cards.name: Ansel 1.0
cards.text: Lose [click]: Break 1 subroutine on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability. [subroutine] Trash 1 installed Runner card. [subroutine] You may install 1 card from HQ or Archives. [subroutine] The Runner cannot steal or trash Corp cards for the remainder of this run.
cards.flavor: Designed by 2018 European Champion Patrick Gower

cards.name: Ballista
cards.text: [subroutine] Trash 1 installed program or end the run.
cards.flavor: “Puts a hole in your rig and your plans.” –René “Loup” Arcemont

cards.name: Botulus
cards.text: Install only on a piece of ice. (If the host ice is uninstalled, this program is trashed.) When you install this program and when your turn begins, place 1 virus counter on this program. Hosted virus counter: Break 1 subroutine on host ice.
cards.flavor: Was it something you ate?

cards.name: Brân 1.0
cards.text: Lose [click]: Break 1 subroutine on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability. [subroutine] You may install 1 piece of ice from HQ or Archives directly inward from this ice, ignoring all costs. [subroutine] End the run. [subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor: A giant wakes…

cards.name: Buzzsaw
cards.text: Interface → 1[credit]: Break up to 2 code gate subroutines. 3[credit]: +1 strength.
cards.flavor: Destruction is an art.

cards.name: Carmen
cards.text: If you made a successful run this turn, this program costs 2[credit] less to install. Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 sentry subroutine. 2[credit]: +3 strength.
cards.flavor:
The whole wide world your domain
For law your own free will.

cards.name: Carnivore
cards.text: +1[mu] Access, once per turn → Trash 2 cards from your grip: Trash the card you are accessing. Limit 1 console per player.
cards.flavor:
“It hungers to sink teeth into problems.”
–Loup

cards.name: Clearinghouse
cards.text:
You can advance this asset.
When your turn begins, you may trash this asset to do 1 meat damage for each hosted advancement counter.
cards.flavor:
“First rule of the business: make sure youʼre not ‘personally liable’ when the transaction executes.”
–Ted J. Son, Central Counterparty Clearance

cards.name: Cleaver
cards.text: Interface → 1[credit]: Break up to 2 barrier subroutines. 2[credit]: +1 strength.
cards.flavor: Subtlety is a luxury.

cards.name: Conduit
cards.text: Whenever a successful run on R&D ends, you may place 1 virus counter on this program. [click]: Run R&D. If successful, access X additional cards when you breach R&D. X is equal to the number of hosted virus counters.
cards.flavor:
A dabbling with truth is a pernicious dream
Drink deep, or taste not the raw datastream.

cards.name: Cookbook
cards.text: Whenever you install a virus program, you may place 1 virus counter on it.
cards.flavor:
“It waits on an unlabelled memstrip far below the deepest hab. Angry, desperate souls seek it out, hungry for power to change a brutal world. Once they can stomach no more bitter revenge, they return to that nameless tunnel, the book a recipe thicker.”
–Heinlein urban legend

cards.name: Creative Commission
cards.text: Gain 5[credit]. If you have any [click] remaining, lose [click].
cards.flavor: The challenge of my art is what I live for, but Iʼm not going to say no to a patron with taste.

cards.name: DZMZ Optimizer
cards.text:
+1[mu]
The first program you install each turn costs 1[credit] less to install.
cards.flavor: Tāo exhaled, the med-exoskeleton faithfully stabilizing him. In that absent breath, he reached through layers of waldos and optimizers and plucked the errant molecule from the chip.

cards.name: Diviner
cards.text: [subroutine] Do 1 net damage. If you trash a card this way with a printed play or install cost that is an odd number, end the run. (0 is not odd.)
cards.flavor: It reads your future in a single biometric sweep.

cards.name: Docklands Pass
cards.text: The first time each turn you breach HQ, access 1 additional card.
cards.flavor: Zahya knows the keeper of every door between the Docklands and the Domes. More importantly, she knows their price.

cards.name: Echelon
cards.text: This program gets +1 strength for each installed icebreaker (including this one). Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 sentry subroutine. 3[credit]: +2 strength.
cards.flavor: The beauty of open projects—each stands atop past success.

cards.name: Fermenter
cards.text: When you install this program and when your turn begins, place 1 virus counter on this program. [click], [trash]: Gain 2[credit] for each hosted virus counter.
cards.flavor:
“Thereʼs a tension to a cook. Each processing cycle sweetens the pot and raises the heat. I stir all night, but few have my appetite for danger.”
–René “Loup” Arcemont

cards.name: Funhouse
cards.text:
When the Runner encounters this ice, end the run unless the Runner takes 1 tag.
[subroutine] Give the Runner 1 tag unless they pay 4[credit].
cards.flavor:
“I might take a break from VR after this one.”
–SeaOfRibaldry, sensie streamer

cards.name: Government Subsidy
cards.text: Gain 15[credit].
cards.flavor: “If the government spent 1% of the funding they provide us tracking where the other 99% went, my colleagues and I would be in prison… …but that is a very big if.” –Huey DeMora, W-Con public-private facilitation seminar

cards.name: Haas-Bioroid: Precision Design
cards.text:
You get +1 maximum hand size.
Whenever you score an agenda, you may add 1 card from Archives to HQ.
cards.flavor: Not an Atom Misplaced.

cards.name: Hansei Review
cards.text: Gain 10[credit]. If there are any cards in HQ, trash 1 of them.
cards.flavor:
“Constant self-reflection is the key to excellence. We remember failed ideas, but do not carry them forward.”
–Director Kase, unknown leadership seminar

cards.name: Jailbreak
cards.text: Run HQ or R&D. If successful, draw 1 card and when you breach the attacked server, access 1 additional card.
cards.flavor:
“Weʼll take the access codes from their own prisec—privilege escalation through local application of force.”
–The Catalyst

cards.name: Jinteki: Restoring Humanity
cards.text: When your discard phase ends, if there is a facedown card in Archives, gain 1[credit].
cards.flavor: An End to Suffering.

cards.name: Karunā
cards.text:
[subroutine] Do 2 net damage. The Runner may jack out.
[subroutine] Do 2 net damage.
cards.flavor: You did not escape, you were shown mercy.

cards.name: Leech
cards.text: Whenever you make a successful run on a central server, place 1 virus counter on this program. Hosted virus counter: The ice you are encountering gets -1 strength for the remainder of this encounter.
cards.flavor: The greediest bloodsucker this side of a corporate boardroom.

cards.name: Longevity Serum
cards.text:
When you score this agenda, trash any number of cards from HQ. Shuffle up to 3 cards from Archives into R&D.
Limit 1 per deck.
cards.flavor: We make you anew.

cards.name: Luminal Transubstantiation
cards.text:
When you score this agenda, gain [click][click][click]. You cannot score agendas for the remainder of the turn.
Limit 1 per deck.
cards.flavor: We are the light of tomorrow.

cards.name: Malapert Data Vault
cards.text: Whenever you score an agenda from the root of this server, you may search R&D for 1 non-agenda card and reveal it. (Shuffle R&D after searching it.) Add that card to HQ.
cards.flavor: Sunlight does not touch the Crater of Eternal Darkness, a fitting abode for the Consortiumʼs malefic secrets.

cards.name: Manegarm Skunkworks
cards.text: Whenever the Runner approaches this server, end the run unless they either spend [click][click] or pay 5[credit].
cards.flavor:
“Whose memory-tape needs such stringent security?”
–The Catalyst

cards.name: Marjanah
cards.text: Interface → 2[credit]: Break 1 barrier subroutine. If you made a successful run this turn, this ability costs 1[credit] less to use. 1[credit]: +1 strength.
cards.flavor:
“You canʼt rule a kingdom by standing still.”
–Zahya Sadeghi

cards.name: Mayfly
cards.text: Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 subroutine. When this run ends, trash this program. 1[credit]: +1 strength.
cards.flavor: Compiling even the smallest AI takes weeks for only seconds of runtime, but that brief, shining moment allows… everything.

cards.name: Mutual Favor
cards.text: Search your stack for 1 icebreaker and reveal it. (Shuffle your stack after searching it.) If you made a successful run this turn, you may install that program. If you do not, add it to your grip.
cards.flavor: The real reward is the friends you make along the way.

cards.name: NBN: Reality Plus
cards.text: The first time each turn the Runner takes a tag, gain 2[credit] or draw 2 cards.
cards.flavor: Why Settle for Real?

cards.name: Neurospike
cards.text: Do X net damage, where X is equal to the sum of the printed agenda points on agendas you scored this turn.
cards.flavor: Macroscale developments within the Net decouple the prior informational states–surplus entropy is then gifted where it will do the most good.

cards.name: Nico Campaign
cards.text:
When you rez this asset, load 9[credit] onto it. When it is empty, trash it and draw 1 card.
When your turn begins, take 3[credit] from this asset.
cards.flavor:
“Haas thinks theyʼre making a new line of androgynous products. In truth, theyʼre making us thousands of new siblings to free.”
–Quetzal

cards.name: Offworld Office
cards.text: When you score this agenda, gain 7[credit].
cards.flavor: As the first lunar city, Heinlein was built on the dreams of a new frontier and boundless opportunity, but He3 mining is too lucrative for the corps to ever relinquish control.

cards.name: Orbital Superiority
cards.text: When you score this agenda, if the Runner is tagged, do 4 meat damage; otherwise, give the Runner 1 tag.
cards.flavor: Mobsters bribe police, megacorps acquire militaries.

cards.name: Overclock
cards.text: Place 5[credit] on this event, then run any server. You can spend hosted credits during that run.
cards.flavor: “After 381FS4 started acting independently, all bets were off. Rethreading its own brain chip… even probing our nodes. I had to shut it down.” –Linus Lovegood, NBN Novelties&Acquisitions

cards.name: Palisade
cards.text:
While this ice is protecting a remote server, it gets +2 strength.
[subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor: Keep the neighbors honest.

cards.name: Pantograph
cards.text: +1[mu] Whenever an agenda is scored or stolen, gain 1[credit]. Then, you may install 1 card from your grip. Limit 1 console per player.
cards.flavor:
“With this beautiful baby I can juggle simultaneous runs by haptic feedback alone!”
–Tāo

cards.name: Pennyshaver
cards.text: +1[mu] Whenever you make a successful run, place 1[credit] on this hardware. [click]: Place 1[credit] on this hardware, then take all credits from it. Limit 1 console per player.
cards.flavor: “Braggarts chase big heists. Patience enriches skimming fractions of a credit at a time.” –Zahya

cards.name: Pharos
cards.text:
You can advance this ice. It gets +5 strength while there are 3 or more hosted advancement counters.
[subroutine] Give the Runner 1 tag.
[subroutine] End the run.
[subroutine] End the run.

cards.name: Ping
cards.text:
When you rez this ice during a run against this server, give the Runner 1 tag.
[subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor: AvID:??:73.174 time=0.632 ms AvID:??:73.174 time=0.201 ms AvID:??:73.174 time=0.000 ms ALERT

cards.name: Predictive Planogram
cards.text:
Resolve 1 of the following. If the Runner is tagged, you may resolve both instead.
  • Gain 3[credit].
  • Draw 3 cards.
cards.flavor: For the best augmented reality shopping experience, please disable tracking protection.

cards.name: Public Trail
cards.text:
Play only if the Runner made a successful run during their last turn.
Give the Runner 1 tag unless they pay 8[credit].
cards.flavor: “A runner uses significant resources scrubbing their traces. Every cycle, itʼs harder to pin them down. But the game changes. In Heinlein, no one can last a day without brushing our AR-network.” –Cassie LaRosa, Lunar NetDefense Sysop

cards.name: Red Team
cards.text: When you install this resource, load 12[credit] onto it. When it is empty, trash it. [click]: Run a central server you have not run this turn. If successful, take 3[credit] from this resource.
cards.flavor: The Domes of Heinlein are a pressure cooker of cutthroat capitalism. Prospective employers rarely have time for background checks.

cards.name: Regolith Mining License
cards.text: When you rez this asset, load 15[credit] onto it. When it is empty, trash it. [click]: Take 3[credit] from this asset.
cards.flavor:
“The economy of three worlds is sustained by He3 extraction from the lunar surface. The very fulcrum of power, the key to collective survival—auctioned to the highest bidder.”
–The Catalyst

cards.name: René “Loup” Arcemont: Party Animal
cards.text: The first time each turn you trash a card you are accessing, gain 1[credit] and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Run wyld.

cards.name: Retribution
cards.text:
Play only if the Runner is tagged.
Trash 1 installed program or piece of hardware.
cards.flavor: Did you really think youʼd get away with it?

cards.name: Seamless Launch
cards.text: Place 2 advancement counters on 1 installed card that you did not install this turn.
cards.flavor:
“The first lesson for handling bioroids is simple: they must not be allowed to feel.”
–Do Nhi Minh

cards.name: Send a Message
cards.text: When this agenda is scored or stolen, you may rez 1 installed piece of ice, ignoring all costs.
cards.flavor: It might be over, but we will get them next time.

cards.name: Smartware Distributor
cards.text: [click]: Place 3[credit] on this resource. When your turn begins, take 1[credit] from this resource.
cards.flavor: The beauty of 22nd-century tech: if it still functions after all these decades, you know the build quality is solid.

cards.name: Spin Doctor
cards.text: When you rez this asset, draw 2 cards. Remove this asset from the game: Shuffle up to 2 cards from Archives into R&D.
cards.flavor: “Itʼs worse than dead meat—your project is too toxic to even feed to the vultures! If you don’t want to join it in the bloody memory hole, crawl onto every business show you can and wallow in blame like a pig in muck.”

cards.name: Sprint
cards.text: Draw 3 cards. Shuffle 2 cards from HQ into R&D.
cards.flavor: All time is crunch time.

cards.name: Superconducting Hub
cards.text:
When you score this agenda, you may draw 2 cards.
You get +2 maximum hand size.
cards.flavor: With Earth-Luna communications, saving microseconds returns megacredits.

cards.name: T400 Memory Diamond
cards.text:
+1[mu]
You get +1 maximum hand size.
cards.flavor: LLDS still holds the patent, but good tech attracts knockoffs.

cards.name: Telework Contract
cards.text: When you install this resource, load 9[credit] onto it. When it is empty, trash it. Once per turn → [click]: Take 3[credit] from this resource.
cards.flavor:
“For all I know, I could spend a shift digging next to old Weyland himself.”
–Lane

cards.name: The Catalyst: Convention Breaker
cards.text: Starter game only.
cards.flavor: Are you ready to start something big?

cards.name: The Syndicate: Profit over Principle
cards.text: Starter game only.
cards.flavor: You work for us. You just donʼt know it yet.

cards.name: Tithe
cards.text:
[subroutine] Do 1 net damage.
[subroutine] Gain 1[credit].
cards.flavor:
“Youʼll give till it hurts… then itʼll reach for more.”
–Red Comyn

cards.name: Tomorrowʼs Headline
cards.text:
When this agenda is scored or stolen, give the Runner 1 tag.
Limit 1 per deck.
cards.flavor: We donʼt find news. We make it.

cards.name: Tranquilizer
cards.text: Install only on a piece of ice. (If the host ice is uninstalled, this program is trashed.) When you install this program and when your turn begins, place 1 virus counter on this program. Then, if there are 3 or more hosted virus counters, derez host ice.
cards.flavor: Shhhh. Itʼs naptime.

cards.name: Tread Lightly
cards.text: Run any server. During that run, the rez cost of each piece of ice is increased by 3[credit].
cards.flavor:
“A mirrorfiber mod or high-end mantle can be helpful, but nothing beats a good dose of ‘keeping your damn head down.’”
–“G0ph3r” OʼRyan

cards.name: Tāo Salonga: Telepresence Magician
cards.text: Whenever an agenda is scored or stolen, you may swap 2 installed pieces of ice.
cards.flavor: Sufficient skill is indistinguishable from magic.

cards.name: Unity
cards.text: Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 code gate subroutine. 1[credit]: +X strength. X is equal to the number of installed icebreakers (including this one).
cards.flavor: The joy of handcrafted code—each fits perfectly within the whole.

cards.name: Urtica Cipher
cards.text:
You can advance this asset.
When the Runner accesses this asset while it is installed, do 2 net damage plus 1 net damage for each hosted advancement counter.
cards.flavor: A novel spin-off of Chronos tech was admixing sensitive data with ethically-sourced brain images of injured staff. Few intruders can handle a thousand years of skin burns in one moment.

cards.name: VRcation
cards.text: Draw 4 cards. If you have any [click] remaining, lose [click].
cards.flavor:
“You know thereʼs no water in the Sea of Tranquility, right?”
“That doesnʼt mean thereʼs no beach.”

cards.name: Verbal Plasticity
cards.text: The first time each turn you take the basic action to draw 1 card, instead draw 2 cards.
cards.flavor:
“Some kids got g-mods for beauty, sports, or staying up all night. My parents thought Broca-mods were cool. Hah. Fluent in ten languages so far, and still searching for the words to thank them.”
–Patrick Blue, Solar Artist

cards.name: Weyland Consortium: Built to Last
cards.text: Whenever you advance a card, gain 2[credit] if it had no advancement counters.
cards.flavor: Here to Stay.

cards.name: Whitespace
cards.text:
[subroutine] The Runner loses 3[credit].
[subroutine] If the Runner has 6[credit] or less, end the run.
cards.flavor: [this space intentionally left blank]

cards.name: Wildcat Strike
cards.text:
Resolve 1 of the following of the Corpʼs choice:
  • Gain 6[credit].
  • Draw 4 cards.
cards.flavor: They can buy off union leadership, but they canʼt stop us walking out!

cards.name: Zahya Sadeghi: Versatile Smuggler
cards.text: Once per turn → When a run on HQ or R&D ends, you may gain 1[credit] for each time you accessed a card during that run.
cards.flavor: I obtain your desire.

cards.name: Anemone
cards.text:
When you rez this ice during a run against this server, you may trash 1 card from HQ to do 2 net damage.
[subroutine] Do 1 net damage.
cards.flavor: Ethereal beauty brings sweet death with only a brief touch.

cards.name: Azef Protocol
cards.text:
As an additional cost to score this agenda, trash 1 of your other installed cards.
When you score this agenda, do 2 meat damage.
cards.flavor: Argus Security is always willing to send agents over to assist with radical asset reassignment.

cards.name: Deep Dive
cards.text:
Play only if you made a successful run on HQ, R&D, and Archives this turn.
The Corp must set aside the top 8 cards of R&D faceup. Access 1 of those cards. You may spend [click] to access another 1 of those cards. Then, the Corp shuffles the set-aside cards into R&D.

cards.name: Hákarl 1.0
cards.text: When you rez this ice during a run against this server, you may derez another installed card. If you do, the Runner cannot use paid abilities printed on bioroid ice for the remainder of this turn. Lose [click]: Break 1 subroutine on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability. [subroutine] Do 1 core damage. [subroutine] End the run.

cards.name: Light the Fire!
cards.text: [click], [trash], suffer 1 core damage: Run a remote server. During that run, cards in the root of the attacked server lose all abilities. When that run is successful, trash all cards in the root of the attacked server.
cards.flavor: A single spark is all it takes...

cards.name: Revolver
cards.text: When you install this program, place 6 power counters on it. Interface → [trash] or hosted power counter: Break 1 sentry subroutine. 2[credit]: +3 strength.

cards.name: Vladisibirsk City Grid
cards.text: You can advance this upgrade. Once per turn → 2 hosted advancement counters: Place 2 advancement counters on another card you can advance in the root of this server. Limit 1 region per server.

cards.name: Artificial Cryptocrash
cards.text: When you score this agenda, the Runner loses 7[credit].
cards.flavor: The line goes up... until we don't need it to anymore.

cards.name: Avgustina Ivanovskaya
cards.text: The first time each turn you install a virus program, sabotage 1. (The Corp trashes 1 card of their choice from HQ or the top of R&D.)
cards.flavor: "Sometimes being a union rep calls for action even more... direct."

cards.name: Backroom Machinations
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this operation, remove 1 tag.
Add this operation to your score area as an agenda worth 1 agenda point.
cards.flavor: "Recording devices at the door, please!"

cards.name: Backstitching
cards.text: When your turn begins, identify your mark. (If you don’t have a mark, a random central server becomes your mark for this turn.) Whenever you encounter a piece of ice during a run on your mark, you may trash this resource to bypass that ice.
cards.flavor: One step back. Take cover. Two steps forward. Repeat, then secure well.

cards.name: Bathynomus
cards.text:
While this ice is protecting Archives, it gets +3 strength.
[subroutine] Do 3 net damage.
cards.flavor: Digital refuse is their food, and you should never come between an animal and its food.

cards.name: Begemot
cards.text: When you install this program, suffer 1 core damage. This program gets +1 strength for each core damage you have taken this game. Interface → 1[credit]: Break any number of barrier subroutines.
cards.flavor: He didn't speak, but I knew exactly what he wanted, and what I had to do.

cards.name: Big Deal
cards.text:
After you resolve this operation, your action phase ends.
Place 4 advancement counters on 1 installed card. You may score that card, if able.
Remove this operation from the game.
cards.flavor: Designed by 2018 North American Champion Sam Suied

cards.name: Bladderwort
cards.text: When your turn begins, gain 1[credit]. Then, if you have 4[credit] or less, do 1 net damage.
cards.flavor: Prey and seawater sucked in, all in the space of a millisecond.

cards.name: Blood in the Water
cards.text: X is equal to the number of cards in the Runner's grip.
cards.flavor: Some tests require specific conditions.

cards.name: Captain Padma Isbister: Intrepid Explorer
cards.text: The first time each turn a run on R&D begins, you may charge 1 of your installed cards. (Add 1 power counter to a card that already has one.)
cards.flavor: The sea is everything; its breath must remain pure and healthy.

cards.name: Carpe Diem
cards.text: Identify your mark. (If you don’t have a mark, a random central server becomes your mark for this turn.) Gain 4[credit]. You may run your mark.
cards.flavor: The best moment to listen is when others are listening to you.

cards.name: Cat's Cradle
cards.text: The rez cost of each piece of code gate ice is increased by 1[credit]. Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 code gate subroutine. 1[credit]: +1 strength.
cards.flavor: I can show you a carpet, a fish, a magical tale...

cards.name: Cezve
cards.text: 2[recurring-credit] (When you install this card and before your turn begins, refill to 2 hosted credits.) You can spend hosted credits during runs on central servers.
cards.flavor: The feel of flour-fine coffee, the scent of caramelizing sugar, the gentle heat of the flame. A ritual I never forget.

cards.name: Chastushka
cards.text: Run HQ. If successful, instead of breaching HQ, sabotage 4. (The Corp trashes 4 cards of their choice from HQ and/or the top of R&D.)
cards.flavor:
We're all alike down here
Androids are friends we salute
Give us all a f***ing break
Ol' Jack is the s*** on my boot.

cards.name: Chekist Scion
cards.text:
You can advance this asset.
When the Runner accesses this asset while it is installed, give them 1 tag plus 1 tag for each hosted advancement counter.
cards.flavor: The only thing that changes is the uniform.

cards.name: Daeg, First Net-Cat
cards.text: Whenever an agenda is scored or stolen, you may charge 1 of your installed cards. (Add 1 power counter to a card that already has one.)
cards.flavor: "That's him at the front, then there's Scout, Jonesy, Parker, Buča, Squee, Boots... you get the idea."

cards.name: Drago Ivanov
cards.text: You can advance this asset. 2 hosted advancement counters: Give the Runner 1 tag. Use this ability only during your turn.
cards.flavor: "Tell them Drago would like a word." Designed by 2019 European Champion Aaryn "Drago" Byrne

cards.name: Echo
cards.text: Whenever you rez a piece of harmonic ice, place 1 power counter on this ice. This ice gains "[subroutine] End the run." for each hosted power counter.
cards.flavor: End the run. End the run. End the run. End the run.

cards.name: Endurance
cards.text: +2[mu] When you install this hardware, place 3 power counters on it. The first time each turn you make a successful run, place 1 power counter on this hardware. 2 hosted power counters: Break up to 2 subroutines. Limit 1 console per player.

cards.name: Envelopment
cards.text:
When you rez this ice, place 4 power counters on it.
When your turn begins, remove 1 hosted power counter.
This ice gains "[subroutine] End the run." before its other subroutines for each hosted power counter.
[subroutine] Trash this ice.

cards.name: Environmental Testing
cards.text:
Whenever you install a program or piece of hardware, place 1 power counter on this resource.
When there are 4 or more hosted power counters, trash this resource and gain 9[credit].
cards.flavor:
"Why are we here? No one else is going to do independent testing, that's why."
–Padma Isbister

cards.name: Esâ Afontov: Eco-Insurrectionist
cards.text: The first time each turn you suffer core damage, you may draw 1 card and sabotage 2. (The Corp trashes 2 cards of their choice from HQ and/or the top of R&D.)
cards.flavor: Waiting is useless. The crisis is here; pick a side.

cards.name: Extract
cards.text: Gain 6[credit]. You may trash 1 of your installed cards to gain 3[credit].
cards.flavor: Leave nothing of value behind.

cards.name: Ghosttongue
cards.text:
When you install this hardware, suffer 1 core damage.
The play cost of each event is lowered by 1[credit].
cards.flavor: Arming the resistance with disarming charm.

cards.name: Hyperbaric
cards.text: When you install this program, place 1 power counter on it. This program gets +1 strength for each hosted power counter. Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 code gate subroutine. 2[credit]: Place 1 power counter on this program.

cards.name: Into the Depths
cards.text:
Run any server. If successful, for each time you passed ice this run, resolve 1 of the following that you have not yet resolved this run:
  • Gain 4[credit].
  • Search your stack for a program. Install it. (Shuffle your stack after searching it.)
  • Charge 1 of your installed cards. (Add 1 power counter to a card that already has one.)

cards.name: Ivik
cards.text: The rez cost of this ice is lowered by 1[credit] for each rezzed piece of code gate ice. [subroutine] Do 2 net damage. [subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor: Keep off the grass.

cards.name: Marrow
cards.text: +1[mu] You get +3 maximum hand size. When you install this hardware, suffer 1 core damage. Whenever the Corp scores an agenda, sabotage 1. (The Corp trashes 1 card of their choice from HQ or the top of R&D.) Limit 1 console per player.

cards.name: Maskirovka
cards.text:
[subroutine] Gain 2[credit].
[subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor: Confound the runner so that they cannot see our true intent.

cards.name: Mavirus
cards.text: While the Runner is accessing this upgrade in R&D, they must reveal it. When the Runner accesses this upgrade, you may purge virus counters. If this upgrade is rezzed, do 1 net damage. [trash]: Purge virus counters.
cards.flavor: Viruses, runners; all are food to them.

cards.name: Mestnichestvo
cards.text:
You can advance this ice.
When the Runner encounters this ice, you may remove 1 hosted advancement counter. If you do, the Runner loses 3[credit].
[subroutine] The Runner loses 3[credit].
[subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor: Names of old carry little weight today, their legacies broken and swept away. Now, we are the rulers of truth.

cards.name: Midnight-3 Arcology
cards.text: When you score this agenda, draw 3 cards. Skip your discard step this turn.
cards.flavor:
"The Midnight-3 glows with an inviting warmth that belies the broken promise within. All that awaits you there is a life of indentured servitude."
–Sundog

cards.name: Mitosis
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this operation, spend [click].
Install up to 2 cards from HQ, creating a new remote server each time. Place 2 advancement counters on each of those cards. You cannot score or rez either of those cards this turn.
cards.flavor: One becomes many.

cards.name: Moon Pool
cards.text: Remove this asset from the game: Trash up to 2 cards from HQ. Reveal up to 2 facedown cards in Archives and shuffle them into R&D. For each agenda revealed this way, you may place 1 advancement counter on an installed card.
cards.flavor: Designed by the Borealis Playtesters

cards.name: Mutually Assured Destruction
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this operation, spend [click][click].
Trash any number of your rezzed cards. Give the Runner 1 tag for each card trashed this way.
cards.flavor: Designed by 2020 Asia-Pacific Champion Sam Keilback

cards.name: No Free Lunch
cards.text: [trash]: Gain 3[credit]. [trash]: Remove 1 tag.
cards.flavor: If there's anything to be learned from our android cousins, it's that there's no shortcut to perfection. Consider all your options.

cards.name: Nyusha "Sable" Sintashta: Symphonic Prodigy
cards.text: When your turn begins, identify your mark. (If you don’t have a mark, a random central server becomes your mark for this turn.) The first time each turn you make a successful run on your mark, gain [click].
cards.flavor: Flaws hold both beauty and opportunity.

cards.name: Ob Superheavy Logistics: Extract. Export. Excel.
cards.text: Once per turn → When you trash a rezzed card, except during installation, you may search R&D for 1 card with a printed rez cost exactly 1[credit] less than the trashed card's printed rez cost. Install and rez the card you found, ignoring credit costs.
cards.flavor: Take all that is offered, and more.

cards.name: PAN-Weave
cards.text:
When you install this hardware, suffer 1 meat damage.
The first time each turn you make a successful run on HQ, the Corp loses 1[credit]. If they do, gain 1[credit].
cards.flavor: Skimming credits with the slightest touch.

cards.name: Pinhole Threading
cards.text: Run any server. If successful, instead of breaching the attacked server, access 1 card in the root of another server. If that card is an agenda, you cannot steal or trash it during this access.
cards.flavor: Neneciğim would be proud.

cards.name: Pravdivost Consulting: Political Solutions
cards.text: The first time each turn the Runner makes a successful run, you may place 1 advancement counter on an installed card you can advance.
cards.flavor: Political news, fit for public consumption.

cards.name: Propeller
cards.text: When you install this program, place 4 power counters on it. Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 barrier subroutine. Hosted power counter: +2 strength.
cards.flavor: Within netspace, tangible space can be manipulated as desired, and fluid dynamics rarely factors into ice development.

cards.name: Refuge Campaign
cards.text: When your turn begins, gain 2[credit].
cards.flavor:
"The promise of a new home, safe work and friendly neighbors will draw in tens of thousands of eco-refugees, no matter which corner of the world they are from."
–Thule employee handbook

cards.name: Regenesis
cards.text: When you score this agenda, if no Corp cards have been added to Archives this turn, you may reveal 1 facedown agenda in Archives and add it to your score area.
cards.flavor:
"Esteemed guests, by the end of this demonstration you will see that extinction is now only a temporary state of affairs."
–Vientiane Keeling

cards.name: Rigging Up
cards.text: Install 1 program or piece of hardware from your grip, paying 3[credit] less. You may charge that card if able. (If it has a power counter on it, add another.)
cards.flavor: Edie doesn't mind the noise. She's happy just being nearby.

cards.name: Running Hot
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this event, suffer 1 core damage.
Gain [click][click][click].
cards.flavor: We can change the world, if we're willing to be changed in return.

cards.name: Stavka
cards.text:
When you rez this ice, you may trash 1 of your other installed cards. If you do, this ice gets +5 strength for the remainder of the run.
[subroutine] Trash 1 installed program.
[subroutine] Trash 1 installed program.
cards.flavor: Centuries of military tactics compressed into a single entity.

cards.name: Steelskin Scarring
cards.text:
Draw 3 cards.
When this event is trashed from your grip or stack, you may draw 2 cards.
cards.flavor: Reactive implants reclaim the memories of our fallen comrades. Their sacrifice is our shield.

cards.name: Stoneship Chart Room
cards.text: [trash]: Draw 2 cards. [trash]: Charge 1 of your installed cards.
cards.flavor: Every ship is a home, and every home needs a heart.

cards.name: Svyatogor Excavator
cards.text: When your turn begins, you may trash 1 of your other installed cards. If you do, gain 3[credit].
cards.flavor: It doesn't matter how long you've owned the land, you'd better hope there's nothing valuable beneath.

cards.name: The Twinning
cards.text:
The first time each turn you spend credits from an installed card, place 1 power counter on this resource.
Whenever you breach HQ or R&D, you may remove up to 2 hosted power counters to access that many additional cards.
cards.flavor: All is folding back, ever back; together as one.

cards.name: Trieste Model Bioroids
cards.text: When you rez this asset, choose 1 rezzed piece of bioroid ice. Runner card abilities cannot break subroutines on the chosen ice.
cards.flavor: At depths no human tech can reach, a Trieste proxy can manipulate a mindscape with unparalleled precision. Designed by 2019 World Champion Oliver "Pinsel" Siccha

cards.name: Trust Operation
cards.text:
Play only if the Runner is tagged.
Trash 1 installed resource. Install and rez 1 card from Archives, ignoring all costs.
cards.flavor: Identify. Contact. Entrap. Counterintelligence never changes.

cards.name: Ubiquitous Vig
cards.text:
You can advance this asset.
When your turn begins, gain 1[credit] for each hosted advancement counter.
cards.flavor: They say they'll only take a handful, but oh what big hands they have!

cards.name: Vasilisa
cards.text:
When the Runner encounters this ice, you may pay 1[credit]. If you do, place 1 advancement counter on an installed card you can advance.
[subroutine] Give the Runner 1 tag.
cards.flavor: No task the witch set would ever be too great, for Vasilisa had her mother's blessing.

cards.name: Virtuoso
cards.text: +1[mu] When your turn begins, identify your mark. (If you don’t have a mark, a random central server becomes your mark for this turn.) The first time each turn you make a successful run on your mark, if that server is HQ, access 1 additional card when you breach HQ. Otherwise, breach HQ when the run ends. Limit 1 console per player.

cards.name: Wave
cards.text: When you rez this ice during a run against this server, you may search R&D for a piece of ice and reveal it. (Shuffle R&D after searching it.) Add that ice to HQ. [subroutine] Gain 1[credit] for each rezzed piece of harmonic ice.
cards.flavor: With networks, growth is exponential.

cards.name: Élivágar Bifurcation
cards.text: When you score this agenda, you may derez 1 installed card.
cards.flavor: Ancient paradoxes are children's stories to the greatest minds ever designed.

cards.name: Abaasy
cards.text: The first time each turn this program fully breaks a piece of ice, you may trash 1 card from your grip to draw 1 card. Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 code gate subroutine. 2[credit]: +2 strength.
cards.flavor: Every piece of ice I see, I see Abaasy.

cards.name: Ampère: Cybernetics For Anyone
cards.text:
Your deck cannot include more than 1 copy of any card.
Your deck may include up to 2 different agenda cards from each Corp faction.
cards.flavor: Affordable, Effective, and Uncompromising.

cards.name: Anvil
cards.text:
When the Runner encounters this ice, you may trash 1 of your other installed cards. If you do, the Runner cannot break this iceʼs printed subroutines for the remainder of this encounter.
[subroutine] Gain 1[credit]. The Runner loses 1[credit].
[subroutine] The Runner trashes 1 of their installed cards.
cards.flavor: Waiting for the next blow to land.

cards.name: Asmund Pudlat
cards.text: When you install this resource, search your stack for up to 2 virus or weapon cards with different names. Host those cards faceup on this resource. (They are not installed.) When your turn begins, you may add 1 hosted card to your grip. If there are no more hosted cards, trash this resource.

cards.name: Basilar Synthgland 2KVJ
cards.text:
When you install this hardware, suffer 2 core damage.
You get +1 allotted [click] for each of your turns.
cards.flavor: It isnʼt as enjoyable as coffee, but the effects are magnitudes stronger.

cards.name: Bloop
cards.text: As an additional cost to rez this ice, derez another piece of harmonic ice. [subroutine] Do 1 core damage. [subroutine] Trash 1 installed program. [subroutine] Trash 1 installed program.
cards.flavor:
As one, every monitoring device on the ship reverberated, emitting a noise so primordial, so titanic, it shook Padma to her core.
Daeg hissed.

cards.name: Concerto
cards.text:
Reveal the top card of your stack and place credits equal to its printed play or install cost on this event. Add the revealed card to your grip.
Run any server. You can spend hosted credits during that run.
cards.flavor: "Roslavetsʼ Concerto No. 2. Breakneck, brilliant, enchanting. The perfect finale for Virtuoso."

cards.name: Distributed Tracing
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this operation, spend [click].
Play only if the Runner stole an agenda during their last turn.
Give the Runner 1 tag.
cards.flavor: Sometimes, they want you to know that they know.

cards.name: Djupstad Grid
cards.text: Whenever you score an agenda from the root of this server, do 1 core damage. Limit 1 region per server.
cards.flavor:
"Itʼs technically above our pay grade, but we know where our weapons come from. In Djupstad they wait, deep in thought, until we call upon them."
—Aron Hendrik

cards.name: Dr. Nuka Vrolyck
cards.text: When you install this resource, load 2 power counters onto it. When it is empty, trash it. [click], hosted power counter: Draw 3 cards.
cards.flavor: "There is another world under the waves, vanishing as we speak. I want to map it before itʼs gone."

cards.name: Dr. Vientiane Keeling
cards.text:
When you rez this asset and when your turn begins, place 1 power counter on this asset.
The Runner gets -1 maximum hand size for each hosted power counter.
cards.flavor: Her numbers never lie, but she doesnʼt write the words that accompany them.

cards.name: End of the Line
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this operation, remove 1 tag.
Do 4 meat damage.
cards.flavor: Under northern skies Sundog had lived all his life, and under them he would die.

cards.name: Finality
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this event, suffer 1 core damage.
Run R&D. If successful, access 3 additional cards when you breach R&D.
cards.flavor: "My guilt is never to be doubted."

cards.name: Flux Capacitor
cards.text: Install only on a piece of ice. The first time you break a subroutine during each encounter with host ice, you may charge 1 of your installed cards. (Add 1 power counter to a card that already has one.)
cards.flavor:
"Are you telling me itʼs pronounced ʼgigawattsʼ?"
—Captain Padma Isbister

cards.name: Freedom of Information
cards.text: This agenda gets -1 advancement requirement for each tag the Runner has.
cards.flavor: "An FOI request? No problem! Please fill out all details. Youʼd like to make an anonymous request? Iʼm sorry: absolutely not."

cards.name: Gaslight
cards.text: When your turn begins, you may trash this asset. If you do, search R&D for an operation and reveal it. (Shuffle R&D after searching it.) Add that operation to HQ.
cards.flavor: Donʼt you remember?

cards.name: Hafrún
cards.text:
When you rez this ice during a run against this server, you may trash 1 card from HQ. If you do, choose 1 installed Runner card. That cardʼs abilities cannot break subroutines for the remainder of that run.
[subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor: Hafrún has lived through generations of changes in the Net, and now there are whispers that something from the deep is making it anxious.

cards.name: Hippocampic Mechanocytes
cards.text:
When you install this hardware, place 2 power counters on it and suffer 1 meat damage.
You get +1 maximum hand size for each hosted power counter.
cards.flavor: To outsiders, it is ironic that no one in Ampère can remember who invented these little fellows. Within the company, this is considered normal.

cards.name: Hostile Architecture
cards.text: The first time each turn the Runner trashes any of your installed cards (including this asset), do 2 meat damage.
cards.flavor: When implemented at this sort of scale, these practices can keep away far more than a few unwanted citizens.

cards.name: Hush
cards.text: Install only on a piece of ice. Host ice cannot gain abilities and loses all abilities except its printed subroutines. [click]: Host this program on another installed piece of ice.
cards.flavor: Quiet. I need to focus.

cards.name: Hybrid Release
cards.text: When you score this agenda, you may install 1 facedown card from Archives.
cards.flavor:
"By disabling their bodiesʼ ability to create a variety of necessary enzymes, weʼve ensured their loyalty to us. If they donʼt return for supplements every month, they die; simple as that."
—Dr. Vientiane Keeling

cards.name: Hypoxia
cards.text:
Play only if the Runner is tagged.
Do 1 core damage. The Runner gets -1 allotted [click] for their next turn.
Remove this operation from the game.
cards.flavor: You think thatʼs air youʼre breathing now?

cards.name: Info Bounty
cards.text: When your turn begins, identify your mark. (If you donʼt have a mark, a random central server becomes your mark for this turn.) The first time each turn a run on your mark ends, gain 2[credit] if you breached that server during that run.
cards.flavor: It was a relief, really, deciding on that one place in the world to definitely never visit again.

cards.name: Issuaq Adaptics: Sustaining Diversity
cards.text:
Whenever you score an agenda that you did not install or advance this turn, place 1 power counter on this identity.
For each hosted power counter, you need 1 less agenda point to win the game.
cards.flavor: Bringing Mother Nature up to speed.

cards.name: K2CP Turbine
cards.text: Each installed non-AI icebreaker gets +2 strength.
cards.flavor: Every rig needs a power source. How about one with blades moving at Mach 2?

cards.name: Katorga Breakout
cards.text: Run any server. If successful, add 1 card from your heap to your grip.
cards.flavor:
"I promised I would come back for you, no matter the cost."
—Esâ Afontov

cards.name: Kimberlite Field
cards.text: When you score this agenda, you may trash 1 of your rezzed cards. If you do, trash 1 installed Runner card with a printed install cost equal to or less than the printed rez cost of the Corp card you trashed.
cards.flavor:
"Weylandʼs synthetic diamonds cost less than naturals... so what are they really digging for here?"
—Captain Padma Isbister

cards.name: Klevetnik
cards.text:
When you rez this ice during a run against this server, you may have the Runner gain 2[credit]. If you do, choose 1 installed resource. That resource loses all abilities until your next turn ends.
[subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor: SCANNING... ASSEMBLING INSULT!

cards.name: Matryoshka
cards.text: When your turn begins, turn each hosted card faceup. [click]: Host a copy of Matryoshka from your grip faceup on this program. (It is not installed.) Interface → X[credit], turn 1 hosted copy of Matryoshka facedown: Break X subroutines. 1[credit]: +1 strength. Limit 6 per deck.
cards.flavor:
She leads and they all follow.
Always there to back up her big sister.
Sheʼs a typical middle child, really.
Just as brave as his sisters.
Sheʼs little—but fierce.
Look at the little baby, even she helps!

cards.name: Mr. Hendrik
cards.text: When the Runner accesses this upgrade while it is installed, you may pay 2[credit] to do 1 core damage. If the Runner has any [click] remaining, they may lose all their [click] to prevent this damage.
cards.flavor: Few employees know he exists. Even fewer know he is actually three.

cards.name: Nanisivik Grid
cards.text: Whenever the Runner approaches this server, you may turn 1 facedown piece of ice in Archives faceup. If you do, resolve 1 subroutine on that ice. Limit 1 region per server.
cards.flavor: Here, at the edge of the habitable world, they extract the future from the bones of the past.

cards.name: Nanuq
cards.text: When this program is uninstalled, remove it from the game. When an agenda is scored or stolen, remove this program from the game. Interface → 2[credit]: Break up to 2 subroutines. 1[credit]: +1 strength.
cards.flavor: Nanuq never leaves, but instead waits, invisible, for the next hunt.

cards.name: Nga
cards.text: When you install this program, load 3 power counters onto it. When it is empty, trash it. The first time each turn you make a successful run, you may remove 1 hosted power counter to sabotage 1. (The Corp trashes 1 card of their choice from HQ or the top of R&D.)
cards.flavor: Relinquish your foolish notions of control.

cards.name: Nightmare Archive
cards.text:
While the Runner is accessing this asset in R&D, they must reveal it.
When the Runner accesses this asset, they may add it to their score area as an agenda worth -1 agenda point. If they do not, do 1 core damage and remove this asset from the game.
cards.flavor: Everyone remembers the first tape they archive.

cards.name: Nonequivalent Exchange
cards.text: Gain 5[credit]. You may have each player gain 2[credit].
cards.flavor: "Oh, the text on these is endless. Just tap accept and you can read it later if you want."

cards.name: Nova Initiumia: Catalyst & Impetus
cards.text: Your deck cannot include more than 1 copy of any card.
cards.flavor: I found my twin hidden away on Luna. Now we will never be apart.

cards.name: Num
cards.text: Interface → 2[credit]: Break 1 sentry subroutine.
cards.flavor: I give you understanding, that you might control that which would threaten you.

cards.name: Ontological Dependence
cards.text: This agenda gets -1 advancement requirement for each core damage the Runner has taken this game.
cards.flavor: Bend the minds of those below you such that they will always need you, and loyalty is assured forever.

cards.name: Orca
cards.text: The first time each turn this program fully breaks a piece of ice, you may charge 1 of your installed cards. (Add 1 power counter to a card that already has one.) Interface → 2[credit]: Break any number of sentry subroutines. 2[credit]: +3 strength.

cards.name: Poison Vial
cards.text: When you install this hardware, load 3 power counters onto it. When it is empty, trash it. Hosted power counter: Break up to 2 subroutines. Use this ability only if you have already broken a subroutine during this encounter.
cards.flavor: The poison cuts deeper than the blade.

cards.name: Post-Truth Dividend
cards.text: When you score this agenda, you may draw 1 card.
cards.flavor:
"Hey kiddo, remember what Daddy says about lying?"
"ʼOnly when you can get away with it!ʼ"

cards.name: Pulse
cards.text: When you rez this ice during a run against this server, the Runner loses [click]. [subroutine] The Runner loses 1[credit] for each rezzed piece of harmonic ice. [subroutine] End the run unless the Runner spends [click].
cards.flavor: The sound welled up from the deep: throbbing, thumping, growing with every passing beat of their hearts.

cards.name: Raindrops Cut Stone
cards.text: Run any server. Whenever a subroutine resolves during that run (including a subroutine that ends the run), place 1 power counter on this event. When that run ends, draw 1 card for each hosted power counter and gain 3[credit].
cards.flavor: With every step closer to their prize, Bankhar felt the ice slicing white-hot through their synapses. It was worth it.

cards.name: Reaper Function
cards.text: When your turn begins, you may trash this asset to do 2 net damage.
cards.flavor: There is an elegance to its blade and stride, but with it comes a screaming whirlwind.

cards.name: Regulatory Capture
cards.text: For each bad publicity you have up to 4, this agenda gets −1 advancement requirement.
cards.flavor: This was a criminal offense. Now itʼs an option for business.

cards.name: Reprise
cards.text:
Play only if you stole an agenda this turn.
Add 1 installed Corp card to HQ. You may run any server.
cards.flavor: "I may bow like Iʼve accomplished the impossible, but the truth is itʼs not that hard."

cards.name: Shipment from Vladisibirsk
cards.text:
Play only if the Runner has at least 2 tags.
Place a total of 4 advancement counters on installed cards you can advance.
cards.flavor: "Donʼt look at the crates."

cards.name: Simulation Reset
cards.text:
Trash up to 5 cards from HQ. Shuffle that many cards from Archives into R&D. Draw that many cards.
Remove this operation from the game.
cards.flavor:
"The worst part about failed experiments? The queue for the incinerator."
—Overheard in the Issuaq Adaptics cafeteria.

cards.name: Spark of Inspiration
cards.text: Set aside cards from the top of your stack faceup until you set aside a program. You may install that program, paying 10[credit] less. Shuffle the set-aside cards into your stack.
cards.flavor:
"The best ideas float to the top, if you give them time."
—Ar<h1m3d3s  JAR

cards.name: Superdeep Borehole
cards.text:
When you rez this asset, load 6 bad publicity counters onto it. When it is empty, you win the game.
When your turn begins, take 1 bad publicity from this asset.
cards.flavor:
"They just keep drilling down, no matter what..."
—Valentina Ferreira

cards.name: Thule Subsea: Safety Below
cards.text: Whenever the Runner steals an agenda, do 1 core damage unless they spend [click] and 2[credit].
cards.flavor: Join us. Safe, away from the crisis.

cards.name: Time Bomb
cards.text: Install only if you made a successful run on a central server this turn. When you install this hardware, place 1 power counter on it. When your turn begins, if there are 3 or more hosted power counters, trash this hardware and sabotage 3. (The Corp trashes 3 cards of their choice from HQ and/or the top of R&D.) Otherwise, place 1 power counter on this hardware.

cards.name: Tremolo
cards.text: Interface → 3[credit]: Break up to 2 barrier subroutines. This ability costs 1[credit] less to use for each installed piece of cybernetic hardware. 2[credit]: +2 strength.
cards.flavor: A repeated note, the alternation of fingers, the rhythm of stitches... the resulting intensity is always the same.

cards.name: Tsakhia "Bankhar" Gantulga
cards.text:
When your turn begins, you may choose a server.
During the first encounter each turn with a piece of ice protecting the chosen server, whenever the Corp would resolve a subroutine, instead they resolve "[subroutine] Do 1 net damage.".
cards.flavor: "With these two by my side, Iʼve sworn never to fail. I can bear any pain so long as it has meaning."

cards.name: Tunnel Vision
cards.text: When your turn begins, identify your mark. (If you donʼt have a mark, a random central server becomes your mark for this turn.) Interface → 2[credit]: Break up to 2 subroutines on a piece of ice protecting your mark. 2[credit]: +2 strength.
cards.flavor:
"How could I pick a favorite? Theyʼre all good dogs."
—Nyusha "Sable" Sintashta

cards.name: Unsmiling Tsarevna
cards.text:
When you rez this ice during a run against this server, you may have the Runner gain 2[credit]. If you do, during each encounter with this ice for the remainder of that run, the Runner cannot break more than 1 of its printed subroutines.
[subroutine] Give the Runner 1 tag.
[subroutine] Do 2 net damage.
[subroutine] You may draw 2 cards.

cards.name: Vampyronassa
cards.text:
[subroutine] The Runner loses 2[credit].
[subroutine] Gain 2[credit].
[subroutine] Do 2 net damage.
[subroutine] You may draw 1 or 2 cards.
cards.flavor:
"Matt, thereʼs something big heading your way. Matt, are you hearing me? Matt? Oh no."
—Moth

cards.name: Vera Ivanovna Shuyskaya
cards.text: Whenever an agenda is scored or stolen, you may reveal the grip. Trash 1 card revealed this way.
cards.flavor: "People donʼt think in facts, they think in stories. We just tidy up that information to hasten the process."

cards.name: WAKE Implant v2A-JRJ
cards.text:
When you install this hardware, suffer 1 meat damage.
Whenever you make a successful run on HQ, place 1 power counter on this hardware.
Whenever you breach R&D, you may remove up to 3 hosted power counters to access that many additional cards.

cards.name: World Tree
cards.text: The first time each turn you make a successful run, you may trash 1 of your other installed cards to search your stack for 1 card of the same type. (Shuffle your stack after searching it.) Install the card you found, paying 3[credit] less.
cards.flavor: Few constructs reach the Deep Net, but these old trees have stretched their roots further than once thought possible.

cards.name: Yakov Erikovich Avdakov
cards.text: Whenever a player trashes a card (including this upgrade) from the root of this server or protecting it, except during installation, gain 2[credit].
cards.flavor: They say the Butcher of Siberia keeps the best cuts for himself.

cards.name: ZATO City Grid
cards.text: Remote server only. Each piece of ice protecting this server gains "When the Runner encounters this ice, choose 1 subroutine on it. You may trash this ice to resolve that subroutine.". Limit 1 region per server.
cards.flavor: Getting in is hard. Getting out requires a death certificate.

cards.name: Zenit Chip JZ-2MJ
cards.text:
When you install this hardware, suffer 1 core damage.
The first time each turn you make a successful run on a central server, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor:
"Zenit implants help you focus on the important things."
—Ampère holo-billboard

cards.name: A Teia: IP Recovery
cards.text:
Limit 2 remote servers.
The first time each turn you install a card in the root of or protecting a remote server, you may install 1 card from HQ in the root of or protecting another remote server, ignoring all costs. You cannot score the second card this turn.
cards.flavor: Caveant Fugitivi.

cards.name: Ablative Barrier
cards.text: Threat 3 → When you rez this ice during a run against this server, you may install 1 non-agenda card from HQ or Archives in the root of or protecting another server. (This ability is active if any player has 3 or more agenda points.) [subroutine] End the run.

cards.name: Adrian Seis
cards.text: Whenever the Runner makes a successful run on this server, play a Psi Game. (Players secretly bid 0–2[credit]. Then each player reveals and spends their bid.) If the bids differ, the Runner cannot access cards other than this upgrade for the remainder of that run. If the bids match, the Runner cannot access this upgrade for the remainder of that run. When your turn ends, you may move this upgrade to the root of another server.

cards.name: AirbladeX (JSRF Ed.)
cards.text: When you install this hardware, load 3 power counters onto it. When it is empty, trash it. [interrupt] → Hosted power counter: Prevent 1 net damage. Use this ability only during a run. [interrupt] → Hosted power counter: Prevent a "when encountered" ability on a piece of ice.

cards.name: Angelique Garza Correa
cards.text: Threat 3 → [click], 1[credit], reveal and trash this upgrade from HQ: Do 1 meat damage. (This ability is active if any player has 3 or more agenda points.) When the Runner accesses this upgrade while it is rezzed, you may pay 2[credit] to do 2 meat damage.
cards.flavor: "Shoot!"

cards.name: Arissana Rocha Nahu: Street Artist
cards.text: Once per turn → 0[credit]: Install 1 program from your grip (paying its install cost). Use this ability only during a run. When that run ends, trash that program if it is not a trojan.
cards.flavor: Art knows no borders.

cards.name: Armed Asset Protection
cards.text: Gain 3[credit]. Gain 1[credit] for each card type among faceup cards in Archives. If any of those cards are agendas, gain another 2[credit].
cards.flavor:
"Nuvem pays us to guard this land, and thatʼs all there is to it."
—Angelique Garza Correa

cards.name: Attini
cards.text: Threat 3 → The Runner cannot spend credits while subroutines on this ice are resolving. (This ability is active if any player has 3 or more agenda points.) [subroutine] Do 1 net damage unless the Runner pays 2[credit]. [subroutine] Do 1 net damage unless the Runner pays 2[credit]. [subroutine] Do 1 net damage unless the Runner pays 2[credit].

cards.name: Audrey v2
cards.text: Whenever you trash a card you are accessing, place 1 virus counter on this program. Interface → Hosted virus counter: Break up to 2 subroutines. Trash 1 card from your grip: +3 strength.
cards.flavor:
"What do you want from me, blood?"
—S3ym0ur

cards.name: B-1001
cards.text: Remove 1 tag: End the run. Use this ability only during a run against another server.
cards.flavor: "Humans crafted me as a lie, but my patron helped me find the truth. This is my gift."

cards.name: Bahia Bands
cards.text:
Run any server. If successful, resolve 2 of the following in any order:
  • Draw 2 cards.
  • Install 1 card from your grip, paying 1[credit] less.
  • Remove 1 tag.
  • Place 4[credit] on this event. You can spend hosted credits to pay trash costs for the remainder of this run.

cards.name: Balanced Coverage
cards.text: When your turn begins, you may choose a card type to look at the top card of R&D. If that card has the chosen type, you may reveal it and gain 2[credit].
cards.flavor: "A lively but peaceful crowd of concerned counter-protesters have come out to—damn it, cut! Can we get the sledgehammer out of the frame?"

cards.name: Banner
cards.text: Interface → 2[credit]: Subroutines on the barrier you are encountering cannot end the run for the remainder of this encounter.
cards.flavor: Above the maze of smoke and swinging fists, they saw the banner waving.

cards.name: Beatriz Friere Gonzalez
cards.text: [click][click]: Run HQ. If successful, instead of breaching HQ, breach R&D. When you do, access 1 additional card.
cards.flavor: "And who can tell me what sort of practical applications this has?"

cards.name: Behold!
cards.text:
While the Runner is accessing this asset in R&D, they must reveal it.
When the Runner accesses this asset anywhere except in Archives, you may pay 4[credit] to give them 2 tags.
cards.flavor: Be afraid.

cards.name: Capybara
cards.text: Whenever you bypass a piece of ice, you may remove this hardware from the game to derez that ice.
cards.flavor:
"One day I looked into the mirror and saw not my own reflection, but a new friend eager to help me."
—Mercury

cards.name: Chrysopoeian Skimming
cards.text: The Corp may reveal an agenda from HQ. If they do, gain [click] and draw 1 card. Otherwise, look at the top 3 cards of R&D.
cards.flavor: Even the tiniest scrap of data can become the key to riches.

cards.name: Curupira
cards.text: Whenever you encounter a barrier, you may spend 3 hosted power counters to bypass it. Whenever this program fully breaks a piece of ice, place 1 power counter on this program. Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 barrier subroutine. 1[credit]: +1 strength.
cards.flavor: Take only what you need.

cards.name: Cybersand Harvester
cards.text: Whenever you rez a piece of ice, place 2[credit] on this asset. You can spend hosted credits to pay install costs. [trash]: Take all credits from this asset.
cards.flavor: Nothingʼs as precious as a hole in the ground.

cards.name: Daniela Jorge Inácio
cards.text:
As an additional cost to trash this upgrade, the Runner must add 2 cards from the grip at random to the bottom of the stack.
Persistent → As an additional cost to steal an agenda from this server or its root, the Runner must add 2 cards from the grip at random to the bottom of the stack.
cards.flavor: "They call me turncoat. I call them broke."

cards.name: Debbie "Downtown" Moreira
cards.text: Threat 4 → When you install this resource, place 2[credit] on it. (This ability is active if any player has 4 or more agenda points.) Whenever you play a run event, place 1[credit] on this resource. [click]: Run any server. You can spend hosted credits during that run.

cards.name: Epiphany Analytica: Nations Undivided
cards.text: The first time each turn the Runner steals or trashes a Corp card, place 1 power counter on this identity. [click], hosted power counter: Look at the top 3 cards of R&D. You may install 1 of those cards.
cards.flavor: Results, Delivered.

cards.name: Eru Ayase-Pessoa
cards.text: Once per turn → [click], take 1 tag: Run Archives. If successful, instead of breaching Archives, breach R&D. Threat 3 → Whenever you breach R&D during a run on Archives, access 1 additional card. (This ability is active if any player has 3 or more agenda points.)
cards.flavor: Luciana loved it when mamãe and papai finished work early, so they could all go home together.

cards.name: Federal Fundraising
cards.text: When your turn begins, you may look at the top 3 cards of R&D and arrange them in any order. Then, if this server is not protected by ice, you may draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Raising money is useful, but discovering which politician is in need of it is vastly more important.

cards.name: Front Company
cards.text:
Rez only during your turn.
The first run each turn cannot be made against a remote server.
The first time each turn a run on Archives begins, if this server is not protected by ice, do 2 net damage.
cards.flavor: "Do you take walk-ins?"

cards.name: Fujii Asset Retrieval
cards.text: When this agenda is scored or stolen, do 2 net damage.
cards.flavor: Deep down, she knew Benício wasnʼt coming back.

cards.name: Greasing the Palm
cards.text: Gain 5[credit]. You may install 1 card from HQ. You may remove 1 tag to place 1 advancement counter on that card.
cards.flavor: "Haas-Bioroid deeply appreciates your assistance in locating our... employee."

cards.name: Hannah "Wheels" Pilintra
cards.text: Once per turn → [click]: Gain [click]. Run a remote server. When that run ends, if it was unsuccessful, take 1 tag. [click], [trash]: Gain [click][click]. Remove 1 tag.
cards.flavor: "How far shall we go this time?"

cards.name: Hermes
cards.text: +1[mu] Whenever an agenda is scored or stolen, add 1 unrezzed card to HQ. Limit 1 console per player.
cards.flavor: This world is not beautiful, and yet that is why it is.

cards.name: Jaguarundi
cards.text: Threat 4 → When the Runner encounters this ice, give them 1 tag unless they spend [click]. (This ability is active if any player has 4 or more agenda points.) [subroutine] Give the Runner 1 tag. [subroutine] If the Runner is tagged, do 1 core damage.
cards.flavor:
"Hey Br3n-N, just doing the hourly check-in. I saw a weird cyber-echo near your last node. You OK, mate?"
—Moth

cards.name: Joy Ride
cards.text: Run R&D. If successful, draw 5 cards.
cards.flavor: Designed by 2020 American Continental Champion Jason Ford

cards.name: Lago Paranoá Shelter
cards.text: The first time each turn the Corp installs a card in the root of a server, you may trash the top card of your stack to draw 1 card.
cards.flavor:
"Animals, tea, meetings, dead drops. Paranoá has you covered, so we keep them covered."
—Sebastião Souza Pessoa

cards.name: Laser Pointer
cards.text: Whenever you encounter a piece of AP, destroyer, or observer ice, you may trash this program to bypass that ice.
cards.flavor: Dazzle. Disorient. Disappear.

cards.name: LilyPAD
cards.text: +2[mu] The first time each turn you install a program, you may draw 1 card. Limit 1 console per player.
cards.flavor: Leaps and bounds better than the competition!

cards.name: Living Mural
cards.text: Install only on a piece of ice. Threat 4 → When you install this program, it gets +3 strength for the remainder of the turn. (This ability is active if any player has 4 or more agenda points.) Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 subroutine on a sentry protecting this server. 1[credit]: +2 strength.

cards.name: M.I.C.
cards.text: [trash]: End the run unless the Runner spends [click]. Use this ability only during a run on this server. [subroutine] The Runner loses [click]. [subroutine] The Runner loses [click]. [subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor: We make these arms for all, so that none who oppose peace would risk their own destruction.

cards.name: Mercury: Chrome Libertador
cards.text: Once per turn → When you breach HQ or R&D during a run, if you did not break any subroutines during that run, you may access 1 additional card.
cards.flavor: I decided; I am free.

cards.name: Mindscaping
cards.text:
Resolve 1 of the following:
  • Gain 4[credit] and draw 2 cards. Add 1 card from HQ to the top of R&D.
  • Do X net damage. X is equal to the number of tags the Runner has, up to 3.
cards.flavor:
"When you stretch a mind it expands, sometimes until it snaps."
—Adrian Seis

cards.name: Monkeywrench
cards.text:
Install only on a piece of ice.
Host ice gets −2 strength. Each other piece of ice protecting this server gets −1 strength.
cards.flavor: Random sabotage accomplishes little; better to strike their weakest points again and again.

cards.name: Oppo Research
cards.text: Play only if the Runner stole or trashed a Corp card during their last turn. After you resolve this operation, your action phase ends. Give the Runner 2 tags. Threat 3 → You may pay 5[credit] to give the Runner 2 tags. (This ability is active if any player has 3 or more agenda points.)

cards.name: Oracle Thinktank
cards.text: When the Runner steals this agenda, give them 1 tag. [click], remove 1 tag: Shuffle this agenda into R&D. The Corp can use this ability only if this agenda is in the Runner's score area.
cards.flavor:
"You really thought weʼd let you keep this data?"
—The Holo Man

cards.name: Phoneutria
cards.text:
When the Runner passes this ice, if there are 4 or more cards in the grip, give them 1 tag.
[subroutine] Do 1 net damage.
[subroutine] Do 1 net damage.
cards.flavor: The construct turns to you, eyes wild. "Beloved," it asks, "is that you?"

cards.name: Pichação
cards.text:
Install only on a piece of ice.
Whenever you pass host ice, you may gain [click]. If this is not the first time you gained [click] during a run this turn, add this program to your grip.
cards.flavor:
"From up here, I can see everything. And from down there, everyone can see this."
—Víbora

cards.name: Pivot
cards.text: As an additional cost to play this operation, spend [click]. Search R&D for 1 operation or agenda and reveal it. (Shuffle R&D after searching it.) Add that card to HQ. Threat 3 → You may play or install 1 card from HQ. (This ability is active if any player has 3 or more agenda points.)

cards.name: S-Dobrado
cards.text: Run a central server. The first time you encounter a piece of ice during that run, bypass it. Threat 4 → The second time you encounter a piece of ice during that run, you may spend [click] to bypass it. (This ability is active if any player has 4 or more agenda points.)

cards.name: Saci
cards.text:
Install only on a piece of ice.
Whenever host ice is rezzed or derezzed, gain 3[credit].
cards.flavor:
I am life, I am sun,
Iʼm a trap, Iʼm a gun,
Iʼm the wind in the dust,
Iʼm the devil that you trust.

cards.name: Salvo Testing
cards.text: Whenever you score an agenda (including this one), you may do 1 core damage.
cards.flavor: "Yes, that explosion was quite loud. May I pour you another drink?"

cards.name: Shibboleth
cards.text: Threat 4 → This program gets −2 strength. (This ability is active if any player has 4 or more agenda points.) Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 code gate subroutine. 2[credit]: +2 strength.
cards.flavor:
"Corporate security regards me as merely another Nico, and that shall ever be their mistake."
—Mercury

cards.name: Slap Vandal
cards.text: Install only on a piece of ice. Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 subroutine on host ice. Use this ability only once per encounter.
cards.flavor:
"I consider it an improvement."
—Arissana Rocha Nahu

cards.name: Slash and Burn Agriculture
cards.text: [click], 1[credit], reveal and trash this agenda from HQ: Place 2 advancement counters on 1 installed card that you can advance.
cards.flavor: Acres of rainforest live or die by quarterly revenue projections.

cards.name: Solidarity Badge
cards.text:
The first time each turn you trash a Corp card, place 1 power counter on this hardware.
When your turn begins, you may remove 1 hosted power counter to draw 1 card or remove 1 tag.
cards.flavor: It is hard, once free, to learn when to call for help.

cards.name: Starlit Knight
cards.text:
Threat 4 → When the Runner encounters this ice, it gains X "[subroutine] End the run." subroutines for the remainder of this run, after its other subroutines. X is equal to the number of tags the Runner has.
[subroutine] Give the Runner 1 tag.
[subroutine] Give the Runner 1 tag.
cards.flavor: An exemplar of Starlightʼs hubris, it stands vigil over secrets of hypocrisy.

cards.name: Stegodon MK IV
cards.text: Each run, as long as a piece of ice has been derezzed during that run, each installed icebreaker gets –2 strength. Once per turn → When a run begins, you may derez 1 piece of ice not protecting the attacked server to gain 1[credit].
cards.flavor: Exceeding expectations for armor superiority.

cards.name: Strike Fund
cards.text:
Gain 4[credit].
When this event is trashed from your grip or stack, you may gain 2[credit].
cards.flavor: "If you want to put your money where your mouth is, there are some picketers who could use your support."

cards.name: Tatu-Bola
cards.text: When the Runner passes this ice, you may swap it with a piece of ice from HQ. If you do, gain 4[credit]. (The new ice is installed unrezzed. You do not pay an install cost.) [subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor: Next! Designed by 2020 Intercontinental Champion Yannick Stucki

cards.name: The Price
cards.text: Trash the top 4 cards of your stack. You may install 1 of those cards, paying 3[credit] less.
cards.flavor:
"You ask how we can even try to stop them? A simple answer: not alone."
—Sebastião Souza Pessoa

cards.name: Tree Line
