cards.text: [click], 1[credit], reveal and trash this ice from HQ: Place 3 advancement counters on 1 installed piece of ice. You can advance this ice. It gets +1 strength for each hosted advancement counter. [subroutine] Gain 1[credit]. End the run.
cards.flavor: The forest around them grew denser with each beat of their heart.

cards.name: Tucana
cards.text: Remote server only. Persistent → Whenever an agenda is scored or stolen from the root of this server, you may search R&D for 1 piece of ice. (Shuffle R&D after searching it.) Install and rez that ice, paying a total of 3[credit] less.
cards.flavor: Their mouths are ever open, blaring sirens never to cease.

cards.name: Umbrella
cards.text: This program can only interface with ice hosting a trojan program. Interface → 2[credit]: Break up to 3 code gate subroutines. If at least 1 subroutine was broken this way, each player may draw 1 card.
cards.flavor:
"However bad it gets out there, know that weʼll still have each other."
—Tom "Spider" Milhas

cards.name: Urban Art Vernissage
cards.text: When your turn begins, you may add 1 installed non-virus trojan program to your grip. If you do, place 2[credit] on this resource. You can spend hosted credits to install cards.
cards.flavor: "...and here, we can see an excellent example of meta neo-Gemeosianism."

cards.name: Valentão
cards.text:
As an additional cost to rez this ice, take 1 bad publicity or remove 1 tag.
[subroutine] Gain 2[credit].
[subroutine] The Runner loses 2[credit].
[subroutine] End the run if you have more credits than the Runner.
cards.flavor:
"The only rule you need to remember is that it makes the rules."
—Pumpkin-and-Dumplin

cards.name: Virtual Service Agent
cards.text: Whenever the Runner passes this ice after encountering it, if they did not break its printed subroutine with a decoder during that encounter, give them 1 tag. [subroutine] The Runner loses 1[credit].
cards.flavor:
"No one has ever told me to get lost so politely."
—Arissana Rocha Nahu

cards.name: Vovô Ozetti
cards.text: The rez cost of each piece of ice protecting this server is lowered by 2[credit]. Threat 4 → The rez cost of each card in the root of this server is lowered by 2[credit]. (This ability is active if any player has 4 or more agenda points.) When your turn ends, you may move this upgrade to the root of another server.

cards.name: Wage Workers
cards.text: Whenever you finish taking an action, if you have taken that action exactly 3 times this turn, gain [click].
cards.flavor: "Free" as in markets, "cheap" as in beer.

cards.name: Your Digital Life
cards.text: Gain 1[credit] for each card in HQ.
cards.flavor: Merely a fun little personality test.

cards.name: Active Policing
cards.text: Play only if the Runner stole or trashed a Corp card during their last turn. After you resolve this operation, your action phase ends. You may install 1 card from HQ. The Runner gets −1 allotted [click] for their next turn. Threat 3 → You may pay 2[credit]. If you do, the Runner gets −1 allotted [click] for their next turn. (This ability is active if any player has 3 or more agenda points.)

cards.name: Alarm Clock
cards.text: When your turn begins, you may run HQ. The first time you encounter a piece of ice during that run, you may spend [click][click] to bypass it.
cards.flavor: Rise and shine. Time to f**k up a corpie's day.

cards.name: Amanuensis
cards.text: +1[mu] When your turn ends, place 1 power counter on this hardware if you are tagged. Whenever you remove 1 or more tags, you may remove 1 hosted power counter to draw 2 cards. Limit 1 console per player.
cards.flavor: He allowed himself five minutes. He wished for more.

cards.name: Amelia Earhart
cards.text:
Whenever a run on HQ or R&D ends, if you accessed 3 or more cards during that run, place 1 power counter on this resource.
When your turn begins, you may remove 3 hosted power counters and trash this resource. If you do, the Corp loses 10[credit].
cards.flavor: Designed by 2021 American Continental Champion Jonas Wilson

cards.name: Arruaceiras Crew
cards.text: Once per turn → Take 1 tag: The ice you are encountering gets –2 strength for the remainder of this encounter. [trash], 2[credit]: Trash the ice you are encountering if its strength is 0 or less.
cards.flavor: “You might have been the spark, Seb, but we're the flame.”

cards.name: Ashen Epilogue
cards.text:
Shuffle your grip and heap into your stack, then remove the top 5 cards of your stack from the game. Draw 5 cards.
Remove this event from the game.
cards.flavor: Their victory became her coronation.

cards.name: Boi-tatá
cards.text: If you trashed any of your installed cards this turn, paid abilities on this program cost 1[credit] less to use. Interface → 2[credit]: Break up to 2 sentry subroutines. 3[credit]: +3 strength.
cards.flavor: Blinded by its own wreath of flames, the Boi-tatá seeks eye after eye until the whole world joins it in darkness.

cards.name: Boto
cards.text: Threat 4 → This ice gets +2 strength. (This ability is active if any player has 4 or more agenda points.) [subroutine] Do 2 net damage. [subroutine] You may trash 1 card from HQ to end the run. [subroutine] You may trash 1 card from HQ to end the run.
cards.flavor: They live forever in the rivers of the Net.

cards.name: Brasília Government Grid
cards.text: Once per turn → When you rez a piece of ice during a run against this server, you may derez another installed piece of ice. If you do, the rezzed ice gets +3 strength for the remainder of that run. Limit 1 region per server.
cards.flavor: Thunderbolt naturally offered city hardening solutions.

cards.name: Bring Them Home
cards.text:
Play only if the Runner stole or trashed a Corp card during their last turn.
After you resolve this operation, your action phase ends.
Reveal and add 2 cards at random from the grip to the top of the stack.
Threat 3 → You may pay 2[credit] to reveal 1 card in the grip at random. The Runner shuffles it into the stack.

cards.name: Burner
cards.text: Run HQ. If successful, instead of breaching HQ, reveal 3 cards in HQ at random. Add 2 of the revealed cards to the top and/or bottom of R&D.
cards.flavor:
“They‘ll be talking about me for years.”
—Arissana Rocha Nahu

cards.name: Business As Usual
cards.text:
Resolve 1 of the following:
  • Place 1 advancement counter on each of up to 2 installed cards you can advance.
  • Remove all virus counters from 1 installed card.
Threat 3 → You may also resolve the other mode. (This ability is active if any player has 3 or more agenda points.)
cards.flavor: Don’t think about it. You’ll sleep better.

cards.name: Capacitor
cards.text:
While the Runner is tagged, this ice gets +2 strength.
[subroutine] Gain 1[credit] for each tag the Runner has.
[subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor: Sebastião gritted his teeth as more and more indicators glowed red.

cards.name: Cataloguer
cards.text: When you install this hardware, load 2 power counters onto it. When it is empty, trash it. Whenever you make a successful run on R&D, instead of breaching R&D, you may remove 1 hosted power counter to look at the top 4 cards of R&D and arrange them in any order. [click], hosted power counter: Breach R&D. Use this ability only if you made a successful run on R&D this turn.

cards.name: Charlotte Caçador
cards.text: You can advance this asset. When your turn begins, you may remove 1 hosted advancement counter to gain 4[credit] and draw 1 card. [trash], hosted advancement counter: Gain 3[credit].
cards.flavor: “They offered me a desk job, but dammit, I just love working in the field.”

cards.name: Cloud Eater
cards.text:
Whenever an encounter with this ice ends, if it was rezzed this turn, trash 1 installed Runner card unless the Runner takes 2 tags or suffers 3 net damage.
[subroutine] Trash 1 installed Runner card.
[subroutine] Give the Runner 2 tags.
[subroutine] Do 3 net damage.
cards.flavor: Don’t let it catch your scent.

cards.name: Coalescence
cards.text: When you install this program, place 2 power counters on it. Hosted power counter: Gain 2[credit]. Use this ability only during your turn.
cards.flavor:
Breathe in.
Be as the dew rolling down a leaf; let yourself go.
Breathe out.

cards.name: Cohort Guidance Program
cards.text:
When your turn begins, you may resolve 1 of the following:
  • Trash 1 card from HQ. If you do, gain 2[credit] and draw 1 card.
  • Turn 1 facedown card in Archives faceup. If you do, place 1 advancement counter on an installed card.
cards.flavor: The best families grow, learn, and hunt together.

cards.name: Corporate Hospitality
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this operation, spend [click].
Gain 6[credit] and draw 2 cards. Add 1 card from Archives to HQ.
cards.flavor: If you wait in the Thunderbolt corporate box long enough, everyone who is anyone comes by.

cards.name: Cupellation
cards.text: Limit 1 hosted card. Access → 1[credit]: Host the non-agenda card you are accessing faceup on this program. (If it was installed, it becomes uninstalled.) Whenever you breach HQ, if this program has a hosted Corp card, you may pay 1[credit] and trash this program to access 2 additional cards.

cards.name: Descent
cards.text: [click], 1[credit], reveal and trash this ice from HQ: Draw 1 card. Reveal up to 2 agendas in HQ and/or Archives and shuffle them into R&D. When your turn begins, you may add this ice to HQ. [subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor: A little circular reasoning never hurt anybody.

cards.name: Eminent Domain
cards.text: [click], 1[credit], reveal and trash this agenda from HQ: Install and rez 1 card from HQ, paying a total of 5[credit] less. When you score this agenda, you may search R&D for 1 card. (Shuffle R&D after searching it.) Install and rez that card, ignoring all costs.
cards.flavor: Young Gael Oliveira agreed to stay on and manage the farm, for a fee.

cards.name: Eye for an Eye
cards.text: Play only if you are not tagged. Run HQ. If successful, take 1 tag and access 1 additional card when you breach HQ. Access → Trash 1 card from your grip: Trash the card you are accessing.
cards.flavor: As the riot turned to open conflict, Seb looked down at the gun in his hand. The time for peace was over.

cards.name: Friend of a Friend
cards.text: [click], [trash]: Gain 5[credit] and remove 1 tag. [click], [trash]: Gain 9[credit] and take 1 tag. Use this ability only if you are not tagged.
cards.flavor:
“I've been a pack runner since I was ten. My uncle got me started after Eduardo took a bullet to the hip. It's only recently that people have started cheering when I leave a cop lying in the dirt.”
—Gabi Saka

cards.name: Hammer
cards.text: During each encounter with this ice, the Runner cannot break more than 1 of its printed subroutines except using killers. [subroutine] Give the Runner 1 tag. [subroutine] Trash 1 installed resource or piece of hardware. [subroutine] Trash 1 installed program that is not a decoder, fracter, or killer.
cards.flavor: The final blow is struck.

cards.name: Hearts and Minds
cards.text: When your turn begins, you may move 1 advancement counter from an installed card to an installed card you can advance. If this server is not protected by ice, you may also place 1 advancement counter on an installed card you can advance.
cards.flavor:
“General, for a successful coup d'état, you need the people on your side.”
—CEO Braganza

cards.name: Heliamphora
cards.text: [interrupt] → Whenever you would access a card in Archives, you may host it faceup on this program instead. (It is not installed.) Use this ability only once each time you breach Archives. When the Corp purges virus counters, they trash 2 cards from HQ at random. Trash this program.
cards.flavor: Even a barren server can provide a feast, if you are patient enough.

cards.name: Isaac Liberdade
cards.text:
Each advanced piece of ice protecting this server gets +2 strength.
Whenever this upgrade moves to the root of a server, you may place 1 advancement counter on a piece of ice protecting that server that has no advancement counters.
When your turn ends, you may move this upgrade to the root of another server.

cards.name: Janaína “JK” Dumont Kindelán
cards.text: When your turn begins, place 3[credit] on this asset. [click], add this asset to HQ: Take all credits from this asset. You may install 1 card from HQ.
cards.flavor: She loved being part of the rough and tumble of politics and fundraising—from the calm of her own home.

cards.name: Jeitinho
cards.text: When your turn ends, if you made a successful run on HQ, R&D, and Archives this turn, you may add this hardware to your score area as an assassination agenda worth 0 agenda points. Then, if you have 3 assassination agendas in your score area, you win the game. Threat 3 → Whenever you bypass a piece of ice, you may spend [click] to install this hardware from your heap.

cards.name: Juli Moreira Lee
cards.text:
When you install this resource, load 4 power counters onto it. When it is empty, trash it.
The first time each turn you take an action on an installed resource, remove 1 hosted power counter and gain [click].
cards.flavor: The Moreira sisters couldn't be any less alike, each taking after her own father, but together they are a force unto themselves.

cards.name: Kingmaking
cards.text: When you score this agenda, draw up to 3 cards. You may add 1 agenda worth 1 or less agenda points from HQ to your score area.
cards.flavor:
“We are close, so close, to the endgame now, my friends. If we can convert just three more, the Automata Initiative is all but through the senate.”
—The Holo Man

cards.name: Lightning Laboratory
cards.text:
When you score this agenda, place 1 agenda counter on it.
Whenever a run begins, you may remove 1 hosted agenda counter to rez up to 2 pieces of ice protecting the attacked server, ignoring all costs. When this turn ends, derez 2 pieces of ice protecting that server.
cards.flavor: Where ideas strike twice!

cards.name: Lobisomem
cards.text: When you install this program and whenever it fully breaks a code gate, place 1 power counter on this program. Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 code gate subroutine. Interface → X[credit], hosted power counter: Break X barrier subroutines. 1[credit]: +2 strength.

cards.name: Logjam
cards.text:
You can advance this ice. It gets +1 strength for each hosted advancement counter.
When you rez this ice, place 1 advancement counter on it plus 1 advancement counter for each card type among faceup cards in Archives.
[subroutine] Gain 2[credit]. End the run.
[subroutine] End the run.
[subroutine] End the run.

cards.name: Lycian Multi-Munition
cards.text: When you rez this ice, choose 1 or more subtypes among barrier, code gate, and sentry. This ice gains the chosen subtypes while it remains rezzed. When a turn ends, derez this ice. [subroutine] If this ice is a code gate, the Runner loses [click] and 1[credit]. [subroutine] If this ice is a sentry, trash 1 installed program. [subroutine] If this ice is a barrier, gain 1[credit] and end the run.

cards.name: Malandragem
cards.text:
When you install this program, load 2 power counters onto it. When it is empty, remove it from the game.
Once per turn → When you encounter a piece of ice, if its strength is 3 or less, you may remove 1 hosted power counter to bypass it.
Threat 4 → Whenever you encounter a piece of ice, you may remove this program from the game to bypass it.

cards.name: Manuel Lattes de Moura
cards.text: Whenever you breach HQ or R&D while you are tagged, access 1 additional card. Threat 3 → As an additional cost to trash this resource with the basic action, the Corp must trash 1 card from HQ. (This ability is active if any player has 3 or more agenda points.)
cards.flavor: “Some info from our mutual friends, Professor. Now, about my daughter's grades…”

cards.name: Meeting of Minds
cards.text: Choose connection or virtual. You may search your stack for 1 resource with the chosen subtype and reveal it. Add that card to your grip. Reveal any number of cards with the chosen subtype in your grip. Gain 1[credit] for each card revealed this way.
cards.flavor: “You'll find a way, little sibling.”

cards.name: Muse
cards.text: When you install this program, search your stack, heap, or grip for 1 non-daemon program. (Shuffle your stack after searching it.) If that program is a trojan, install it on a piece of ice. Otherwise, install it on this program.
cards.flavor: Vó, mentor, angel. Murdered by porcos. Never forgotten.

cards.name: Nuvem SA: Law of the Land
cards.text: Whenever you finish resolving an operation or an action on an expendable card, look at the top card of R&D. You may trash that card. The first time you trash a card from R&D during each of your turns, gain 2[credit].
cards.flavor: Our fist shall hold the world.

cards.name: Physarum Entangler
cards.text: Install only on a piece of ice. Whenever you encounter host ice, if it is not a barrier, you may pay 1[credit] for each subroutine it has. If you do, bypass that ice. When the Corp purges virus counters, trash this program.
cards.flavor: It finds a route, eventually.

cards.name: Piranhas
cards.text:
As an additional cost to rez this ice, take 1 bad publicity or remove 1 tag.
[subroutine] You may draw 1 card.
[subroutine] Do 1 net damage.
[subroutine] End the run if there are more cards in HQ than in the grip.
cards.flavor: Eat, grow, deny. A truly ravenous generation.

cards.name: Pressure Spike
cards.text: Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 barrier subroutine. 2[credit]: +3 strength. Threat 4 → 2[credit]: +9 strength. Use this ability only once per run. (This ability is active if any player has 4 or more agenda points.)
cards.flavor:
“If stress hurts, then it must be a weapon.”
— Beatriz Friere Gonzalez

cards.name: Privileged Access
cards.text:
Play only if you are not tagged.
Run Archives. If successful, instead of breaching Archives, take 1 tag.
When you take a tag with this event, you may install 1 resource from your heap, paying 2[credit] less.
Threat 3 → When you take a tag with this event, you may install 1 program from your heap.

cards.name: Sebastião Souza Pessoa: Activist Organizer
cards.text: Whenever you take 1 or more tags, if you had no tags, you may install 1 connection resource from your grip, paying 2[credit] less. As an additional cost to trash a connection resource with the basic action, the Corp must trash 1 card from HQ.
cards.flavor: Destroy the mechanisms of domination.

cards.name: See How They Run
cards.text: When you score this agenda, give the Runner 1 tag. Play a Psi Game. (Players secretly bid 0–2[credit]. Then each player reveals and spends their bid.) If the bids differ, do 1 core damage. If the bids match, do 1 net damage.
cards.flavor:
“Be patient. When the prey panics, they lead you right to their friends.”
—Adrian Seis

cards.name: Seraph
cards.text:
When the Runner encounters this ice, they lose 3[credit] unless they suffer 2 net damage or take 1 tag.
[subroutine] The Runner loses 3[credit].
[subroutine] Do 2 net damage.
[subroutine] Give the Runner 1 tag.
cards.flavor:
“Starlight called it a gift. I call it providence.”
—The Holo Man

cards.name: Sisyphus Protocol
cards.text: The first time each turn the Runner passes a rezzed code gate or sentry, you may pay 1[credit] or trash 1 card from HQ. If you do, the Runner encounters that ice again.
cards.flavor:
“Every mind can be dulled by repetition, even our prey’s. Strike when they get complacent, but before you get bored.”
—Charlotte's fifth lesson

cards.name: Sorocaban Blade
cards.text:
You cannot trash more than 1 installed Runner card with this ice during each encounter.
[subroutine] Trash 1 installed resource.
[subroutine] Trash 1 installed piece of hardware.
[subroutine] Trash 1 installed program.
cards.flavor: At Thunderbolt, we ask: why not turn plowshares to swords?

cards.name: Spree
cards.text: Place 3 power counters on this event, then run any server. Hosted power counter: Host 1 installed trojan program on a piece of ice protecting the attacked server.
cards.flavor: Sometimes an artist will be seized by the uncontrollable urge to create.

cards.name: Stoke the Embers
cards.text:
When you score this agenda, gain 3[credit] and place 1 advancement counter on an installed card.
When you install this agenda from anywhere except HQ, you may reveal it. If you do, gain 2[credit] and place 1 advancement counter on an installed card.
cards.flavor: “Up next: President Tavares' state funeral.”

cards.name: Sudden Commandment
cards.text: Draw 2 cards. You may play 1 non-terminal operation from HQ. Threat 3 → If this operation is the first mandate you played this turn, you may pay 3[credit] to gain [click]. (This ability is active if any player has 3 or more agenda points.)
cards.flavor: Epiphany employees learned not to make weekend plans.

cards.name: The Basalt Spire
cards.text: When the Runner steals this agenda, you may add 1 card from Archives to HQ. When you score this agenda, place 2 agenda counters on it. Once per turn → Hosted agenda counter, trash the top card of R&D: Add 1 card from Archives to HQ.
cards.flavor:
High above, Braganza schemes,
Of force, fire, and basalt dreams.

cards.name: The Holo Man
cards.text: When your turn begins, you may move this upgrade to the root of another server. Once per turn → [click], 4[credit]: Place 2 advancement counters on 1 card in the root of or protecting this server. If you have not installed any cards from HQ this turn, instead place 3 advancement counters on that card.

cards.name: The Powers That Be
cards.text: Whenever you score an agenda, you may install 1 card from HQ or Archives, ignoring all costs.
cards.flavor:
“I followed every lead, and found the rot ran deep from Epiphany, worming into every branch of gov'. I saw my imperative, clear as day: these three had to die. And I had to find a way to do it.”
—Mercury

cards.name: The Wizard’s Chest
cards.text: Use this hardware only if you made a successful run on HQ, R&D, and Archives this turn. [trash]: Choose hardware, program, or resource. Set aside cards from the top of your stack faceup until you set aside 2 cards of the chosen type. You may install 1 of those 2 cards, ignoring all costs. Shuffle the rest of the set-aside cards into your stack.
cards.flavor: Designed by 2020 World Champion Richard Hall

cards.name: Thunderbolt Armaments: Peace Through Power
cards.text: Whenever you rez a piece of AP or destroyer ice during a run, that ice gets +1 strength and gains “[subroutine] End the run unless the Runner trashes 1 of their installed cards.” after its other subroutines for the remainder of that run.
cards.flavor: Strength in the palm of your hand.

cards.name: Tributary
cards.text: The first time each turn a run begins, you may move this ice to the outermost position protecting the attacked server. (The Runner will approach this ice.) [subroutine] You may draw 1 card. You may install 1 piece of ice from HQ protecting another server, ignoring all costs. [subroutine] Each piece of ice gets +2 strength for the remainder of this run.

cards.name: Trick Shot
cards.text:
Place 4[credit] on this event. You can spend hosted credits during runs.
Run R&D. If successful, place 2[credit] on this event and access 1 additional card when you breach R&D.
When that run ends, you may run a remote server.
cards.flavor: 8 billion, corner office.

cards.name: Valentina Ferreira Carvalho
cards.text: Whenever you remove 1 or more tags, gain 1[credit]. Threat 3 → When you install this resource during your turn, you may remove 1 tag or gain 2[credit]. (This ability is active if any player has 3 or more agenda points.)
cards.flavor: “I came home from Siberia to find a better purpose for myself.”

cards.name: Warm Reception
cards.text: When your turn begins, you may install 1 card from HQ. You cannot score that card this turn. If this server is not protected by ice, you may derez this asset to derez another installed card.
cards.flavor: “I missed you last week! Come, we have lots to talk about. How was little Sarita's piano recital?”

cards.name: Window of Opportunity
cards.text:
You may install 1 program or piece of hardware from your grip.
Run any server. When that run begins, derez 1 piece of ice protecting that server. When that run ends, the Corp may rez the ice derezzed this way, ignoring all costs.
cards.flavor: There's a crack in everything. That's how the light gets in.

cards.name: Working Prototype
cards.text: Whenever you rez a card (including this asset), place 1 power counter on this asset. [click], hosted power counter: Gain 3[credit]. [click], 5 hosted power counters: Gain 6[credit]. Add 1 installed resource to the top of the stack.
cards.flavor: “Just tilt your head a little to the right; the suit will soon sync with your cortical profile.”

cards.name: “Pretty” Mary da Silva
cards.text: Whenever you breach R&D, if you are allowed to access 2 or more cards in R&D during this breach, you may access 1 additional card.
cards.flavor: “Listen up, garotinha, maybe you'll learn something.”

cards.name: AU Co.: The Gold Standard in Clones
cards.text:
Whenever you do damage or trash 1 or more cards from HQ, place 1 power counter on this identity.
When your turn begins, you may remove 2 hosted power counters to look at the top 3 cards of R&D. Trash 1 of those cards and add the rest to HQ.

cards.name: Aggressive Trendsetting
cards.text: The first time the Runner trashes an installed Corp card during each of their turns, they may spend [click]. If they do not, you get +1 allotted [click] for your next turn.
cards.flavor: “Don’t tell me you were at the gala, darling? I must not have seen you!”

cards.name: Anthill Excavation Contract
cards.text:
When you rez this asset, load 8[credit] onto it. When it is empty, trash it.
When your turn begins, take 4[credit] from this asset and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor:
“If you lived here, you’d be at work by now!”
—Weyland recruiter

cards.name: Azimat
cards.text: 2[recurring-credit] (When you install this program and before your turn begins, refill to 2 hosted credits.) You can spend hosted credits to pay trash costs.
cards.flavor:
“For my children’s sake, I’ll endure any pain.”
—Dewi Subrotoputri, as Dyah Kunthi

cards.name: BANGUN: When Disaster Strikes
cards.text: You may install agendas faceup. (This does not make their abilities active.) Whenever the Runner accesses a faceup installed agenda, do 2 meat damage and give the Runner 1 tag.
cards.flavor: We’ll be there.

cards.name: Barry “Baz” Wong: Tri-Maf Veteran
cards.text: Whenever the Corp rezzes a piece of ice, you may install 1 resource or piece of hardware from your grip.
cards.flavor: Try me.

cards.name: Biawak
cards.text:
You can forfeit 1 agenda as you rez this ice to pay for 10[credit] of its rez cost.
[subroutine] Trash 1 installed program or end the run.
[subroutine] Trash 1 installed resource or end the run.
[subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor:
“Dammit, Moth! Where are you? This thing is way bigger than you s—”
—C0nr4d

cards.name: Bigger Picture
cards.text:
Play only if the Runner is tagged. Resolve 1 of the following:
  • Give the Runner 1 tag.
  • Remove any number of tags. The Runner loses 5[credit] for each tag removed this way. Gain credits equal to the number of credits the Runner lost.

cards.name: Bling
cards.text: +1[mu] Whenever you install a card without spending credits, you may host the top card of your stack faceup on this hardware. (It is not installed.) You can play or install hosted cards as if they were in your grip. When your discard phase ends, trash all hosted cards. Limit 1 console per player.

cards.name: Bumi 1.0
cards.text: When you rez this ice during a run against this server, you may trash 1 installed trojan program. Lose [click]: Break 1 subroutine on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability. [subroutine] Trash 1 installed program. [subroutine] Do 1 core damage.
cards.flavor: “You dare?”

cards.name: Byte!
cards.text:
While the Runner is accessing this asset in R&D, they must reveal it.
When the Runner accesses this asset anywhere except in Archives, you may pay 4[credit]. If you do, give the Runner 1 tag and do 3 net damage.
cards.flavor: You thought you were safe?

cards.name: Cacophony
cards.text: The first time each turn you steal or trash a Corp card, place 1 power counter on this resource. When your action phase ends, you may remove 2 hosted power counters to sabotage 3. (The Corp trashes 3 cards of their choice from HQ and/or the top of R&D.)
cards.flavor:
“Nil SIR, black noise, lost girls, drowned boys!”
—Ryō “Phoenix” Ōno

cards.name: Charm Offensive
cards.text: Run Archives. When that run ends, you may trash 1 rezzed copy of a card you accessed in Archives during that run.
cards.flavor: “I’ll use what I have to get what I want.”

cards.name: Chromatophores
cards.text: Install only on a piece of ice. Host ice gains barrier, code gate, and sentry.
cards.flavor:
“The Net operates almost as much on dream logic as it does digital logic. If you believe something to be true, it often is.”
—The Encyclopedia Silica

cards.name: Clean Getaway
cards.text: Run any server. If successful, gain 6[credit].
cards.flavor:
“…one-hundred and twenty-seven rounds fired, and two police hoppers totaled. Miraculously, no officers were hurt, though the suspect remains at large.”
—Abdul el-Sattar, KKN 6

cards.name: Detente
cards.text: +1[mu] The first time each turn you make a successful run on HQ, you may host 1 card from HQ at random faceup on this hardware. (It is not installed or rezzed.) [click], add 2 hosted cards to HQ: The Runner may access 1 card in HQ at random. Any player can use this ability. Limit 1 console per player.

cards.name: Devadatta Drone
cards.text:
When you install this program, place 2 power counters on it.
Whenever you breach R&D, you may remove 1 hosted power counter to access 1 additional card.
cards.flavor:
“I still have friends on the inside.”
—Magdalene Keino-Chemutai

cards.name: Dewi Subrotoputri: Pedagogical Dhalang
cards.text:
Whenever you make a successful run, if your [mu] is full, you may flip this identity and gain 1[credit].
Flip side:
Whenever you make a successful run, if you have at least 1 unused [mu], you may flip this identity and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor:
Who else will teach the stories of good and evil?
We can’t leave the corps’ dirty deeds in the shadows.

cards.name: Doomscroll
cards.text:
[subroutine] Give the Runner 1 tag.
[subroutine] Do 1 net damage.
[subroutine] Do 2 net damage if the Runner has at least 2 tags.
cards.flavor:
They know what makes you tick.
And ticked-off.

cards.name: Embedded Reporting
cards.text: Dividends 2 (When you score this agenda, place 2 agenda counters on it for each excess advancement counter.) When your discard phase ends, you may remove 1 hosted agenda counter to search R&D for 1 operation and reveal it. (Shuffle R&D after searching it.) Add that operation to the top of R&D.

cards.name: Empiricist
cards.text:
[subroutine] Draw 1 card. You may add 1 card from HQ to the top of R&D.
[subroutine] Do 1 net damage. Give the Runner 1 tag.
[subroutine] Do 2 net damage.
cards.flavor: Jinteki’s most experimental ice are often their most dangerous.

cards.name: Flyswatter
cards.text:
When you rez this ice during a run against this server, purge virus counters.
[subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor: Stop that.

cards.name: Fransofia Ward
cards.text: The rez cost of each piece of ice is increased by 1[credit]. Whenever you encounter a piece of ice, if the Corp has 15[credit] or more, you may trash this resource to bypass that ice. (Pass that ice. No subroutines or further "when encountered" abilities resolve.)
cards.flavor:
“She’s learned from the best: me. When I retire, the KK Tri-Maf’ll be in good hands.”
—Barry “Baz” Wong

cards.name: GAMEDRAGON™ Pro
cards.text: When you install this hardware and when your turn begins, you may host this hardware on an installed non-AI icebreaker. Host icebreaker gets +1 strength. Abilities that increase its strength last for the remainder of the run (instead of any shorter duration).

cards.name: Gourmand
cards.text: Access → [trash]: Trash the non-agenda card you are accessing. If you do, draw 1 card.

cards.name: Greenmail
cards.text:
When you score this agenda, gain 2[credit].
When you forfeit this agenda, gain 4[credit].
cards.flavor: “It’s been a real pleasure doing business with you.”

cards.name: Hantu
cards.text: When you install this program, place 2 virus counters on it. Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 sentry subroutine. Hosted virus counter: +2 strength.
cards.flavor:
“I’m on retainer for monthly purges on thirty-six different servers.”
—Ratu Maharani, pawang virus

cards.name: Humanoid Resources
cards.text: [click][click][click], [trash]: Gain 4[credit] and draw 3 cards. Install up to 2 cards from HQ (one at a time). You may play 1 operation from HQ.
cards.flavor: “Deploying in T-minus 5…”

cards.name: IP Enforcement
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this operation, remove X tags.
Install 1 agenda from the Runner’s score area with a printed agenda point value equal to X. If the Runner is still tagged, place 1 advancement counter on that agenda.
cards.flavor: “I believe you have something of ours.”

cards.name: Idiosyncresis
cards.text:
You can advance this asset.
When your turn begins, you may trash this asset. If you do, for each hosted advancement counter, gain 3[credit] and the Runner loses 2[credit].
cards.flavor: You don’t really want to know what makes you unique as a person. It’s so much less than you think.

cards.name: Illumination
cards.text: Run R&D. If successful, install up to 3 cards from your grip (one at a time), paying 1[credit] less for each.
cards.flavor: “Won’t she get in trouble for putting that in the show? And how did she even find out?!”

cards.name: Kessleroid
cards.text: The Runner cannot trash this ice (while it is rezzed). [subroutine] End the run. [subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor:
“The detritus of failed incursions accumulates. Instead of sweeping it all away, the parsimonious sysop should nudge this debris into defensive positions in the server’s metagravity well.”
—Moira Virtue, Ice Engineering, KKU

cards.name: Key Performance Indicators
cards.text:
Resolve 2 of the following in any order:
  • Draw 1 card. Shuffle 1 card from HQ into R&D.
  • Install 1 piece of ice from HQ, ignoring all costs.
  • Place 1 advancement counter on an installed card you can advance.
  • Gain 2[credit].
cards.flavor: Designed by 2023 World Champion William “Sokka” Huang

cards.name: LEO Construction: Labor Solutions
cards.text: Once per turn → Trash 1 rezzed bioroid card in the root of or protecting the attacked server: End the run.
cards.flavor: Workers of the World, Delivered.

cards.name: Lamplighter
cards.text:
When an agenda is scored or stolen from this server or its root, trash this ice.
[subroutine] Give the Runner 1 tag unless they pay 3[credit].
[subroutine] End the run if the Runner is tagged.
cards.flavor: Itur in antiquam telam.

cards.name: Lie Low
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this event, spend [click]. Resolve 1 of the following:
  • Draw 4 cards.
  • Remove up to 2 tags.
cards.flavor: “Pity the money’s being spent here, when I could be buying hiasan for my apartment.”

cards.name: Madani
cards.text: [click]: Host any number of programs from your grip faceup on this hardware. (They are not installed.) Once per turn → 0[credit]: Install 1 hosted program (paying its install cost). Limit 1 console per player.

cards.name: Magdalene Keino-Chemutai: Cryptarchitect
cards.text: Whenever you discard cards to reach your maximum hand size, you may install 1 program or piece of hardware from among those cards.
cards.flavor: Good design is invisible—but I’ll never settle for ‘good’.

cards.name: Maglectric Rapid (748 Mod)
cards.text: Whenever you make a successful run on HQ, you may trash this hardware to derez 1 installed Corp card.
cards.flavor:
“You think I’ve finished messing with you?
Yeah, nah.”
—Barry “Baz” Wong

cards.name: Mahkota Langit Grid
cards.text: 2[recurring-credit] (When you rez this upgrade and before your turn begins, refill to 2 hosted credits.) You can spend hosted credits to rez assets in the root of this server and ice protecting this server. Persistent → The trash cost of each asset in the root of this server is increased by 2[credit]. Limit 1 region per server.

cards.name: Maintenance Access
cards.text: As an additional cost to play this event, spend [click]. Run Archives. When you would approach Archives (after passing all ice), instead change the attacked server to HQ and approach HQ.
cards.flavor:
“Don’t let self-respect get in the way of a good shortcut.”
—“G0ph3r” OʼRyan

cards.name: Measured Response
cards.text:
Play only if the threat level is 4 or greater, and only if the Runner made a successful run during their last turn.
Do 4 meat damage unless the Runner pays 8[credit].
cards.flavor:
“We would like to reassure our shareholders that none of the buildings damaged in the blast were owned by Weyland Consortium subsidiaries…”
—Luana Campos, Weyland spokesperson

cards.name: Mercia B4LL4RD
cards.text: When your action phase ends, you may install 1 piece of ice from HQ, paying 1[credit] less. If you do, move this upgrade to the root of the server that piece of ice is protecting.
cards.flavor: “My predecessor had passion, imagination, ambition. I assure you, I possess no such flaws.”

cards.name: Mitra Aman
cards.text: Whenever the Runner approaches a piece of ice protecting this server, you may trash this upgrade. If you do, gain 3[credit] and you may swap the ice being approached with a piece of ice from Archives or HQ.
cards.flavor: Spring-loaded minds, kept in suspension to be launched into the net at any incursion.

cards.name: MuslihaT: Multifarious Marketeer
cards.text: When your turn begins, look at the top card of your stack. If that card is an icebreaker or a run event, you may reveal it and add it to your grip.
cards.flavor: Peer pressure works.

cards.name: Mycoweb
cards.text: [subroutine] You may install 1 piece of ice from Archives, ignoring all costs. [subroutine] You may rez 1 installed piece of ice, paying 2[credit] less. [subroutine] Resolve 1 subroutine on a rezzed sentry. [subroutine] Resolve 1 subroutine on another rezzed code gate.

cards.name: N-Pot
cards.text: 3[credit]: Break 1 subroutine on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability. [subroutine] End the run. [subroutine] If the threat level is 2 or greater, end the run. [subroutine] If the threat level is 4 or greater, end the run.
cards.flavor:
”On the Net, we hold the power.”
 —Arnold Teoh, NBN technologist

cards.name: Nanomanagement
cards.text: Gain [click][click].
cards.flavor:
“I am a very reasonable manager. I do not expect my staff to do anything I could not do.”
—Bass CH1R180G4

cards.name: Nebula Talent Management: Making Stars
cards.text:
When your action phase ends, if you played an operation this turn, gain 1[credit] and flip this identity.
Flip side:
The first time each turn you play an operation, gain [click].
When the Runner makes a successful run on HQ or R&D, flip this identity.
cards.flavor:
Igniting your potential.
Never stop shining.

cards.name: Next Big Thing
cards.text: When this agenda is scored or stolen, place 1 agenda counter on it. [click], hosted agenda counter: Draw 4 cards. Shuffle any number of cards from HQ into R&D. The Corp can use this ability even if this agenda is in the Runner's score area.
cards.flavor: That’s so fifteen minutes ago.

cards.name: Off the Books
cards.text: Dividends 1 (When you score this agenda, place 1 agenda counter on it for each excess advancement counter.) When your discard phase ends, you may remove 1 hosted agenda counter to search R&D for 1 card and reveal it. (Shuffle R&D after searching it.) You may install that card, ignoring all costs. If you do not, add it to HQ.

cards.name: Open Market
cards.text: When you install this resource, load 6[credit] onto it. When it is empty, trash it. You can spend hosted credits to install connection and job resources. When your turn begins, take 1[credit] from this resource.
cards.flavor:
“That kepo NBN gang makes trillions off incidental data scraping. So what if I use it to network?”
—MuslihaT

cards.name: Otto Campaign
cards.text:
When you rez this asset, load 6[credit] onto it. When it is empty, trash it and gain [click][click].
When your turn begins, take 2[credit] from this asset.
cards.flavor: “Don’t be scared of the Ottos, kiddo. They’re building our future!”

cards.name: PT Untaian: Life's Building Blocks
cards.text: When your discard phase ends, if there are 3 or fewer cards in HQ, you may pay 1[credit] to place 1 advancement counter on an unrezzed card you can advance. (You cannot score that card this turn.)
cards.flavor: The Looming Future.

cards.name: Peer Review
cards.text:
Reveal all but 1 card in HQ.
Gain 7[credit]. You may install 1 card from HQ in the root of a remote server.
cards.flavor: Peer reviews are the difference between living in the arcs and living in the slums. Cloneline gengineering never made anything as vicious or cutthroat as a Jinteki scientist.

cards.name: Petty Cash
cards.text: Play only if you have not finished an action yet this turn. Gain 5[credit]. If you played this operation from anywhere except HQ, gain [click]. [click]: Play this operation from Archives. After it resolves, remove it from the game.

cards.name: Phật Gioan Baotixita
cards.text:
When your discard phase ends, place 1 power counter on this asset.
The first time each turn an agenda is scored or stolen, you may remove up to 2 hosted power counters. Do 1 net damage plus 1 net damage for each power counter removed this way.
cards.flavor: “I make the best company.”

cards.name: Plutus
cards.text: As an additional cost to rez this asset, forfeit 1 agenda or reveal and trash 3 cards from HQ. When your turn begins, you may play 1 transaction operation from Archives. After it resolves, remove it from the game.
cards.flavor: “Rejoice, executives! The Net has sent unto us a profit!”

cards.name: Poétrï Luxury Brands: All the Rage
cards.text:
Whenever you score an agenda, look at the top 3 cards of R&D. You may install 1 non-agenda card from among them.
Whenever an agenda is stolen, you may install 1 non-agenda card from HQ.
cards.flavor: Fashion fades. Poétrï is eternal.

cards.name: Principia
cards.text: This program costs 1[credit] less to install for each other installed icebreaker. (Programs trashed as part of installing this program don’t count.) Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 barrier subroutine. 2[credit]: +2 strength.
cards.flavor: On the shoulders of giants.

cards.name: Project Ingatan
cards.text: Dividends 1 (When you score this agenda, place 1 agenda counter on it for each excess advancement counter.) When your discard phase ends, you may remove 1 hosted agenda counter to install 1 card from Archives, ignoring all costs.

cards.name: Proprionegation
cards.text: When you score this agenda, place 1 agenda counter on it. Hosted agenda counter: The Runner moves to the outermost position of Archives. (They approach any ice in that position.) Use this ability only during a run.
cards.flavor: We rely too much on spatial cognition. What happens when that system receives a null signal?

cards.name: Public Access Plaza
cards.text: When your turn begins, gain 1[credit]. Threat 2 → When the Runner trashes this asset (while it is rezzed), give them 1 tag.
cards.flavor:
“Give me five minutes of a user’s Access Plaza traffic and I’ll tell you where they’re having lunch tomorrow. Give me another ten, and I’ll have their bibi’s secret rendang recipe.”
—Luzviminda Reyes, Synapse Sales

cards.name: Rent Rioters
cards.text: [click][click][click],[trash]: Gain 9[credit].
cards.flavor: “In the end, they raised the rent and we were out on the street. But the riots had tanked property values so much we moved back in—with a better deal!”

cards.name: Rising Tide
cards.text: This program gets +1 strength for each fracter in your heap. Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 barrier subroutine. 1[credit]: +1 strength.
cards.flavor: The waters begin to roil, and bit by bit they swell.

cards.name: Ritual
cards.text: Draw 1 card for each [click] you have remaining.
cards.flavor: Every day starts the same: tea, news, a threedee puzzle. Then it’s off to work. Magdalene won’t let being fired get in the way of completing her masterpiece.

cards.name: Ryō “Phoenix” Ōno: Out of the Ashes
cards.text: The first time each turn a run becomes successful after a subroutine resolved during that run, gain 1[credit] and the Corp trashes 1 card from HQ.
cards.flavor: Light up, flame out, and burn it all down.

cards.name: Sang Kancil
cards.text: Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 code gate subroutine. 3[credit]: +2 strength. If a run event is active, this ability costs 2[credit] less to use.
cards.flavor: Consequences only matter if they catch you.

cards.name: Scatter Field
cards.text:
While this ice is the only piece of ice protecting this server, it gets +4 strength.
[subroutine] You may install 1 card from HQ.
[subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor:
“It is a fallacy that conscious observation can change reality. The consciousness of the observer isn’t required at all.”
—The Encyclopedia Silica

cards.name: Scrounge
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this event, spend [click].
Install 1 program from your heap. You may add 1 program from your heap to the bottom of your stack.
cards.flavor:
“99% of everything is trash. That’s why I pay someone else to search it for me.”
—Sturg3on_General

cards.name: Semak-samun
cards.text: The Runner cannot break the printed subroutine on this ice except using a fracter. [subroutine] End the run unless the Runner suffers 3 net damage.
cards.flavor: The silence of the forest is the surest sign of danger.

cards.name: Sericulture Expansion
cards.text: Dividends 1 (When you score this agenda, place 1 agenda counter on it for each excess advancement counter.) When your discard phase ends, you may remove 1 hosted agenda counter to place 2 advancement counters on 1 installed card. (You cannot score that card this turn.)

cards.name: Shred
cards.text: Run any server. The first time the Corp would end that run, prevent the run from ending unless the Corp reveals and trashes X cards from HQ at random. X is equal to the number of cards in the root of the attacked server.
cards.flavor: The volume is the message.

cards.name: Side Hustle
cards.text:
When you install this resource and whenever a run begins, place 1[credit] on this resource.
When there are 6 or more hosted credits, take all credits from this resource, trash it, and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor:
“They were fast, friendly, and efficient. ★★★★☆.”
—satisfied customer

cards.name: Syailendra
cards.text:
You can advance this ice.
When the Runner encounters this ice, if it has 3 or more hosted advancement counters, you may place 1 advancement counter on an installed card you can advance.
[subroutine] You may place 1 advancement counter on an installed card you can advance.
[subroutine] The Runner loses 2[credit].
[subroutine] Do 1 net damage.

cards.name: Synapse Global: Faster than Thought
cards.text: The first time each turn a tag is removed, you may reveal and install 1 card from HQ, ignoring all costs. [click], remove 1 tag: Gain 2[credit].
cards.flavor: Every Impulse Monitored.

cards.name: The Zwicky Group: Invisible Hands
cards.text: The first time each turn you gain credits through an ability on an agenda or operation, you may draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Action at a distance.

cards.name: Top-Down Solutions
cards.text: Draw 2 cards. Install up to 2 cards from HQ (one at a time).
cards.flavor:
“The instability of human braintapes is directly proportional to the number of limbs on a given bioroid, so we’ve begun phasing them out for something better-equipped. A human braintape could be working beside an octopus for weeks and never have an inkling.”
—Maía Mínervudóttir, R&D

cards.name: Topan: Ormas Leader
cards.text: Once per turn → [click]: Install 1 card from your grip, paying 2[credit] less. When you install that card, suffer 1 meat damage.
cards.flavor: Whatever it takes for us to survive.

cards.name: Touch-ups
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this operation, spend [click].
Place 2 advancement counters on 1 installed card you can advance. If you do, choose a card type and reveal the grip. Choose up to 2 revealed cards of that type. The Runner shuffles those cards into the stack.
cards.flavor: “Your Star Power is in the toilet, kid. We need a fresh face.”

cards.name: Transfer of Wealth
cards.text: Run HQ. If successful, take 1 tag and the Corp loses 3[credit]. Gain 2[credit] for each credit lost this way.
cards.flavor:
“In KK, we say ‘harimau mati karena belangnya’. It means don't tell the world how much money you have if you plan on keeping it.”
—JokoR

cards.name: “Knickknack” O’Brian
cards.text: The first time each turn a run begins, you may trash 1 of your other installed cards. If you do, gain credits equal to its printed install cost and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: There are a hundred currencies in the undercity, and Knickknack takes them all. Creds and rupiah get you noodles. For his secret menu, he’ll take your burnt-out rigs, your sterilized virii. But to taste his smoked vatchicken stew, bring him what he values most: your story.

cards.name: Aircheck
cards.text:
Place 4[credit] on this event. While this event is active, you can spend hosted credits, and you cannot lose or spend credits from your credit pool.
Run HQ or R&D.
When that run ends, if it was successful, you may run a remote server.

cards.name: Ansel 2.0
cards.text: Lose [click][click]: Break up to 2 subroutines on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability. [subroutine] Trash 1 installed Runner card. [subroutine] Remove 1 card in the heap from the game. [subroutine] You may install 1 card from HQ or Archives. [subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor: Designed by 2021 World Champion Patrick Gower

cards.name: Baker
cards.text: Once per turn → [click]: Run Archives. When you would approach Archives (after passing all ice), you may pay 1[credit] to instead change the attacked server to HQ or R&D and approach that server. Spend credits only from stealth cards to pay this cost.
cards.flavor: Time for a key change.

cards.name: Beta Build
cards.text: Search your stack for 1 non-virus program. Install it, ignoring all costs. (Shuffle your stack after searching it.) Run any server. When that run ends, if that program has not been uninstalled, add it to the top of your stack.
cards.flavor: “I donʼt need a forever answer, I need a now answer.”

cards.name: Borrowed Goods
cards.text:
+1[mu]
When you install this hardware, if you are not tagged, take 1 tag.
cards.flavor: “Nice job, kid. Now lose the tail.”

cards.name: Caveat Emptor
cards.text:
Resolve 1 of the following:
  • Gain 6[credit]. The Runner gets −1 allotted [click] for their next turn.
  • Gain 10[credit]. The Runner gets +1 allotted [click] for their next turn.
cards.flavor: “I can tell you’re a discerning customer. That’s why you’re here, after all.”

cards.name: Chain Reaction
cards.text:
Play only if you made a successful run on HQ, R&D, and Archives this turn.
Trash 2 installed Corp cards. The Corp trashes 1 installed Runner card.
cards.flavor: One stone is a small price to pay for two birds.

cards.name: Corsair
cards.text: Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 barrier subroutine. 1[credit]: The barrier you are encountering gets −3 strength for the remainder of this encounter. Spend credits only from stealth cards to use this ability.
cards.flavor: There have been many golden ages of piracy, each occurring on stranger and stormier waters.

cards.name: Cultivate
cards.text: Look at the top 5 cards of R&D. Trash 1 of those cards, add 1 of them to HQ, and arrange the rest in any order.
cards.flavor: To nurture perfection is to know when, what, and whom to cut.

cards.name: Editorial Division: Ad Nihilum
cards.text: The first time each turn you take bad publicity, you may search R&D for 1 non-agenda black ops, gray ops, or liability card and reveal it. (Shuffle R&D after searching it.) Add that card to HQ.
cards.flavor: It never happened.

cards.name: Esca
cards.text:
While the Runner is accessing this asset in R&D, they must reveal it.
When the Runner accesses this asset, they lose 1[credit]. If they are tagged, do 1 net damage.
cards.flavor:
“touch it for all I care! just don’t post a sob story if you get bit”
—luc3ne, in the Rig Kids ‘new-runners’ channel

cards.name: Event Horizon
cards.text: [trash]: End the run. Use this ability only during a run against this server. [subroutine] Trash 1 installed program unless the Runner pays 3[credit]. [subroutine] End the run unless the Runner pays 3[credit].
cards.flavor: Even light cannot escape. What makes you think you can?

cards.name: Flagship
cards.text: HQ or R&D only. Runs against this server cannot be declared successful. (This effect does not cause runs to become unsuccessful.) Persistent → During each run against this server, the Runner cannot access more than 1 card other than this upgrade.
cards.flavor: “Gilded lily? Yeah, you can get one in the gift shop.”

cards.name: Flood the Market
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this operation, spend [click].
Choose 1 installed card you can advance. Place 1 advancement counter on that card for each remote server that has a card in its root and is protected by ice.
cards.flavor: There is a tipping point where an ad becomes so omnipresent, it’s subliminal.

cards.name: Flywheel
cards.text:
[subroutine] Gain 1[credit]. You may draw 1 card.
[subroutine] Gain 1[credit]. You may draw 1 card.
cards.flavor:
“The metakinetic energy of an incursion is an asset. Direct the invader’s movement into a dynamic system, and you may be surprised how much the cluster can extract from it.”
—Moira Virtue, Ice Engineering, MU (formerly of KKU)

cards.name: Grubber
cards.text:
When you rez this ice, if it is protecting a central server, take 1 bad publicity.
[subroutine] End the run unless the Runner pays 3[credit].
[subroutine] End the run unless the Runner pays 3[credit].
cards.flavor: gimme gimme gimme gimme gimme gimme

cards.name: Hackerspace
cards.text: You can install unique (♦) companion resources and unique (♦) connection resources onto this resource. Each resource installed this way costs 1[credit] less to install. While this resource has a hosted companion and a hosted connection, you get +2 maximum hand size.
cards.flavor: “That’s S4lamander, Maestro, iggy two-fingers, C-Sweet, Johnny N., Tina ‘Kickflips’. And of course, Sir Hacksalot.”

cards.name: Hiram “0mission” Svensson: Shadow of the Past
cards.text: Whenever you install or trash a piece of hardware (from any location), look at the top card of R&D.
cards.flavor: “Truth runs deeper than power can ever reach.”

cards.name: Hype Machine
cards.text: As long as an agenda was scored or stolen this turn, the rez cost of this upgrade is lowered by 6[credit]. [trash]: Place 1 advancement counter on a card you can advance in the root of this server.
cards.flavor: Every season is preview season.

cards.name: Knowledge Seeker
cards.text:
Whenever an encounter with this ice ends, if it has 3 or more hosted virus counters, purge virus counters and derez this ice.
[subroutine] Place 1 virus counter on this ice.
[subroutine] Look at the top 4 cards of R&D and arrange them in any order.
[subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor: Designed by 2021 Asia-Pacific Champion William “Sokka” Huang

cards.name: Kompromat
cards.text:
Run a server protected by ice. When that run ends, if it was successful, give the Corp 1 bad publicity unless they derez 1 piece of ice protecting the attacked server.
Remove this event from the game.
cards.flavor: It’s easier to dodge a bullet than an envelope with your name on it.

cards.name: Lampades
cards.text: When you install this program, place 3 power counters on it. Access → Hosted power counter, pay the printed rez or play cost of the card you are accessing: Trash that card. Spend credits only from stealth cards to use this ability.
cards.flavor: “We herald the goddess.”

cards.name: Let Them Dream
cards.text: When you score this agenda, you may search HQ, R&D, or Archives for 1 agenda and reveal it. (Shuffle R&D after searching it.) Add that agenda to HQ or the bottom of R&D. While this agenda is in the Runner’s score area, it is worth 1 less agenda point.

cards.name: Lethe
cards.text:
Whenever the Runner bypasses or fully breaks this ice, give them 1 tag.
[subroutine] You may add 1 card from Archives to the top or bottom of R&D.
[subroutine] Add 1 installed Runner card to the grip.
cards.flavor: Drink deeply and forget.

cards.name: Lionsmane
cards.text:
[subroutine] Do 2 net damage.
[subroutine] Do 2 net damage unless the Runner pays 3[credit].
[subroutine] Do 2 net damage unless the Runner jacks out.
cards.flavor: ”Step closer,” you dream you hear. “Feel my embrace.”

cards.name: Lotus Haze
cards.text: When you score this agenda, place 3 agenda counters on it. Hosted agenda counter: Move 1 rezzed upgrade to the root of another server.
cards.flavor:
“Warn you? Useless. Once they make the biofeedback stick, all you see is what they want you to see.”
—Witch_Of_The_Woods

cards.name: Luana Campos
cards.text: When your turn begins, you may host 1 of your bad publicity counters on this asset. (It has no effect while hosted.) If you do, gain 3[credit] and draw 1 card. [interrupt] → When this asset would be uninstalled, take all hosted bad publicity.
cards.flavor: “May our new headquarters live twice as long as the noble kapok tree that stood where I now stand!”

cards.name: Magistrate Revontulet
cards.text:
As an additional cost to steal an agenda, the Runner must pay 3[credit].
Whenever you score an agenda, the Runner loses 3[credit].
cards.flavor: “I do not take kindly to uninvited guests in my reality. Have you at least brought a gift?”

cards.name: Methuselah
cards.text: +1[mu] Whenever a run begins, you may trash 1 piece of hardware from your grip to place 2[credit] on this hardware. You can spend hosted credits during runs. Limit 1 console per player.

cards.name: Myōshu
cards.text:
Play only if you scored an agenda this turn that you did not install this turn.
Add this operation to your score area as an agenda worth 2 agenda points.
cards.flavor: There is no victory which is not also beauty.

cards.name: Méliès City Luxury Line
cards.text:
As an additional cost to steal this agenda, the Runner must spend [click].
When you score this agenda, gain [click].
cards.flavor: “Welcome aboard, Moonsilver Class members. Our express stops today are at New Lovell, Heinlein, and Imamura Station.”

cards.name: Méliès U: Only the Brightest
cards.text:
When your discard phase ends, secretly set your identity to any copy of Méliès U: Only the Brightest.
When the Runner makes a successful run on a central server, flip this identity.
When the Runner’s action phase ends, gain 1[credit].
Side 1: When you flip this identity to this side during a run on HQ, look at the top card of R&D. You may trash that card. If you do, add 1 card from Archives to HQ.
When the Runner’s discard phase ends, flip this identity.
Side 2: When you flip this identity to this side during a run on R&D, look at the top card of R&D. You may trash that card. If you do, add 1 card from Archives to HQ.
When the Runner’s discard phase ends, flip this identity.
Side 3: When you flip this identity to this side during a run on Archives, look at the top card of R&D. You may trash that card. If you do, add 1 card from Archives to HQ.
When the Runner’s discard phase ends, flip this identity.
cards.flavor:
Above all else.
Beneath any notice.
Off the record.

cards.name: Nihilo Agent
cards.text:
When you rez this asset, load 3 power counters onto it. When it is empty, trash it.
When your turn begins, remove 1 tag and 1 bad publicity.
When your discard phase ends, give the Runner 1 tag, take 1 bad publicity, and remove 1 hosted power counter.
cards.flavor: –ect acquir– ₰ –istory dele–

cards.name: Nurse Hạnh
cards.text: Whenever 2 or more facedown cards in Archives are turned faceup, draw 2 cards.
cards.flavor: “I’ll just need your arm for a few moments.”

cards.name: Paywall
cards.text:
When the Runner encounters this ice, they lose 1[credit].
[subroutine] End the run unless the Runner pays 1[credit].
cards.flavor:
“Yeah, I previously worked at a Weyland shop, but the boss had it out for me. Creative differences.”
—Isolde Muraro, ice architect

cards.name: Perfect Recall
cards.text: When you rez this upgrade and whenever an agenda is scored or stolen from this server or its root, place 1 power counter on this upgrade. Hosted power counter: Reveal 1 card in HQ. The Runner cannot steal or trash copies of that card for the remainder of this run. Use this ability only during a run.

cards.name: Read-Write Share
cards.text: Limit 4 hosted cards. When you install this program and when your turn begins, you may host 1 card from your grip facedown on this program to draw 1 card. [trash]: Shuffle all hosted cards into your stack.
cards.flavor: Take what you need. Leave what you can.

cards.name: Reanimation Protocol
cards.text: Install and rez 1 piece of ice from Archives, paying a total of 10[credit] less. If you rezzed a piece of non-liability ice this way, take 1 bad publicity.
cards.flavor: The only blasphemy is to wallow in deletion.

cards.name: Retirement Plan
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this operation, spend [click].
Install 1 agenda, asset, or piece of ice from Archives.
cards.flavor: Your terms of service have been extended.

cards.name: Reverb
cards.text:
The rez cost of this ice is lowered by 1[credit] for each other unrezzed piece of ice.
[subroutine] End the run.
[subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor: Everything in the Net is ultimately just information—light, sound, runners. If you can reflect any, you can reflect all.

cards.name: Rotary
cards.text: +1[mu] Whenever you breach HQ or R&D, you may take 1 tag to access 1 additional card. [click], 2[credit]: Trash this hardware. Only the Corp can use this ability, and only if the Runner is tagged. Limit 1 console per player.

cards.name: Sacrifice Zone Expansion
cards.text: Install only faceup. (This agenda is neither rezzed nor unrezzed.) The first time each turn you advance this agenda, gain 3[credit]. Once per turn → When the Runner makes a successful run on another server, you may remove 1 hosted advancement counter to do 1 meat damage.

cards.name: Scapegoat
cards.text:
Resolve 1 of the following of the Runner’s choice:
  • Remove 2 bad publicity.
  • Choose 1 installed Runner card. The Runner shuffles it into the stack.
cards.flavor: She’d play the part of the dangerous criminal for now; that was the deal. She was too useful to put away for good. Even Lunar Customs could use a smuggler of her skills now and then.

cards.name: Sell Out
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this event, trash 1 installed resource.
Gain 4[credit] and draw 2 cards.
cards.flavor: “We’re cooked, maninha. Somebody tipped them off.”

cards.name: Shackleton Grid
cards.text: Once per turn → When the Runner spends credits from outside their credit pool during a run against this server, you may do 4 meat damage. Limit 1 region per server.
cards.flavor: You’re on your own.

cards.name: Sipa
cards.text: The first time each turn you pass the outermost piece of ice protecting a server after fully breaking it, you may swap it with another installed piece of ice.
cards.flavor: Can’t let it touch the ground.

cards.name: Sleipnir
cards.text:
[subroutine] You may draw 1 card.
[subroutine] You may shuffle 1 card from HQ or Archives into R&D.
[subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor:
He bade write runes on the shield before the shining goddess,
on Sleipnir’s teeth, and the straps of the sledge.

cards.name: Stick and Poke
cards.text: The first time each turn you encounter a piece of ice, it gains “[subroutine] Do 1 net damage. The Runner draws 1 card.”, before its other subroutines, for the remainder of that encounter.
cards.flavor: In the Net, it takes a special effort not to sanitize your equipment. But they manage anyway.

cards.name: Stowaway
cards.text:
Install only on a piece of ice.
Whenever you make a successful run on this server, gain 2[credit].
cards.flavor: Not only does life exist in the Net, it adapts to our presence and thrives.

cards.name: Synchrocyclotron
cards.text: The first double operation you play each turn costs [click] less to play.
cards.flavor: The cyclotron’s utility was discovered after its magnets quenched during load testing, resulting in 1,600 tons of liquid helium venting directly into Heinlein city tenements and an anomalous 13-second local time loss. An apology was issued, funerals were covered, and funding was rerouted to recreate the error at scale.

cards.name: Tailgate
cards.text:
The play cost of this event is lowered by 1[credit] for each piece of ice protecting HQ.
Run HQ. If successful, access 2 additional cards when you breach HQ.
cards.flavor: In the age of unparalleled digital security, never underestimate the power of human error.

cards.name: Take a Dive
cards.text:
Run HQ or R&D. If successful, and if a subroutine resolved during this run, give the Corp 1 bad publicity.
Remove this event from the game.
cards.flavor:
“The walking flatlined will never know the difference between a cyberwall and a Saisentan. Use that fact!”
—Cracking Corps for Fun and Profit

cards.name: The Red Room
cards.text: Central server only. The first time each turn an agenda is scored or stolen, place 1 power counter on this upgrade. Hosted power counter: End the run. Use this ability only during a run against another server.
cards.flavor: The equipment for asset return and processing is bespoke, and can be set up in less than an hour.

cards.name: The Tungsten Tailor
cards.text:
Each piece of ice gets −1 strength.
The first time each turn you break a subroutine on a piece of ice with 0 or less strength, gain 1[credit].
cards.flavor:
“I don’t know if the Net is made of atoms or bits or something else altogether. I do know this baby’s sharp enough to poke a hole in whatever the answer is.”
—Pumpkin-and-Dumplin

cards.name: Tocsin
cards.text: [click], 1[credit], reveal and trash this ice from HQ: Search R&D for up to 1 barrier and up to 1 sentry and reveal them. (Shuffle R&D after searching it.) Add those cards to HQ. [subroutine] The Runner loses 2[credit]. [subroutine] End the run. [subroutine] End the run.
cards.flavor: No one can hear the clamor of the bells and not be alarmed. Least of all the intruder.

cards.name: Touchstone
cards.text:
The first time each turn you play an event, place 1[credit] on this hardware.
You can spend hosted credits during runs.
cards.flavor: I know who I am.

cards.name: Underdome Irregulars
cards.text: When your action phase ends, if a piece of ice was rezzed this turn, draw 2 cards or remove 1 tag. If no ice was rezzed this turn, trash this resource.
cards.flavor: “Got me out of a jam, so I lend it a hand sometimes. Same with most of us: favors, debts, blackmail, whatever. Point is, when Vic calls, you pick up.”

cards.name: Unleash
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this operation, remove 1 tag.
Rez 1 installed piece of ice, ignoring all costs. You may resolve 1 subroutine on that ice.
cards.flavor: “Found you.”

cards.name: Vertigo
cards.text:
When the Runner passes this ice, if they have no [click] remaining, they cannot steal or trash Corp cards for the remainder of this run.
[subroutine] The Runner loses [click].
cards.flavor: It was only a moment for you; you took no notice.

cards.name: Vicsek
cards.text:
[subroutine] Do X net damage and give the Runner X tags. X is equal to the number of tags the Runner has.
[subroutine] Give the Runner 1 tag. Trash this ice.
cards.flavor: BZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZ

cards.name: Virtual Intelligence, P.I.: “You Can Call Me Vic”
cards.text: Once per turn → [click], 1[credit]: Draw 1 card and remove 1 tag.
cards.flavor: “I knew from the start this case was gonna be the end of me…”

cards.name: Vulture Fund
cards.text: Gain 14[credit] and take 1 bad publicity.
cards.flavor: “The boss likes to swoop in at just the last second. You should consider yourself lucky.”

cards.name: Witch Hunt
cards.text:
When this agenda is scored or stolen, take 1 bad publicity.
When your action phase ends, if you scored this agenda this turn, remove all tags, then give the Runner 3 tags.
cards.flavor: Of the truth, only ashes remained. Of his former life, even less.

cards.name: Word on the Street
cards.text:
As an additional cost to score an agenda the Corp installed this turn, they must add this resource to their score area as an agenda worth −1 agenda points with “You cannot forfeit this agenda.”.
When the Corp scores an agenda they did not install this turn, trash this resource, gain 4[credit], and draw 1 card.

cards.name: ezaM
cards.text: [click]: Swap this ice with another installed piece of ice. [subroutine] Look at the top card of R&D. You may add that card to the bottom of R&D. [subroutine] Each piece of ice gets +1 strength for the remainder of this run.
cards.flavor: A web that only tightens the more you’re lost within it.

cards.name: realloc()
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this operation, spend [click].
Choose 2 rezzed pieces of ice. For each chosen piece of ice, gain credits equal to its printed rez cost, then derez it.
cards.flavor: All service will be indefinitely suspended by 11:59 pm tonight. We apologize for any inconvenience.
